jobs.description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Mgr, Supply Chain Data Products and Analytics

Position Summary

Leads the Supply Chain Data Products & Analytics team serving the Supply Chain organization. The Manager owns the supply chain data product portfolio — governed, reusable analytical assets including inventory productivity and Economic Return on Inventory models, workforce capacity models, distribution network demand signals, and operational scorecards — that convert enterprise data into supply chain decisions with measurable financial outcomes.

The role builds domain analytics on the enterprise data platform under enterprise standards, is the named owner of the supply chain analytical data layer and leads the team's adoption of AI-enabled analytical capability, including the existing automation portfolio and natural-language analytics, under applicable governance and control standards.

Essential Responsibilities

Data Product Ownership

- Owns the supply chain data product catalog: definition, prioritization, development, versioning, and retirement of governed analytical assets serving Supply Chain functions, Supply Chain leadership, and enterprise finance stakeholders.

- Directs closure of documented domain data engineering gaps in the enterprise lakehouse in partnership with the enterprise data platform organization.

- Establishes data contracts, refresh standards, and quality thresholds for all production data products.

S/4HANA Analytical Continuity

- Serves as the accountable owner for the supply chain analytical data layer and maps every production report and data product to its post-conversion data source before cutover.

- Partners with the Business Integration function on system-of-record design decisions affecting downstream analytics; Business Integration owns system configuration and process design — this role owns the analytical consumption layer.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Workflow

- Owns and evolves the team's automation and AI-assisted analytics portfolio, progressing from robotic process automation toward governed AI workflows within human-approved control boundaries and applicable enterprise standards.

- Maintains a value ledger attributing realized savings and productivity hours to each deployed capability; no autonomous AI action on financial controls.

Decision Support

- Delivers executive decision support: MSS Leadership Scorecard, Monthly Operating Review analytics, blocked invoice control monitoring against the SOX threshold, and CFO-level financial models.

Team Leadership & Capability Build

- Leads, develops, and performance-manages a team of 4–5 professionals; executes the team's skills progression toward analytics engineering, AI engineering, and data product management.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, engineering, information systems, or business discipline, or equivalent experience.

- Seven or more years of progressive experience in analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, or supply chain decision support, including two or more years leading people or cross-functional delivery.

- Demonstrated delivery of analytical products on a modern cloud data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent) with SQL fluency and working knowledge of data modeling.

- Experience supporting enterprise resource planning data environments; SAP (ECC or S/4HANA) data structures strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in utility, energy, or asset-intensive supply chain operations.

- Experience with data product management practices, semantic layer design, or federated operating models.

- Experience deploying RPA, LLM-based tooling, or AI-assisted workflow automation under enterprise governance, including human-in-the-loop control design.

- Power BI at an advanced level, including workspace administration and deployment pipelines.

Company Description
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description
Turner & Townsend is seeking an analytical individual to join our NY Real Estate Office. This role will be responsible for the preparation and support of monthly operational financial reports for commercial real estate construction projects and ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of reports. Furthermore, this individual will be responsible for collaborating with the wider business in the aggregation of financial information to assist in the documentation, review, and communication.

Duties Include:

- Set up and maintain contract / projects on the Financial Management System – Dynamics (charge rates, project forecasts, forecast spread)

- Responsible for the monthly, quarterly and annual forecasting reviews with Project Directors / Leadership team

- Explain invoiced values against forecast values and budget variances

- Maintaining up to date data (opportunities, forecasts, invoicing, POs) within Dynamics 365

- Reviewing and analyzing utilisation data from Dynamics 365

- Responsible for reconciliation checks across financial data to omit errors to improve report accuracy

- Responsible for the monthly invoices and billing reports on key accounts

- Management and collation of client timesheets to support invoicing on key accounts

- Responsible for the monthly finance report to the external client on key accounts

- Dealing first hand with financial queries from operational staff

- Management of Interco agreements and Interco Purchase orders as well as Subcontractor PO’s

- Management of internal financial transfers, invoicing and agreements

- Management of contractor costs

- Undertake monthly, quarterly and annual forecasting and margin reviews

- Support for the Credit Control team

- Provision of data for reports and audits

- Respond to requests for information on profitability

- Support leadership teams in providing Finance related messages and confidence to the business

Key Attributes

- Quantitative skills – understanding and manipulating numbers and data

- Strong Excel Skills (including Sumif, VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, and Graphs)

- Working knowledge of D365 preferable but not essential

- High level of accuracy and attention to detail

- Strong organization and time management

- Ability to work on own initiative and meet tight deadlines

- Flexible and responsive attitude

- Working knowledge of PowerBI preferable but not essential

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field.

- Minimum of 2 years of experience working within an accountancy/finance-based position

- Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, invoicing and management

- Understanding of GAAP financial reporting standards.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

- Effective communication skills with the ability to present financial information.

- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Additional Information
*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

Job Title:
Business Operations Analyst

Department:
Advancement | Alumni Association

Position Overview

The Business Operations Analyst provides operational, analytical, and administrative support for the LAG Program and the Executive Director of Philanthropic Engagement. This position supports business operations by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing operational data, monitoring progress toward program priorities, preparing reports, dashboards, and presentations, and supporting annual planning, goal setting, resource planning, and workflow improvement efforts.

The Business Operations Analyst coordinates with internal partners, Advancement units, academic and medical center stakeholders, and vendors to support operational processes, business transactions, data integrity, and timely follow-up on key deliverables. The role identifies operational challenges, recommends solutions, supports standardization efforts, and helps ensure resources, processes, and communications are aligned with broader fundraising and institutional priorities.

The Business Operations Analyst requires strong written and oral communication skills, sound judgment, discretion, analytical and organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex environment. The role requires the ability to work independently and collaboratively, maintain confidentiality, use tools such as Workday, TAS, Microsoft Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and consistently meet deadlines while supporting a culture of continuous improvement.

All members of External Affairs are part of creating a culture that inspires an exceptionally multifaceted and talented team and are expected to exhibit The Ohio State University’s Shared Values. The Office of External Affairs is committed to acting with kindness, respect, and integrity at all times and welcoming our colleagues’ ideas, voices, and perspectives, acknowledging that we are better together.

Duties and Responsibilities

60% - Provides business operations analysis and coordination for the LAG Program by gathering, analyzing, and summarizing data to support operational planning, goal setting, resource planning, decision-making, and reporting. Monitors progress toward program priorities and fundraising-related operational goals, develops and maintains reports, dashboards, tracking tools, and presentations for leadership review. Manages operational data collection processes, supports data integrity, processes business transactions, and prepares regular status updates and summary reports. Identifies operational challenges, analyzes workflow or resource issues, recommends solutions, and supports continuous improvement, process standardization, and best-practice implementation. Coordinates with Advancement partners, academic colleges, regional campuses, Estate and Planned Giving, the Wexner Medical Center, and other internal or external partners to align operational activity with institutional priorities and ensure timely information sharing and follow-up. Supports budget, vendor, and resource-related processes by tracking requests, coordinating documentation, monitoring status, and escalating issues as appropriate.

30% - Provides operational and administrative support for leadership priorities, meetings, communications, and planning activities. Prepares agendas, briefing materials, reports, presentations, communications, and follow-up documentation for internal and external constituents. Coordinates meetings, timelines, logistics, and workgroup activity related to operational initiatives, training for fundraiser managers, annual planning, goal setting, and cross-functional collaboration. Maintains organized records and process documentation, supports workflow transparency through tools such as Workday, TAS, Microsoft Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and ensures follow-up actions are captured and completed. Exercises judgment within defined operational parameters, handles confidential information with discretion, responds to routine inquiries, and escalates complex issues to leadership as appropriate.

10% - Supports special projects and additional operational assignments as needed, including analysis of LAG Program operational strategy, workforce development plans, resource planning, process improvement, standardization initiatives, and other business operations priorities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience.

- 2 year’s of experience in business operations, administrative support, project management, or related field.

Desired Qualifications (We’re committed to building a team that reflects a variety of skills and experiences and encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly)

- Four (4) years of relevant experience

- Knowledge of University fiscal policies desired.

- Experience with Word, Excel, Access, Power Point, and Internet software desired.

- Demonstrated experience in office setting.

- Demonstrated skills in customer service and excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

- Occasionally must be able to work additional hours, evenings, and weekends.

The Office of External Affairs is committed to providing tools and resources for you to learn our business, proprietary databases, university-specific processes, and advancement practices.

You Need to Know

Aside from the unparalleled benefits of working for The Ohio State University and working in the vibrant, smart, enjoyable, and growing city of Columbus, Ohio, this opportunity will provide exceptional rewards that arise from working for an institution doing worldwide life-changing teaching and research. Learn more here: Careers at Ohio State.

In accordance with the Disaster Preparedness and University State of Emergency Policy 6.17 this position has been designated as a standby position.

Company

We are the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco — public servants with a mission to advance the nation’s monetary, financial, and payment systems to build a stronger economy for all Americans. As part of the nation’s central bank, we are committed to understanding and serving the vibrant, expansive communities of the Twelfth District, which covers the nine western states of the U.S. That means we seek and appreciate new perspectives and build opportunities to learn and grow. At the SF Fed, we approach our work with integrity and a commitment to service.

The Law Enforcement + Workplace Experience Group is looking for a Business Analyst to join the Support Office team. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering actionable insights and leading projects and programs that support critical business decisions and improve organizational effectiveness. You will support a broad set of stakeholders across multiple business lines within WE + LE, and the Bank. To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset, be proactive, effectively manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and communicate with ease.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Use business knowledge and analytical skills to support decisions related to WE + LE operations, strategic planning, programs, and business issues. Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources; identify trends and patterns; and develop actionable insights, reports, dashboards, visualizations, and recommendations for leadership.

- Partner with stakeholders and other cross-functional teams to assess business needs, define requirements, evaluate alternatives, and implement projects, automation, data infrastructure, and process improvement solutions that support operational and strategic objectives.

- Lead or participate in cross-functional projects and programs by developing project plans, coordinating meetings and communications, tracking deliverables, documenting decisions and action items, and supporting the successful implementation of business solutions.

- Lead and continuously improve the Group’s information management program by coordinating records management activities, maintaining information maps and permissions, supporting assessments and inventories, overseeing records disposition, and monitoring compliance requirements.

- Coordinate the Group’s business continuity program by maintaining continuity plans, facilitating required exercises and attestations, tracking improvement actions, communicating requirements, and supporting organizational resilience.

- Administer and enhance SharePoint sites, Teams environments, distribution groups, and related collaboration tools by managing permissions, maintaining and organizing content, supporting compliance activities, and improving information access and usability.

- Coordinate recurring business communications, reports, leadership presentations, and other information sharing activities to promote transparency, engagement, and informed decision making across the organization.

- Proactively communicate with internal and external stakeholders, peers and management while building and maintaining positive relationships.

- Provide back-up support for other analysts and team members across the Group.

- Demonstrate sound judgment and discretion when managing sensitive business information, records, permissions, and data.

Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Information Management, Project Management, Public Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience.

- Typically requires 2+ years of experience in business analysis, program coordination, project management, operations, information management, business continuity, or a related business support function.

- Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, CoPilot, Teams, Word, Visio, and Project.

- Experience creating dashboards, reports, infographics, or other data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar business intelligence platforms.

- Strong project management, organizational, and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive work to completion in a dynamic environment.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex information and recommendations to diverse audiences.

jobs.title: Financial Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Here, you’ll find a collaborative culture that respects and values differences and colleagues who share a spirit of generosity.

Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

About This Position

The Financial Data Analyst is responsible for supporting the testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of automated financial information systems and updates related to assigned ERP, client invoicing, and other financial systems, with a focus on Client Invoicing, Revenue Accounting, Cash Management, and related Invoice-to-Cash processes.

The role helps identify and evaluate process and system improvements, supports changes driven by business requirements, client needs, laws, and regulations, and works with Finance, Technology, and business partners to document needs, complete assigned analysis and testing, maintain procedures, and support reliable day-to-day use of financial systems.

The position assists with new functionality, training and procedure materials, and user support, while building business expertise in assigned systems and financial processes.

**This position requires 4 days/week on-site in Owings Mills, MD and will require on-site interviews**

Role Summary

- Requires conceptual knowledge of theories and practices in Finance Systems Enablement, business analysis, system testing, data review, and related financial processes, with emphasis on Client Invoicing, Revenue Accounting, Cash Management, and Invoice-to-Cash activities.

- Works within standardized procedures and established team practices to support financial system enhancements, recurring production activities, user support, documentation, testing, and implementation tasks.

- Completes defined assignments such as documenting business needs, executing test scenarios, validating results, researching routine issues, updating procedures, and regularly verifying that work quality and timeliness support team objectives.

Responsibilities

- Support financial system enhancements and process changes by completing assigned analysis, documentation, testing, implementation, and post-launch support activities.

- Gather and document business needs using established templates, including process notes, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and decision or issue logs.

- Execute defined test scenarios, document results, identify defects or unexpected outcomes, and support retesting after issues are addressed.

- Assist with UAT, business readiness, communications, training materials, procedures, and implementation checklists.

- Monitor assigned production support items, recurring activities, data quality findings, or system maintenance tasks and follow established escalation procedures.

- Analyze system, process, or data issues using available documentation and standard methods; summarize findings and recommended next steps for review.

- Maintain process documentation, system procedures, job aids, training materials, and knowledge articles so information remains current and easy to use.

- Support monthly and quarterly Finance activities by completing assigned system, data, reporting, and control-related tasks accurately and on schedule.

- Coordinate with Finance, Technology, Enterprise Data, Operations, and third-party providers to exchange information, track actions, and support timely resolution of assigned items.

- Identify practical opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, or make processes easier for users; share observations with more experienced team members.

- Build working knowledge of Client Invoicing, Revenue Accounting, Cash Management, financial systems, and the broader Invoice-to-Cash process through hands-on assignments and team learning.

Qualifications

Required:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, Technology, or a related field, or the equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

- 0+ years of total relevant work experience in finance, accounting, business analysis, systems support, data analysis, operations, or a related discipline.

- Conceptual understanding of accounting, financial processes, business analysis, information systems, or data management.

- Ability to follow standardized procedures, organize assigned work, meet deadlines, and check work for accuracy and completeness.

- Analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to collect information, identify patterns, and summarize findings.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work constructively with colleagues across business and technology teams.

- Attention to detail, curiosity, and willingness to build knowledge of financial systems and Invoice-to-Cash processes.

Preferred:

- Internship, academic, or work experience involving finance, accounting, information systems, business analysis, data, operations, or process improvement.

- Working knowledge of common productivity tools used for analysis, documentation, communication, and presentation.

- Exposure to ERP platforms, billing systems, workflow tools, reporting platforms, testing tools, or enterprise applications.

- Exposure to Client Invoicing, Revenue Accounting, Cash Management, accounts receivable, billing, or related financial processes.

- Experience creating process documentation, test scripts, training materials, data analysis, or business requirements in an academic or professional setting.

- Interest in automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, workflow, or other technologies that can improve business processes.

FINRA Requirements

FINRA licenses are not required and will not be supported for this role.

jobs.title: IT Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Company:

Description:

Our not-so-secret sauce.

Award-winning, inclusive, Top Workplace culture doesn’t happen overnight. It’s a result of hard work by extraordinary people. The industry’s brightest talent drive our efforts to deliver purposeful work and meaningful impact every day. Learn more about what makes us different and how you can make your mark as a Salesforce Developer at Marsh Agency.

Marsh Agency helps people and organizations manage risk and prepare for the future through insurance, benefits, retirement, and wealth management strategies. We believe in hands-on proactive service, data-driven insights, and understanding how global events can impact local decisions. As a trusted partner, we show our clients what’s possible and guide them during every step of their journey.

A day in the life

As an IT Operations Analyst on the IT Strategy & Operations team, you will serve as a central hub for enabling strong operational and financial management across the IT organization. You will own core IT financial planning activities (forecasting, budgeting, and spend management), with a particular focus on outside services and third-party spend. This role will also manage day-to-day vendor relationships and contract administration activities, ensuring work is delivered as expected and vendors and contractors are onboarded and offboarded smoothly. The ideal candidate can operate independently, bring structure to ambiguity, and partner effectively with IT leaders, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Accounts Payable, and vendors.

Our future colleague.

We’d love to meet you if your professional track record includes these skills:

IT financial planning, forecasting & budget management (outside services focus)

- Own the forecasting and budget process for the IT organization, with emphasis on outside services / third-party spend.

- Maintain run-rate views and forecast models; identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities and provide clear variance commentary versus prior forecasts and budgets.

- Partner with IT leaders and cost owners to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and drive timely submissions for monthly/quarterly cycles.

- Support month-end activities as needed (e.g., accrual tracking, invoice timing, and forecast updates) in coordination with Finance and Accounts Payable.

- Maintain financial trackers and data integrity across sources (e.g., invoices, POs, contracts, budget trackers); reconcile discrepancies and document assumptions.

- Prepare executive-ready summaries, dashboards, and talking points that translate financial details into decisions and actions for IT leadership.

- Identify and implement process improvements to streamline budgeting/forecasting and improve transparency of third-party spend.

Vendor management, contracting support & performance monitoring

- Manage day-to-day vendor relationship and contract administration activities for IT outside services providers.

- Support new sourcing events (RFIs/RFPs/RFQs) by coordinating requirements, gathering documentation, organizing responses, and supporting evaluation and selection.

- Monitor active vendor engagements to evaluate delivery quality and facilitate renewals

- Support basic spend analysis and vendor reporting to improve cost visibility and identify optimization opportunities.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

- 3–5+ years of experience in technology finance, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), IT financial operations, vendor management, procurement/contract administration, or a comparable cross-functional role.

- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining budgets/forecasts, performing variance analysis, and translating results into clear written commentary and leadership-ready insights.

- Experience managing third-party / outside services spend in an IT organization (professional services, managed services, SaaS/software, cloud, or related technology categories).

- Hands-on Excel skills (e.g., pivots, lookups, data validation, reconciliation) and comfort working with imperfect data from multiple sources.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to independently prioritize work and meet recurring deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to coordinate across IT, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and vendor partners.

- Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential financial, vendor, and personnel information.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with forecasting and budgeting tools such as Oracle, IBM Apptio, etc.

- Experience supporting RFx processes, contract renewals, and vendor performance reporting.

- Experience building simple dashboards or reporting (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) to improve visibility of spend and vendor performance.

- Experience in financial services, insurance, or professional services environments.

We know there are excellent candidates who might not check all of these boxes. Don’t be shy. If you’re close, we’d be very interested in meeting you.

Business Systems Analyst – Laboratory Information Technology Systems

The Business Systems Analyst serves as the liaison between laboratory operations and information technology teams, supporting scientists, laboratory technicians, and quality professionals. This position is part of a collaborative team responsible for enhancing existing Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), implementing new laboratory technology solutions, and supporting system integrations across clinical laboratory environments.

This role is well suited for candidates with experience in clinical laboratory operations and a strong understanding of laboratory workflows, information systems, data integrations, and technology-driven process improvements.

- Develops and maintains documentation, standards, procedures, and best practices related to laboratory systems and business analysis activities.

- Applies business analysis methodologies to translate complex laboratory workflows into scalable technology solutions.

- Influences stakeholders across multiple functional areas to support project priorities, system enhancements, and implementation initiatives.

- Supports laboratory system implementation, integration, enhancement, and optimization projects from requirements gathering through deployment.

jobs.title: CX Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; New York, NY - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto's Customer Experience team is changing how we serve small businesses: new service models, a telephony platform migration, and the data infrastructure to support both. We are hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to own the data layer that makes this work.

You will work directly with CX leaders to identify and scope priorities, own the foundation of pipelines, data models, and dashboards that make CX data trustworthy, and use that foundation to answer causal questions about what actually moves customer outcomes. The strongest candidates pair real coding and statistical depth with the judgment to know which question is worth answering.

About the Team:

CX Data and Insights is the analytical backbone of Gusto's Customer Experience organization. We define the metrics CX leaders run the business on, and we produce the analysis that shapes operational roadmap decisions.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

- Lead: Own ambiguous problems, design analysis and measurement frameworks, and introduce policies and practices by which data integrity is monitored and enforced within your domain.

- Execution: Deliver multiple high-impact projects, balancing trade-offs to maximize business value, and maintain clear expectations of deliverables and timelines.

- Strategic Partnership: Partner with CX leaders, cross-function data-science teams, tool developers (i.e. Salesforce), and data engineering to align on strategy.

- Analytical Rigor: Apply advanced statistical methods and AI-driven anomaly detection to proactively uncover opportunities, diagnose performance issues, and shape CX strategy, separating signal from noise. Navigate messy, conflicting data sources to establish reliable sources of truth. Use AI to accelerate hypothesis generation, code drafting, cross-source reconciliation, validation, and build agents to automate repetitive tasks.

- Develop and scale reporting: define DBT and Snowflake data pipeline requirements for evolving CX data sources, and build and maintain monitoring systems and streamlit dashboards for day-to-day operation and self-serve insights.

- Independence: Work with minimal guidance to prioritize, create, and deliver data projects, proactively resolving conflicts or misalignment across stakeholders.

- Scale the Craft: Up-level the team’s best practices in data modeling and schema design, expand our toolsets (e.g., Databricks for AI-augmented modeling and anomaly detection) where they accelerate CX outcomes, drive improvements in data quality, rigor, and adoption of better data capabilities, and mentor other data practitioners.

- Communication: Present complex findings in a structured, compelling way to technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a data-informed mindset across the company.

Here’s what we're looking for:

- 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Governance.

- Strong SQL and Python proficiency, capable of querying and analyzing large datasets with ease.

- Strong foundation in data modeling, schema design, and data quality best practices, with functional experience working on cloud platforms like Snowflake.

- Proven experience building and maintaining robust data reporting pipelines and ETL workflows.

- Demonstrated experience designing or operating governance for AI-assisted analytics outputs. At minimum: validation standards for AI-generated code and metric definitions, drift and source-of-truth audits on dashboards that feed operational decisions, and documented rules for when human review is non-negotiable on performance-adjacent data products. Comfort working inside an organization's AI use policy.

- Clear, direct communication style. You can explain a complex data investigation to a non-technical stakeholder in 1-2 sentences before diving into the details.

- Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward without waiting for perfect requirements.

- Frequent, practical use of AI in analytics workflows with concrete examples (not aspirational interest). You can describe specific ways AI has changed how you scaffold pipelines, write and review code, validate data, or generate documentation, and you know where human verification is non-negotiable.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $111,160/yr to $138,950/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $134,735/yr to $168,419/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

This high performing team works with clients to implement the full spectrum of data analytics and data science, from data querying and wrangling to data engineering, to data visualization, dashboarding, and business intelligence (BI), to predictive analytics. This individual will support organizational and mission goals within the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). This role requires hands on technical expertise and strong communication skills. -
Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and machine learning solutions that improve strategic and tactical decision-making.

-
Identify opportunities to improve organizational efficiency by applying AI, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline business processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance workforce productivity.

-
Design and implement AI-enabled workflow solutions for document processing, knowledge management, literature reviews, information retrieval, case management, reporting, decision support, and other operational functions.

-
Develop Generative AI (GenAI) solutions using large language models (LLMs), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, vector databases, AI agents, and prompt engineering techniques.

Develop predictive, classification, clustering, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and other machine learning models using structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.

Develop scalable data science pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark, and cloud-native analytics platforms.

Develop dashboards, visualizations, technical documentation, presentations, and demonstrations that communicate AI capabilities and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

-
Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI and machine learning solutions using modern MLOps and DevSecOps practices.

-
Apply responsible AI principles, governance, privacy, security, and human-in-the-loop review throughout the AI lifecycle.

-
Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL and AI data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Amazon S3, and AWS analytics services.

Three (3) or more years of experience in data analytics, data visualization, or related technical consulting fields.

-

Job Description:

GDIT's Federal Health Division is hiring a Member Services Data Analyst to support the the World Trade Center Health Program (WTCHP).

You will play a key role in transforming member services and operational data into actionable insights that improve member experience, increase operational efficiency, and support data-driven decision-making across the program.

This role is ideal for a process-oriented analyst who enjoys understanding how systems, teams, and workflows interact. Successful candidates are naturally curious, continuously seek opportunities for improvement, and are comfortable challenging inefficient processes while identifying practical solutions.

What You'll Be Doing:

- Support member services operations by analyzing and reporting on key performance metrics, identifying trends, and recommending process improvements that enhance service delivery and member satisfaction.

- Collaborate with Operations, Customer Service, IT, Data, and Program Leadership teams to align reporting requirements, define performance metrics, and implement data-informed process improvements.

- Analyze member service performance indicators, including call center metrics, service-level performance, quality measures, satisfaction scores, and member feedback trends to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.

- Monitor member benefits administration activities by tracking enrollment, eligibility, health, life, and related benefit program data to ensure accuracy, compliance, and positive member outcomes.

- Develop dashboard requirements, reports, and visualizations for operational leaders and executives using Power BI, Excel, SQL, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.

- Utilize data analysis to evaluate existing workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational processes, recommending enhancements that improve efficiency, consistency, and customer experience.

- Support data quality initiatives by identifying discrepancies, validating data sources, and assisting with data cleansing and reporting accuracy efforts.

- Leverage Jira or similar tools to manage reporting requests, track process improvement initiatives, document requirements, and monitor implementation progress.

- Produce executive-ready reports, presentations, and performance analyses that support strategic planning, operational improvements, and leadership decision-making.

- Ensure adherence to applicable privacy, security, and compliance requirements related to member information and protected health information (PHI).

What You'll Need (required):

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Public Health, or a related field

- Experience: 2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, operations analysis, business analysis, customer service analytics, benefits administration, or a related field

- Experience analyzing operational processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing data-driven recommendations

- Strong proficiency in Excel and experience creating reports, dashboards, and data visualizations

- Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools

- Familiarity with SQL for data extraction, analysis, and reporting

- Experience documenting business processes, workflow mapping, standard operating procedures (SOPs), or operational requirements

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills

- Ability to present findings and recommendations to both operational and leadership audiences

- Ability to work collaboratively across business and technical teams

- Security clearance level: Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust suitability

What Would Be Eeven Better (preferred):

- Experience supporting healthcare, health insurance, benefits administration, member services, customer contact centers, or government healthcare programs

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, enrollment processes, claims, eligibility, customer experience, or service delivery metrics

- Experience with Jira or other work management and ticketing platforms

- Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI, PCI, or related privacy and security requirements

- Experience with process improvement methodologies, workflow optimization, or operational excellence initiatives

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Explore a career in analytics and business operations at GDIT and join a team dedicated to improving member experiences through data-driven insights, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement. You'll work alongside colleagues who share your passion for solving complex challenges and delivering meaningful results in support of the World Trade Center Health Program.

The likely salary range for this position is $64,230 - $85,100. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

Remote

To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. - Experience working with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) and creating executive-ready dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to analyze large, complex datasets and communicate insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Ellipsis Health builds AI products that take on healthcare's staffing shortages and administrative burden, pairing conversational AI with our patented voice biomarker technology to help deliver better healthcare for everyone. Our voice agents talk with patients every day: booking and rescheduling appointments, answering billing questions, handling medication refills, and checking in after a hospital visit.

This role drives growth and operations for our provider business, which serves health systems, provider groups, and FQHCs. You'll work across the provider teams within Ellipsis, from sales and deployment to customer success, product, and engineering, and report into provider segment leadership.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're seeking a Business Operations Associate to play a critical role in driving growth, operational excellence, and customer success. You'll work across three areas: business operations, customer experience, and data and analytics, using a combination of analytical, operational, and technical skills to evaluate key business problems while weighing the needs of a variety of stakeholders, from internal teams to senior health system leaders.

The ideal candidate blends strategic thinking, analytical horsepower, and hands-on execution, has exceptional attention to detail, high drive and low ego, and is energized by tackling the complex, interesting challenges of a rapidly scaling startup.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Support and eventually lead internal business reviews, highlighting performance and optimization initiatives across the full funnel.

 - Build scalable processes and playbooks for customer onboarding, deployment handoffs, and cross-functional workflows as the provider business grows.

 - Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for health system, provider group, and FQHC customers after go-live, partnering with the deployment team to keep programs on track.

 - Run recurring customer check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews, translating program performance into clear outcomes and next steps.

 - Monitor patient experience and program quality across our provider programs (outreach outcomes, escalations, and care coordinator handoffs), flagging and resolving issues before they reach the customer.

 - Build and maintain customer-facing reporting and dashboards that show program impact and ROI.

 - Capture customer feedback and feature requests, partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize them, and close the loop with customers.

 - Identify renewal and expansion opportunities (new sites, service lines, or products) using program data, market trends, and customer feedback, and support the growth team in pursuing them.

 - Develop and monitor critical operational performance metrics, surfacing the second- and third-order implications of identified trends.

 - Analyze program performance and patient engagement data across deployments to benchmark outcomes, identify efficiency opportunities, and run controlled experiments to test solutions.

 - Conduct in-depth market research to develop customer, competitor, partner, and white-space opportunity briefs.
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 4+ years of experience in a data-heavy work environment (e.g., finance, consulting), including 2+ years of investment banking, private equity / growth equity, and/or consulting, and 1+ years of operational experience at a high-growth technology company.

 - Highly proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, and Sheets) and Claude.

 - Ability to flex between high-level strategic thinking and deep analytical problem solving.

 - Comfort in client-facing settings, including presenting performance results to senior health system stakeholders.

jobs.description:

About the Team:

The Dow Jones Customer Service (DJCS) mission is to provide great service for our customers and great experiences for our people. Our team has the privilege of delivering impactful experiences by helping our customers access the trusted news and business information published and produced by our marquee brands including, The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, MarketWatch, Dow Jones Factiva and Dow Jones Risk & Compliance. jobs.title: Pricing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Our Opportunity

Chewy is hiring a Pricing Data Analyst to support pricing programs that strengthen customer trust, competitive price perception, and pricing consistency. This role combines hands-on analysis with operational ownership: you’ll monitor pricing performance, investigate issues, and help turn insights into improvements to our tools and processes. You’ll work with Pricing Analytics, Data Science, Product and Technology, Merchandising, and other partner teams. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working with large datasets, and able to connect data findings to clear next steps.

What You’ll Do

- Use SQL and other analytical tools to assess pricing performance, competitive matching, price perception, and margin-related opportunities.

- Build and maintain reporting and monitoring that help teams track pricing metrics, identify issues, and understand trends.

- Investigate pricing or data quality issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with partner teams on resolution.

- Support pricing initiatives by helping define cohorts, validate data, monitor results, and prepare readouts.

- Help maintain recurring pricing processes and identify opportunities to improve their accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

- Partner with Analytics, Data Science, Product and Technology, Merchandising, and other teams to clarify business needs and support tools or automation.

- Summarize findings and recommendations in a clear, actionable way for technical and business partners.

- Document processes, requirements, and analytical methods to support consistent execution.

What You’ll Need

- 2+ years of relevant experience in pricing, merchandising, retail, e-commerce, or a related field.

- Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing large datasets.

- Experience with Excel and a data visualization tool such as Tableau; Python or a similar programming language is a plus.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data issues and explain findings.

- Attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring work alongside multiple priorities.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams in a changing environment.

- A bias for action and interest in improving both business processes and tools.

Bonus (Preferred Qualifications)

- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience supporting competitive intelligence, or pricing operations.

- Experience in e-commerce

jobs.title: Data Engineering/Analytics Support
jobs.description:
Job Title: Data Engineering/Analytics Support

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 50%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a flexible, proactive, and detail-oriented engineer with a passion for analytics and a commitment to delivering high-quality products under government direction.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to technical analysis in support of government-led assessments of Integrated Combat Systems and Weapons Systems across warfare areas including Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), Surface Warfare (SUW), Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD), Ground Based Air Defense (GBAD), Strike, Area Defense, Self-Defense and Point Defense areas. You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where priorities may shift and processes are still evolving—requiring adaptability, clear documentation, and a strong sense of initiative.

The ideal candidate has a foundation in an engineering field with MATLAB or Python experience, strong analytical skills, and is eager to learn and tackle complex problems.

Responsibilities:

• Data Analysis & Interpretation: Assist in analyzing data from Defense and Integrated Combat Systems training, testing, and evaluation events to identify trends in system performance. Collaborate with senior analysts to analyze system data. Basic understanding of radar principles is a plus but not required: Including how radar systems transmit and receive signals, and the relationship between these signals and target detection.

• Scripting & Automation: Support the development and maintenance of automated scripts using MATLAB or Python to streamline data extraction, cleaning, and transformation. Training and mentorship will be provided.

• Technical Reporting: Prepare draft technical inputs, summaries, and visual presentations that support government-led reports and briefings.

• Communication & Presentation: Convey analysis inputs to government analysts and government leads.

• Collaboration: Work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, sharing knowledge and collaborating with government and contractor team members as directed.

• Process Improvement: Support refinement and documentation of data analysis workflows, documentation, and reporting processes under government direction.

• Continuous Learning: Proactively expand your understanding of Defense and Integrated Combat System, analytical tools, and related technologies.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense security clearance.

• Willingness and ability to travel as required.

• Ability to maintain a flexible schedule during test events and surge periods.

• Capable of working in stationary positions (sitting or standing) for extended periods.

• Must be a U.S. Citizen.

• Must be willing to work on site in Norco, California.

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoD SECRET clearance.

• Travel may be required, to include riding U.S. Navy vessels.

Desired Skills & Attributes:

• Working knowledge of MATLAB or Python; coursework or personal projects are great.

• Experience or familiarity with tool verification and validation practices.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

• Familiarity with core data analysis techniques and visualization tools.

• Quick to learn new systems, tools, and technical domains.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset.

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The proposed salary range for this position is:
$69,600 - 142,700 USD

jobs.description:
Associate/Experienced Manufacturing Operations Analyst

Company:
The Boeing Company

Boeing Global Services (BGS) is seeking an Associate/Experienced Manufacturing Operations Analyst to join our team in Huntington Beach, CA.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst, Hardware Platform Operations
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

As a member of Hardware Platform Operations, you will work side by side with the operations leads who run the business of Hardware Platform, spanning both core engineering and Rocket Motor Systems, serving as a true right hand on the organization’s most important operational, financial, and strategic work. You will support headcount, budget, capital equipment, and planning workstreams day to day, and you will help with the high-stakes special projects that shape where the organization goes next. You will partner with engineering leadership, our business lines and divisions, Finance, Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Facilities, and central business operations to unpack ambiguous problems and turn them into lasting, scalable solutions.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Hardware Operations Analyst to join our growing team. This role is built for someone who would rather ship a working solution this week than a perfect plan next quarter. Your work will range from quick-turn firefighting to building and redesigning processes to supporting strategic analyses that land in front of division leads and executives. We are open to a range of experience levels and will invest heavily in coaching the right person. Scope will grow as fast as you can take it on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Contribute to Special Projects and Strategic Analysis: Help the operations leads work through the organization’s highest-priority, most ambiguous problems and get them to a decision.

- Build ROI, cost-benefit, and scenario analyses for strategic business starts, Core Technology investments, and organizational design changes.

- Frame the problem, gather the data, form a point of view, and turn it into a clear recommendation for leadership.

- Support the Budget and Financial Operating Rhythm: Track and analyze the financial levers behind Hardware Platform’s budget and fully allocated P&L, in partnership with FP&A.

- Prepare rolling monthly forecasts for headcount, non-labor expense, and capital expenditure, working directly with engineering leads and division operations.

- Produce monthly variance analysis (actuals vs. operating plan vs. forecast), explain the drivers, and recommend actions to stay on plan.

- Partner on Annual Planning and Mid-Year Refresh: Coordinate the planning cycle for Hardware Platform, from input gathering through final submission.

- Build planning models that tie historical labor and spend to strategic priorities and business line demand.

- Help build the case for how Hardware Platform is funded and structured as the organization scales.

- Coordinate Headcount and Staffing Operations: Track the full FTE lifecycle, from program demand intake and req approval through recruiting, onboarding, staffing assignments, and labor reporting.

- Build and maintain the central headcount database and dashboards (current headcount, pending starts, open reqs, and attrition) that give every division a common language for headcount decisions.

- Work cross-functionally with divisions, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and People Operations to inform decisions on requisition openings, headcount adjustments, and hiring priorities for rapid scaling.

- Assist with Capital Equipment and Space: Facilitate the lifecycle of Hardware Platform’s capital equipment, workspace, and lab footprint.

- Maintain the capital equipment database (utilization, depreciation, lifecycle), coordinate the purchase approval process, and help build next year’s capex budget.

- Contribute to workspace and lab growth planning with Facilities and Strategic Real Estate, and track business line utilization of shared equipment and square footage.

- Enable the Leadership Operating Cadence: Help keep the leadership team informed, aligned, and moving.

- Help define KPIs for organizational health, service performance, and team growth, and build report-outs for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews and leadership meetings with division leads and senior executives.

- Organize leadership meetings, capture decisions, and follow action items through to closure.

- Build Scalable Processes and Tools: Leave every process better, faster, and more automated than you found it.

- Design dashboards, trackers, and automations across our systems (e.g., Oracle, Anaplan, Foundry, Google Sheets/Excel, BI tools) and use AI tools to remove manual work.

- Spot gaps in data and systems before they become problems, flag them, and help fix them.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, finance, economics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 1+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, buy-side investing, FP&A, business or strategic operations, or a similar analytical role. We are hiring across multiple experience levels and will level the role based on demonstrated capability.

- Bias for action: You move things forward without waiting to be asked, and you have a track record of following work through to outcomes, not just completing tasks.

- Proactive: You see the problem before it lands on your desk and show up with a proposed fix.

- Influence without authority: You have gotten busy, senior people to make a decision or take action, and you know how to do it with data, clarity, and good relationships.

- Strong analytical and financial foundation: You’re comfortable with financial modeling, variance analysis, and advanced Excel/Google Sheets, and can turn messy data into a clear answer.

- Clear, concise communicator: You write and present crisply to audiences ranging from individual engineers to executives.

- Accountable and organized: You juggle multiple projects in parallel, keep stakeholders updated without being chased, and close loops.

- Coachable and a fast learner: You have high emotional intelligence and a low ego, and you’re eager to learn quickly in a technical, fast-moving environment.

- U.S. Person status required due to access to export-controlled data.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 4+ years of experience in the roles listed above, with demonstrated growth in scope and responsibility.

- Experience working within or supporting engineering or technical organizations, ideally in defense, aerospace, tech, hardware, or advanced manufacturing.

- Experience with headcount planning, capital expenditure planning, or facilities and space planning.

- Hands-on experience with Oracle, Anaplan, Foundry, SQL, or BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI), including building databases or dashboards from scratch.

- Experience using AI tools or automation to scale your own output and your team’s.

- Ability to obtain and hold a U.S. Top Secret clearance.

US Salary Range

$124,000—$164,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

- Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

- Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

-

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Turn Business Problems into Smart Data & Technology Solutions

Are you the person who naturally asks,"Why are we doing it this way?" and then finds a better solution?

At Merkle, we're looking for a Business Systems Analyst who can bridge the gap between business strategy and technical delivery. In this role, you'll work directly with clients and cross-functional teams to uncover business needs, define solutions, and help bring innovative data, marketing technology, and AI-driven initiatives to life.

This is not a role where you simply document requirements and move on. You'll be a trusted advisor, collaborator, and problem solver, helping clients navigate complex challenges while partnering with architects, engineers, and business leaders to drive meaningful outcomes.

What You'll Do

Partner with Clients

- Lead discovery workshops and requirements sessions that uncover business needs and drive decisions.

- Ask thoughtful questions, identify gaps, and help stakeholders clarify their goals.

- Translate business challenges into actionable requirements, use cases, and solution recommendations.

- Contribute to pre-sales conversations and solution design discussions.

Connect Business and Technology

- Turn complex technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.

- Create requirements documentation, process flows, user stories, and solution summaries.

- Help clients understand how data, technology, and AI can support their goals.

- Build alignment across stakeholders with different priorities and perspectives.

Drive Solution Delivery

- Own workstreams and collaborate closely with engineers, architects, and project teams.

- Manage priorities, dependencies, and delivery milestones.

- Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, testing, and user acceptance activities.

- Identify risks early and help teams navigate challenges before they impact delivery.

Embrace AI and Innovation

- Use AI tools to improve requirements gathering, documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.

- Explore new technologies and recommend smarter ways of working.

- Stay current on trends across customer data, marketing technology, analytics, and AI platforms.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You might be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience in business analysis, consulting, solutions delivery, product, or technology-focused roles.

- Enjoy working directly with clients and facilitating conversations that drive outcomes.

- Can comfortably communicate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

- Have experience with platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar technologies.

- Understand data flows, integrations, customer data, and marketing technology ecosystems.

- Are organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.

- Regularly use AI tools to improve how you work and solve problems.

What Success Looks Like

- Clients leave meetings with clear decisions, next steps, and confidence in the path forward.

- Delivery teams receive complete, actionable requirements that help them move quickly.

- Business stakeholders understand the value and impact of technology solutions.

- Projects stay organized, focused, and on track.

- You continually introduce new ideas, efficiencies, and innovations that improve outcomes.

Why Merkle?

At Merkle, you'll work with leading brands to solve challenging business problems at the intersection of data, marketing technology, customer experience, and AI. You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple industries, collaborate with talented experts, and help shape the future of customer engagement and digital transformation.

If you're curious, consultative, technically minded, and passionate about helping businesses solve complex challenges, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

About Futureforce University Recruiting

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Finance

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

TITLE: AI Product Associate Analyst

Location Options: Chicago, Indianapolis

The Experience

The team sits within a broader technology organization supporting professional services, and is evolving to own tools end-to-end — from selection and rollout through ongoing adoption and eventual retirement. Enablement is shifting from broad, one-size-fits-all training toward targeted support for specific tool use cases. The org is focused on tool adoption, operational systems, and staying ahead of emerging industry tools and partners. Overall, the team acts as an internal standards and systems group for professional services, working across a globally distributed set of teams and partners.

Our ideal candidate is interested in designing solutions for our AI agents and helping employees use Salesforce's agentic products in innovative new ways to do their best work. Product Analysts play an important role in Agile teams by gathering requirements from end-users and communicating with engineers and AI Product Managers to deliver the right agent features to meet these user needs.

- Keep pace with evolving business requirements and be willing to work directly with engineers and AI Product Managers on the best possible solution.

- Use Agile and Iterative methodologies during the Agentic Delivery Lifecycle (ADLC).
