jobs.title: Data Scientist, Next Gen Recommendation Systems
jobs.description:
About impact.com:

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at impact.com:

We're seeking a Data Scientist to help build the next generation of recommendation systems powering our partnership automation platform. Our ecosystem connects a rich set of entities—advertisers, media publishers, creators, products, and consumers—and the relationships between them are where the real value lives. Your work will help surface the right partnerships, the right products, and the right content across this network at scale.

You'll contribute to evolving our recommender stack toward a graph-based architecture leveraging semantic embeddings of entities and their relationships, applying cutting-edge techniques in representation learning, graph ML, and retrieval. The system needs to serve recommendations both in batch and real time, respond to dynamic user inputs, drive measurable value for end users across the platform, and remain reliable as the ecosystem grows.

This role is hands-on and end-to-end. You'll own modeling and experimentation work for a defined area of the recommendation stack—from problem framing through productionization—in close partnership with Engineering, Product, MLOps, and Business Stakeholders. You're expected to bring (or actively develop) ML engineering chops so you can take a solution from prototype to production, and to be a relentless user of AI coding agents to multiply your output and accelerate iteration.

What You'll Do:

Core Responsibilities

Multi-entity recommendations across the partnership graph

Design, build, and evaluate recommendation models that operate across heterogeneous entities—advertisers, publishers, creators, products, and consumers—and the relationships between them. Frame problems in terms of the partnership graph and apply techniques appropriate to each surface, including candidate generation, ranking, reranking, and personalization.

Graph-based modeling & semantic embeddings

Contribute to evolving our architecture toward graph-based approaches: learn semantic embeddings of entities and relationships, apply graph neural networks or attention aware graph transformer models where they add value, and build representations that generalize across surfaces and use cases. Stay current with cutting-edge techniques in graph ML, representation learning, and modern recommender architectures, and bring relevant ideas into the platform.

Batch and real-time serving

Build models and pipelines that serve recommendations in both batch and real-time contexts. Partner with Engineering on retrieval infrastructure, vector search, feature stores, and low-latency serving patterns. Make pragmatic tradeoffs between model sophistication, latency, cost, and freshness based on the surface and use case.

End-to-end ML delivery & ML engineering

Own the full lifecycle of your work: data and feature design, model development, evaluation, launch, monitoring, and iteration. Build production-grade pipelines, write code that other engineers can extend, and partner with MLOps on reproducibility, observability, and reliability. Use AI coding agents aggressively to accelerate prototyping, refactoring, debugging, and shipping—we expect this to be a core part of how you work, not an occasional aid.

Experimentation & measurement

Design offline evaluation (offline replay, counterfactual evaluation, holdout sets) and online experiments (A/B tests, holdouts, interleaving) to quantify model impact. Apply appropriate statistical methods, recognize common pitfalls in recommender evaluation (position bias, feedback loops, selection effects), and translate results into clear recommendations for product and engineering partners.

Cross-functional collaboration

Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Business Stakeholders to translate platform goals into measurable model outcomes. Communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Document your work so that models, features, and decisions are understandable and reproducible by others.

What You Bring:

- 3+ years of experience in data science / applied ML, with a track record of shipping production models that delivered measurable user or business impact.

- Strong Python and SQL skills; experience working with large-scale data and distributed compute (Spark/Databricks or equivalent).

- Hands-on experience building recommendation or ranking systems—candidate generation, learning-to-rank, retrieval and reranking, or implicit feedback modeling.

- Experience with embeddings and representation learning for users, items, content, or other entities.

- ML engineering capability (or strong willingness and demonstrated ability to develop it): you can build, ship, and maintain production pipelines—not just prototypes in notebooks.

- Strong experimentation skills: designing and analyzing A/B tests, interpreting results, and communicating findings to stakeholders.

- Relentless user of AI coding agents in your day-to-day workflow, with a clear sense of where they accelerate you and where they don't.

- Insatiable curiosity about new techniques, architectures, and tools—and a track record of teaching yourself things quickly. You read papers, try new tools, and bring ideas back to the team.

- Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to operate with growing autonomy in ambiguous, evolving spaces.

Preferred / Nice to have

- Experience with graph-based ML: graph neural networks (KGAT, transformers or similar), graph-aware retrieval, or knowledge graph embeddings.

- Experience with modern deep learning recommender architectures (two-tower, sequence/transformer-based recommenders, multi-task ranking).

- Familiarity with vector search and vector databases (FAISS, ScaNN, Vespa, Milvus, or similar) and approximate nearest neighbor methods.

- Experience with real-time ML serving, feature stores (Feast, Tecton, or equivalent), and low-latency inference patterns.

- Exposure to contextual bandits, reinforcement learning, or off-policy evaluation in recommendation settings.

- Familiarity with PyTorch/TensorFlow and PyTorch Geometric / DGL for graph workloads.

- Familiarity with GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run) and/or mature MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection).

- Experience in adtech, martech, e-commerce, or two-sided/multi-sided marketplace recommendations.

What Sets You Apart

- You think in terms of user and business outcomes, not just model metrics, and you connect modeling choices to real value delivered through the platform.

- You're rigorous about measurement but pragmatic about shipping—able to deliver MVPs and iteratively evolve them into durable production systems.

- You're a relentless learner. New papers, new tools, new architectures—you find them, try them, and figure out where they fit. You don't wait to be told what to learn.

jobs.title: Corporate Finance, Revenue Operations - Associate
jobs.description:
About the Role

iCapital is seeking a skilled and dynamic Associate to join our Revenue Control team within the Corporate Finance organization. This individual will be a key player in shaping the future of iCapital as the firm continues to scale and expand into new areas. This role resonates across various financial activities, from accounting and reporting for revenue on various products to streamlining processes and driving scalability across the Corporate Finance team, as well as other key stakeholders at iCapital. This Individual will own various responsibilities including month end close duties, revenue, accounts receivable, treasury management and financial reporting as well as ad hoc projects and analyses.

Responsibilities

- Perform revenue calculations and controls for various product lines across iCapital, primarily Technology Solutions.

- Ensure precision in monthly and quarterly revenue estimates and actuals, providing insightful analyses of variances.

- Foster a culture of financial excellence by collaborating with client relationship managers, finance leadership and external client contacts.

- Review legal agreements, contracts and other key documents and understand relevant economic terms as they relate to revenue and reporting and apply that understanding to revenue calculations.

- Support full revenue cycle including order processing, invoicing, payment collection and revenue recognition, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.

- Spearhead month-end close processes, preparing revenue calculations and revenue accruals for technology solutions products.

- Calculate and consolidate P&L and balance sheet data, ensuring accurate journal entries for various entities.

- Assist with the calculation and generation of invoices at month end.

- Perform month over month roll forwards for key revenue metrics.

- Prepare detailed monthly revenue reconciliation analyses supporting accurate P&L reporting.

- Execute cash application processes and prepare monthly cash reconciliations.

- Support the initiative to enhance efficiency and automation of our existing revenue calculations and invoicing processes, including implementation of a new order-to-cash billing and receivable software.

- Develop insightful reporting and analyses to support business unit and product line leads with actionable insights for performance reporting to management and investors.

- Identify and address process gaps, implement robust internal controls, and improve documentation for internal control processes.

- Identify opportunities to streamline processes by leveraging automation tools and data-driven workflows to improve efficiency and accelerate task completion.

Qualifications

- 2-5 years of corporate accounting or public accounting experience within the financial services industry

- Outstanding financial analysis skills and knowledge of accounting principles and US GAAP reporting

- Strong ability to apply critical thinking skills to analyze complex issues and propose effective solutions, while consistently maintaining a meticulous attention to detail

- Organized and detail-oriented process manager who can prioritize and communicate clearly with senior leadership

- Experience with revenue, treasury management, accounts receivable and payable, and cash reconciliations

- Knowledge of booking journal entries and preparation of financial statements

- Data-driven thinker who can manage large data sets for efficient analyses

- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Able to coordinate across teams and departments to complete projects

- CPA license is preferred but not required

- Degree in Accounting is preferred but not required

- Familiar with Oracle NetSuite or other general ledger systems (i.e. Quickbooks) is preferred

- Familiar with alternative investments or structured investments is preferred

Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $85,000 to $110,000. iCapital offers a compensation package which includes salary, equity for all full-time employees, and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and unlimited paid time off (PTO).

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc | Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us/recognition/

jobs.title: Oracle Analytics FDI Developer
jobs.description:
At i360technologies, we deliver business consulting and technology solutions that support the mission of federal agencies. A major federal agency is consolidating its core financial management systems into a single, multi-tenant Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP solution as part of the government-wide push to standardize federal financial management. The program will migrate multiple agency components and customer agencies onto the new platform, with a stated goal of making maximum use of automation and artificial intelligence to reduce manual workload, speed reconciliation and improve data quality.

i360technologies supports this program as a subcontractor to a large federal systems integrator. We are seeking an Oracle Analytics FDI Developer who will help build the financial dashboards and reports the agency uses to see its data clearly and track performance. Centralizing financial data and improving reporting and analytics is a core goal of the program. This is an entry-level role: if you're curious about data, learn fast, and want to start your career on a program of this size, this role is built for you.

Location: Washington, DC Metro, on-site at client facilities; occasional travel to other client locations.

Why AI Matters Here

AI is central to how this team delivers. We want developers who already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to learn new platforms quickly, write and debug SQL, build visualizations, check data, and document their work. You don't need years of experience. You do need to show us how you've used AI to learn something new and get real results.

What You Will Do

- Help develop Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) dashboards, visualizations, and analytical content.

- Support configuration of financial subject areas and semantic models.

- Help build KPIs and performance metrics.

- Write and test SQL queries.

- Help integrate Fusion ERP data into analytics solutions.

- Validate financial data and reporting accuracy.

- Support dashboard and query performance tuning.

- Support security and role-based access to analytics.

- Support testing, deployment, and production support.

- Document your work and learn from senior developers on the team.

Required Qualifications

- High school diploma.

- 1year of experience required.

- Knowledge of SQL through coursework, projects, or work.

- Knowledge of or hands-on experience with a data visualization or BI tool (Oracle Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).

- Basic understanding of data modeling or databases.

- Interest in financial data and reporting.

- Demonstrated use of AI tools to learn new technologies and get work done.

What You'll Gain

- A start to your career on a decade-long federal modernization program.

- Mentorship from senior Oracle analytics and federal financial management specialists.

- A career path that grows with the program: more scope, more responsibility, more expertise each year.

- In-demand skills in Oracle analytics, SQL, and AI-enabled delivery.

What Success Looks Like

- Assigned dashboards, queries, and reports are built and checked on schedule.

- The data you deliver is accurate and ties to the source.

- You learn FDI and Fusion data quickly, using AI to accelerate learning, and take on more scope over time.

Security & Eligibility Requirements

- US Citizenship or Lawful Permanent Residency with a minimum of three (3) years of U.S. residency

- Successful completion of a Moderate Risk background investigation and FBI fingerprinting

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain an HSPD-12 Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential

- Execution of a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)

- Compliance with agency Security Rules of Behavior

- Completion of required cybersecurity and privacy awareness training

- Work must be performed within the United States (remote access from foreign locations is not permitted)

- Employment is contingent upon contract award and Government approval of candidate qualifications

Benefits

- Referral Bonus

- (401k) Matching

- Holidays – Eleven

- Technology Reimbursement

- Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

- Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

- Paid Time Off (0-3 years - 15 Days PTO | 3+ years 20 Days)

- 80% Employer Paid Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

Benefit eligibility and coverage are subject to applicable plan terms and company policies.

Location: Washington, DC Metro. On-site at client facilities in the DC Metro area as required; occasional travel to other client locations

COMPANY DESCRIPTION:

Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a Temporary Business Analyst to lead business analysis activities across enterprise digital experience initiatives within the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem.

In this role, you will serve as a key connection between client business stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams, translating business objectives and operational needs into clear, actionable requirements for Adobe-based solutions. You will work across platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Sites, AEM Assets, Edge Delivery Services, Adobe Workfront, and other Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities.

This is a client-facing role requiring someone who can independently lead discovery and requirements activities, facilitate complex stakeholder discussions, identify gaps and dependencies, and help shape solutions rather than simply document requests.

You will partner closely with client stakeholders, product owners, solution architects, UX teams, developers, QA teams, and delivery leadership throughout the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and solution definition through implementation, testing, and release.

The ideal candidate brings strong Business Analysis fundamentals, significant Agile delivery experience, and hands-on experience working within Adobe Experience Cloud implementations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Lead requirements discovery and analysis for Adobe Experience Cloud implementations and enhancement initiatives.

- Plan and facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, requirements sessions, and solution-definition discussions.

- Translate business objectives into capabilities, epics, features, user stories, functional requirements, process flows, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

- Independently own requirements for significant project workstreams from discovery through implementation.

- Partner with Adobe solution architects and technical teams to evaluate business requirements against platform capabilities and technical constraints.

- Help stakeholders distinguish between business needs, solution requirements, and implementation preferences.

- Identify gaps, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and conflicting requirements and drive them toward resolution.

- Recommend practical solutions when business requests conflict with Adobe platform capabilities, established implementation patterns, or project constraints.

- Develop clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria that enable development and QA teams to execute effectively.

- Own backlog quality and requirements readiness for assigned initiatives.

- Lead and participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.

- Work closely with Product Owners to support backlog prioritization and sequencing.

- Maintain requirements traceability from initial business objectives through implementation and validation.

- Coordinate requirements across business, UX, content, development, integrations, analytics, and QA workstreams.

- Lead functional support for QA and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario review, requirement validation, defect triage, and functional clarification.

- Support release-readiness activities and validate that delivered functionality addresses the intended business need.

- Document current-state and future-state processes, workflows, governance models, business rules, and operating procedures.

- Communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders, translating between the two when necessary.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- 2-3+ years of Business Analysis experience within digital experience, marketing technology, enterprise technology consulting, product delivery, or a related field.

- Demonstrated experience supporting or delivering enterprise solutions within the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem.

- Hands-on Business Analysis experience with Adobe Experience Manager, specifically AEM Sites and/or AEM Assets.

- Experience gathering and defining requirements for AEM capabilities, workflows, content models, authoring experiences, asset management, or related platform functionality.

- Demonstrated experience independently leading requirements discovery and requirements-management activities.

- Strong experience working within Agile delivery environments, including Scrum-based delivery.

- Hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence to manage requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, documentation, backlog activities, and delivery coordination.

- Significant experience supporting Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Testing, including requirement validation, test scenario review, defect triage, and functional clarification.

- Strong experience developing epics, features, user stories, functional requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

- Experience facilitating discovery workshops and requirements sessions with business and technical stakeholders.

- Experience supporting backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization activities.

- Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and how Business Analysis supports discovery, design, development, testing, and release.

- Ability to independently manage a project workstream and drive requirements from ambiguity to an implementable solution.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex enterprise delivery environment.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with multiple Adobe Experience Cloud capabilities is highly desirable, including:

- Adobe Experience Manager Sites

- Adobe Experience Manager Assets

- Adobe Edge Delivery Services

- Adobe Workfront

- Adobe Content Hub

- Adobe Dynamic Media

- Adobe certifications are a plus.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

DUTIES: Analyze, manipulate, or process large sets of data using statistical software. Clean and manipulate raw data using statistical software. Identify business problems or management objectives that can be addressed through data analysis. Recommend data-driven solutions to key stakeholders. Create graphs, charts, or other visualizations to convey the results of data analysis using specialized software. Execute end-to-end analyses to answer key product and business questions. Apply SQL and analytical programming tools to extract, transform, and analyze data from various data sources with accuracy and reproducibility. Design and analyze experiments using valid frameworks, correctly interpreting results and surfacing limitations, assumptions, and sources of uncertainty. Perform structured investigations into metric changes and evaluate plausible drivers. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Engineering to validate metric definitions, experiment setup, and measurement readiness. Clearly document analytical context, methodology, assumptions, and conclusions to ensure work can be understood and reused by others. Communicate findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner, focusing on how results answer the underlying business question. Identify potential data quality or measurement issues and escalate them appropriately. Design causal analyses for complex initiatives, ensuring methodological soundness and appropriate interpretation of results. Remote work may be permitted on occasion within a commutable distance from the worksite.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Business Analytics, Engineering (any), Math or related; and 2 years of experience in the job offered or a related quantitative occupation. About the Role

As a Strategic Sales Data Analyst, you will sit within the product team and play a key role in advancing analytics across Wellmark’s product and sales channels. While this role supports the product model, it will continue to operate as a shared-service resource, partnering broadly across Sales Operations and other business areas to deliver distribution analysis, executive reporting, and insights that inform business decisions. You will develop and enhance Power BI dashboards that help leaders understand performance, identify trends, and uncover opportunities. In addition, you will support sales compensation design, metric development, and strategic analyses that evaluate business performance, channel effectiveness, and key operational outcomes. Through your work, you will help teams establish meaningful measures of success and use data to drive informed decision-making.

About You

You are passionate about using data and visualization to tell a clear business story. With hands-on experience building dashboards, you know how to create visuals that help leaders quickly understand performance, identify trends, and uncover opportunities for deeper analysis. Partnering with stakeholders to define metrics, analyze business challenges, and develop data-driven recommendations comes naturally to you. You enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity and helping teams take a more strategic and disciplined approach to measuring success. Assertive, collaborative, and results-oriented, you have a proven ability to translate complex information into actionable insights and communicate effectively with both operational stakeholders and executive audiences.

Qualifications
Preferred:

- Master's Degree

- Demonstrated history of effective consultation and presentation within the business, including senior leaders

- Proven experience exercising independent judgement and higher order thinking

- Ability to influence direction utilizing data analysis techniques/tools and translating complex data into actionable insights and compelling narratives.

Required:

- Bachelor's degree or direct and applicable work experience.

- 4+ years of experience with data collection, analysis, reporting, and presentation. Ability to independently translate data into consumable insights that support business decisions.

- Demonstrated experience providing effective consulting and influencing decisions through sound judgment and data analysis to effectively drive positive business outcomes.

- Advanced proficiency with Excel, Access, and Business Objects, or similar tools. Technical aptitude to learn new systems quickly and produce ad hoc reports.

- Natural curiosity with strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

- Attentive to details. Proven ability to evaluate accuracy and validity of data.

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships of collaboration and trust. Viewed as a subject matter expert and go- to resource.

- Ability to independently manage projects, perform effective follow through and define work plans, and business rules. Ability to document administrative methods and procedures.

- Self-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Flexible and adaptable to change.

Additional Information
a. Analyze performance of our distribution channels and look for opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of the various channels and support sales leadership in identification of potential shifts in strategy. Work with business stakeholders to gain a holistic view of the internal and external sales channels as an input to recommendations. Identify data critical to monitoring performance of our product teams and support the team in how various initiatives deliver value to our customers and provide data that supports prioritization.

b. Apply distribution channel knowledge and expertise to influence and collaborate with stakeholders on execution and maintenance of sales strategies and reporting objectives to meet critical business requirements.

c. Perform the evaluation, administration, and implementation of sales incentive plans, including performance/goals metrics, design, consulting and communication. Turn marketing data into meaningful action.

Wellmark is seeking a hands-on Marketing Data Analyst to advance how we collect, connect, govern, and use marketing data. You’ll collaborate with teams to develop measurement, learning, and testing plans; support shared KPI definitions and data governance; map fields and validate inputs as new data sources are integrated; build results PowerPoint decks; and deliver timely analysis that helps marketing and corporate communications teams interpret the data. jobs.title: Digital Analytics Expert
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

O nás: WPP Media, líder v oblasti digitálnej komunikácie a marketingových technológií, hľadá skúseného a strategicky mysliaceho Digital Analytics Expert/Expertku pre náš tím Data, Technology & Analytics. Ak si pripravený/á prevziať zodpovednosť za najkomplexnejšie analytické projekty pre klientov, byť kľúčovým expertom v oblasti webovej a aplikačnej analytiky a aktívne sa podieľať na posúvaní hraníc dátovo-orientovaného rozhodovania, si ideálny/a kandidát/ka. Hľadáme niekoho s výraznými technickými schopnosťami a "hands-on" prístupom, kto dokáže previesť komplexné dáta do konkrétnych klientskych stratégií.

Účel pozície: Ako Digital Analytics Expert budeš kľúčovým expertom na pokročilú digitálnu analytiku, ktorý hlboko rozumie správaniu používateľov na webových stránkach. Tvoja hlavná úloha bude spočívať v hĺbkovej analýze dát, identifikácii kľúčových insightov a preklade komplexných zistení do akčných strategických odporúčaní pre našich klientov. Budeš aktívne pracovať s dátami, navrhovať optimalizácie, a úzko spolupracovať s internými tímami, pričom sa zameriaš na maximálnu pridanú hodnotu pre klientov WPP Media.

Čo budeš robiť:

- Pokročilá Webová a Aplikačná Analytika (Hands-on): Expertná práca s platformami ako GA4 (príp. Adobe Analytics a Firebase). Hĺbková analýza dát o správaní používateľov na webových stránkach, diagnostická analýza, segmentácia a vyhodnocovanie výsledkov.

- Komplexné analytické a implementačné audity: Vykonávanie hĺbkových revízií existujúcich nastavení GA4, GTM a dátových vrstiev (dataLayer). Auditovanie a optimalizácia merania konverzií naprieč kľúčovými reklamnými systémami (Google Ads, Meta a pod.) pre zabezpečenie maximálnej dátovej presnosti a výkonu kampaní.

- Generovanie strategických Insightov: Identifikácia kľúčových dátových insightov a trendov. Preklad komplexných analytických zistení do jasných, akčných strategických odporúčaní pre optimalizáciu digitálnych stratégií a kampaní klientov.

- Analytické Projektové Vedenie: Samostatné riadenie a doručovanie komplexných analytických projektov pre klientov, od počiatočnej definície biznisových potrieb až po prezentáciu výsledkov a odporúčaní.

- Optimalizácia Merania a Implementácie: Návrh a implementácia pokročilých meracích plánov a udalostí prostredníctvom Google Tag Manager (vrátane server-side taggingu) pre web a aplikácie, zabezpečujúc súlad s legislatívou (napr. Consent Mode v2).

- Spolupráca s Internými Tímami: Podpora a komunikácia s mediálnymi plánovačmi, stratégmi a klientskymi tímami pri definovaní budúcich stratégií a kampaní. Úzka spoluprácas našimi Data, Reporting & Automation Specialistami.

- Reporting & Vizualizácia: Prezentácia výsledkov a odporúčaní klientom a interným tímom. Návrh a nastavenie automatizovaných reportov v nástrojoch ako Looker Studio alebo Power BI na tvorbu zrozumiteľných a vizuálne atraktívnych prehľadov.

- Kontinuálne Vzdelávanie a Inovácie: Aktívne sledovanie trendov, štúdium nových nástrojov a metodík v oblasti digitálnej dátovej analytiky. Prototypovanie nových analytických prístupov. Mentoring a vzdelávanie kolegov v oblastiach digitálnej analytiky.

Ak si skúsený/á analytik/analytička s vášňou pre "hands-on" prácu s dátami, webovú a aplikačnú analytiku a máš drive pre tvorbu akčných klientskych stratégií, radi ťa spoznáme!

Zamestnanecké výhody, benefity

Čo ti ponúkame:

- Príležitosť pracovať na najkomplexnejších analytických projektoch pre špičkových klientov.

- Pracovné prostredie, ktoré podporuje experimentovanie, inováciu a neustály rozvoj technických a strategických zručností.

- Úzku spoluprácu s tímom expertov a priamu spätnú väzbu na tvoje analytické stratégie.

- Kariérny rozvoj s možnosťou hlbokej špecializácie a expertného vplyvu.

- Flexibilný pracovný čas a 1 deň home office týždenne.

- Benefit balík v hodnote až 1 000 € ročne – Multisport, zdravotná starostlivosť, jazykové kurzy, cestovanie alebo kultúra.

- 5 sick days ročne.

- Moderné kancelárie v centre Bratislavy – káva, ovocie a nápoje každý deň.

- Pravidelné teambuildingy, firemné akcie a dobrovoľnícke aktivity.

- Notebook a mobilný telefón s paušálom.

Čo od teba očakávame:

Skúsenosti a znalosti:

- Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľných "hands-on" skúseností v oblasti digitálnej a webovej analytiky.

- Výborné komunikačné schopnosti v slovenčine a angličtine (slovom aj písmom).

- Expertná a praktická znalosť Google Analytics 4 (GA4) a Google Tag Manager (GTM) pre web, vrátane pokročilých nastavení a troubleshootingu.

- Praktická skúsenosť s vizualizačnými nástrojmi ako Looker Studio alebo Power BI pre tvorbu a interpretáciu komplexných reportov.

- Aktívna skúsenosť s auditovaním tracking architektúry, odhaľovaním anomálií v dátach a prepájaním webovej analytiky s ekosystémom platforiem pre digitálny marketing (Ads, sociálne siete).

- Prehľad v oblasti server-side taggingu (ssGTM a pod.).

- Znalosť problematiky Consent Mode v2.

- Dobrá znalosť MS Excel / Google Sheets pre pokročilé analýzy.

Výhodou (nie podmienkou):

- Znalosť a praktická skúsenosť s Adobe Analytics a Adobe Data Collection.

- Skúsenosť s aplikačnou analytikou (napr. Firebase).

- Základná znalosť SQL pre dopytovanie dát.

Všeobecné kompetencie:

- Výnimočné analytické, kritické a "out of box" myslenie s výraznou orientáciou na detaily.

- Schopnosť prekladať komplexné dáta do jasných biznisových insightov a akčných odporúčaní.

- Silné prezentačné a komunikačné zručnosti, schopnosť "data storytellingu" a vedenia strategických diskusií.

- Proaktívny a samostatný prístup s orientáciou na výsledok a klientov.

jobs.title: Associate Technical Product Analyst (Tech Management Team)
jobs.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Team: Our team - Technology Management - is part of a larger Project Management Organization (PMO) that supports enterprise infrastructure initiatives across multiple U.S. locations, including Denver, California, Austin, and Ashburn. This role will work with a team of experienced Project Managers while collaborating with a broader network of approximately 20 project and program managers across the organization.

The team partners with a diverse group of technical specialists responsible for all aspects of infrastructure, including solution design, compute, network, security, cloud, storage, and data center services. Projects range from infrastructure modernization and cloud initiatives to data center and platform-related efforts, providing broad exposure to project management practices, technology operations, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a motivated, energetic, and passionate Project Manager who excels with complex challenges and is a natural problem solver. As a Visa Project Manager, you will be an integral part of a diverse, cross-functional team managing the execution of a wide variety of technical solutions. While ensuring the success of critical infrastructure projects, your ability to collaborate and work with a talented team of experienced engineers will shape Visa’s operations globally.

The Work itself:

- Collaborate across a diverse team of technical experts to ensure solutions are implemented on schedule

- Develop and execute timelines and budgets aligned with Visa’s operating guidelines

- Troubleshoot coordination challenges and implement creative solutions to complex problems

- Leverage modern technologies and project management tools to streamline project execution

- Lead and actively contribute to planning meetings, executive updates, and technical exchange meetings

The Skills You Bring:

- Energy and Drive: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technologies and enjoys challenging projects on a global scale

- Challenge the Status Quo: Comfort in pushing boundaries and the drive to manage projects beyond just tracking their completion

- Learner: Constant drive to learn new technologies and architectures such as Hadoop, various databases, mainframes, cloud strategies, and networking technologies

- Partnership: The ability to work well with multiple organizations simultaneously and identify solutions that meet the needs of all stakeholders

- Organization: Prepared to actively manage multiple projects and tasks, each with varying scopes and stakeholders and ensure the details are accounted for in a final solution

- We do not expect that any single candidate would fulfill all of these characteristics. For instance, we have awesome team members who are really focused on building scalable systems but didn’t work with payments technology or web applications before joining Visa.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience

- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. In particular, a demonstrated ability to effectively communicate technical and business issues and solutions to multiple organizational levels internally and externally as needed

- Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project)

- Interest in Technology and Infrastructure-related project management work

Preferred Qualifications:

- Concentration or academic focus in Computer Science, Information Technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, business coursework is a plus

- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to think strategically

- Independent judgement and mature decision-making skills to lead technology office projects that often have enterprise-wide scope and may have significant cost and time-to-market impacts

- Strong process orientation and a solid understanding of project management techniques, methodologies, and best practices

Information for US Applicants
For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $79,800.00 to $ 124,100.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics
jobs.description:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description: Analyst - Blockchain Technology & Analytics

Visa’s Stablecoin team is building cutting-edge onchain infrastructure to change the way money moves. While onchain solutions began as niche and speculative, they are now transforming how value moves across the global financial ecosystem.

Visa is at the forefront of this transition. We are rapidly expanding our stablecoin and tokenized money infrastructure to enhance our network and develop solutions for partners around the world. Visa brings trust, scale, and security to the evolving onchain ecosystem, creating the opportunity for generational impact in payments and beyond.

Role Summary

We are looking for a technically curious and highly motivated Blockchain Technology & Analytics Analyst to support the evaluation, monitoring, and implementation of blockchain and digital asset technologies.

This role combines blockchain data analytics, AI-assisted development and research, technical due diligence, and project execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable working hands-on with blockchain data and infrastructure while also being able to translate technical concepts into clear insights and presentations for business, product, technology, and client stakeholders.

The candidate does not need to be a blockchain expert on day one, but should have a strong technical foundation, curiosity about emerging technologies, and the ability to rapidly learn new platforms and tools using AI-assisted development and research.

A successful candidate will be someone who can take a relatively open-ended question such as "How is this validator performing?", "How does this blockchain network work?", or "Should we evaluate this technology provider?" and independently turn it into a structured technical investigation.

They will be comfortable using AI tools, data, APIs, documentation, and hands-on experimentation to quickly develop an informed point of view, and then communicate the findings clearly to stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Blockchain Technology Research

- Develop a working understanding of Ethereum and EVM-compatible blockchains, including transactions, smart contracts, validators, nodes, RPC interfaces, and common infrastructure components.

- Develop familiarity with blockchain ecosystems outside EVM, particularly Solana and Canton.

- Use AI-driven research and analysis to evaluate the technical architecture, APIs, integration models, security considerations, and capabilities of blockchain and digital asset technology providers.

- Conduct technical evaluations of platforms and providers such as Fireblocks, Turnkey, Zerohash, Chainalysis, Notabene, and other emerging blockchain infrastructure and compliance solutions.

- Compare technology providers and clearly document capabilities, architectural tradeoffs, integration considerations, and potential use cases.

Prototyping & Technical Experimentation

- Assist with the development and deployment of proofs of concept (POCs) for blockchain and digital asset use cases.

- Deploy and test applications, blockchain infrastructure, APIs, and supporting components on AWS and virtual machines.

- Work with engineering and product teams to evaluate new blockchain technologies through hands-on experimentation.

- Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate prototyping, troubleshooting, documentation, and technology evaluation.

Blockchain Analytics & Validator Monitoring

- Use Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools to rapidly build dashboards, scripts, and analytical tools for monitoring blockchain infrastructure and validator performance.

- Develop dashboards and analytics covering metrics such as validator fees and rewards, transaction volumes, transaction counts, aggregate transaction value, and other network performance indicators.

- Use Allium, SQL, and blockchain datasets to conduct on-chain data analysis and answer product, technical, and business questions.

- Write and troubleshoot JSON-RPC queries against blockchain nodes and RPC endpoints to retrieve blockchain, transaction, validator, and network information.

- Analyze blockchain data to identify trends, anomalies, and insights relevant to product development and infrastructure operations.

Technical Communication & Stakeholder Engagement

- Translate complex blockchain concepts into clear explanations for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Create executive-ready presentations, architecture diagrams, technical assessments, and recommendations for stakeholders across Visa.

- Present findings from technology evaluations, blockchain analytics, and POCs to product, engineering, security, and business teams.

- Support client engagements by contributing to technical discovery and due diligence, researching client technology requirements, and evaluating potential integration approaches.

Project & Process Management

- Coordinate cross-functional activities required to advance blockchain technology initiatives from evaluation through POC.

- Project manage internal Visa processes associated with new technologies, including Security Assessments and other technology review processes.

- Track dependencies, risks, decisions, action items, and approvals across technical and business stakeholders.

- Work with internal teams, external technology providers, and clients to move technical evaluations and POCs forward.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor’s degree, OR 5+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- Basic understanding of Ethereum, EVM-compatible blockchains, smart contracts, transactions, wallets, nodes, and blockchain validators.

- Familiarity with blockchain ecosystems such as Solana and/or Canton.

- Experience writing SQL queries and analyzing structured datasets.

- Ability to work with REST APIs and JSON-RPC interfaces.

- Familiarity with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another scripting/programming language.

- Experience or strong interest in using AI coding and research tools to accelerate technical work.

- Basic familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, Linux, and virtual machines.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple technical workstreams simultaneously.

- Hands-on experience querying blockchain data using Allium or similar blockchain analytics platforms.

- Experience interacting directly with Ethereum or other blockchain nodes through JSON-RPC.

- Exposure to blockchain infrastructure, custody, wallet, compliance, or analytics platforms.

- Experience building dashboards or data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Grafana, Tableau, or similar platforms.

- Familiarity with AWS services, Docker, Git, and other development tools.

- Experience conducting technical vendor evaluations or technology due diligence.

- Experience developing prototypes or POCs involving APIs, cloud infrastructure, or emerging technologies.

- Interest in digital assets, stablecoins, tokenization, blockchain infrastructure, payments, or distributed ledger technologies.

Information for US Applicants
For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $131,900.00 to $ 204,000.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Work Hours

Varies upon the needs of the department.

Travel Requirements

This position requires travel 5-10% of the time.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

jobs.title: Business and Data Analyst [U.S. Citizenship Required, Public Trust Suitability]
jobs.description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Role: Business and Data Analyst
Location: Remote; work must be performed within the United States. Preference for candidates located in the following states: CA, CO, DC, GA, FL, IL, MS, NC, NY, OH, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, and VT.
Type: Full-Time, W-2
Compensation: $90,000 annually
Experience: 3–5 years of relevant professional experience; Salesforce platform experience required

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to federal contract requirements supporting Department of Homeland Security (DHS) agency programs, applicants must:

- Be a U.S. Citizen.

- Currently reside within the United States.

- Have lived within the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.

- Be eligible to obtain and maintain the required U.S. government Public Trust suitability determination.

- Successfully complete the required background investigation, including a credit check, before beginning work.

Your Route Into Business Analysis

Welcome to Via Logic, where innovation meets collaboration. We are seeking a Business and Data Analyst with 3–5 years of relevant professional experience and hands-on Salesforce platform experience to support our federal government client. In this role, you’ll connect program needs with technical delivery, helping teams understand business processes, define requirements, and improve applications and workflows. You’ll work closely with stakeholders, developers, Quality Engineers, and other technical team members to translate complex needs into clear, actionable requirements and reliable solutions. Our work supports public assistance, recovery support, grants management, and mitigation-related processes. Experience supporting these programs or working with state and local governments is preferred. This is a great opportunity for an analyst who enjoys understanding how programs operate, asking thoughtful questions, and helping teams deliver technology that makes complex work easier.

Your Mission Today

Your Responsibilities

- Requirements Gathering: Facilitate stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and working meetings to identify business needs, clarify priorities, and define project scope.

- Business Process Analysis: Document current workflows, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and develop future-state processes that improve program operations and the user experience.

- Salesforce Business Analysis: Analyze business needs within Salesforce-based applications, document workflow and data requirements, and collaborate with Salesforce administrators and developers to evaluate and refine solutions.

- Program & Grants Workflows: Translate public assistance, recovery support, grants management, and mitigation-related business processes into clear requirements that support application development and enhancements.

- User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Develop and refine epics, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria that give development and testing teams a shared understanding of expected functionality.

- Technical Liaison: Serve as a bridge between business and technical teams, explaining program needs, resolving questions, and helping ensure solutions meet stakeholder expectations.

- Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze application and program data, clarify reporting needs, identify inconsistencies, and help teams define useful reports and dashboards.

- Testing & Validation: Partner with Quality Engineering and business users to validate requirements, support user acceptance testing, document defects, and confirm that delivered functionality meets business needs.

- Documentation & Traceability: Maintain business requirements, process flows, data mappings, decision records, and other documentation that connects stakeholder needs to delivered functionality.

- Agile Collaboration: Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and other Agile activities. Coordinate with analysts and technical teams to support consistent functionality across products.

What Helps Explorers Succeed Here

Required Skills & Experience

- Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in any field of study.

- Experience: 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in business analysis, systems analysis, business process improvement, or a closely related discipline.

- Salesforce Platform: Hands-on professional experience working with Salesforce-based applications, including analyzing or supporting business workflows, data, reporting, or application enhancements.

- Requirements Development: Experience gathering and documenting business and functional requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

- Process Analysis: Experience documenting current-state and future-state workflows, identifying gaps, and recommending practical process improvements.

- Stakeholder Engagement: Experience facilitating discussions with business users and technical teams, asking clarifying questions, and building a shared understanding of priorities and requirements.

- Technical Collaboration: Ability to translate business needs into requirements that developers, Salesforce administrators, and Quality Engineers can implement and validate.

- Data Analysis: Experience reviewing data, identifying inconsistencies, and defining reporting or dashboard requirements to support business decisions.

- Testing & Validation: Experience supporting user acceptance testing, reviewing application behavior against requirements, and tracking issues through resolution.

- Agile: Experience working within an Agile delivery environment using Scrum, SAFe, or similar methodologies.

- Communication & Organization: Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain clear documentation.

Preferred Experience

- Experience supporting public assistance, recovery support, grants management, or mitigation programs.

- Experience working with state and local governments, including agencies administering public-sector assistance or grant programs.

- Familiarity with grant application, review, award, monitoring, reporting, or closeout workflows.

- Experience analyzing Salesforce workflows, reports, dashboards, permissions, or integrations.

- Experience with SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable data analysis and reporting tools.

- Experience supporting cloud-based applications or modernization initiatives.

- Previous federal government experience, particularly supporting DHS.

- Current or previous favorable U.S. government Public Trust determination.

Certifications

No certifications are required. Salesforce, business analysis, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications are a plus.

Why Explorers Stay

- Remote-first flexibility within the U.S.

- Comprehensive healthcare benefits.

- Generous Paid Time Off (PTO).

- Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on growth and continuous learning.

- Opportunities to deepen your expertise in business analysis, Salesforce, and program modernization.

- Meaningful work supporting mission-driven programs with real-world impact.

How We Work

- This is a client-facing role that includes virtual collaboration and occasional customer interaction.

- Team members are expected to actively engage through Slack, Teams, email, Monday.com, and other company or client-provided collaboration tools.

- Availability for meetings and collaboration during Eastern Time work hours is expected.

- Cameras on during virtual meetings is part of our collaborative culture.

- This is a full-time W-2 position.

- Work must be performed within the United States.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges - not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

jobs.title: Business Operations and Talent Specialist
jobs.description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Duration: Full-time, W-2 position
Salary: $55,000–$90,000 annually. Compensation will be determined based on the depth and relevance of experience, technical recruiting capabilities, government contracting knowledge, business operations expertise, and the scope of responsibilities the selected candidate is prepared to take on.
Experience Required: 2+ years of relevant experience in recruiting, business operations, human resources, finance administration, or related business support. Candidates with additional experience are encouraged to apply.
Location: Arlington, VA/Washington, DC metropolitan area. Candidates must reside within reasonable commuting distance of Arlington, VA. This position requires in-person participation at our Arlington-area coworking space, leadership and team meetings, company events, and other business activities as needed. Onsite requirements will vary based on business needs and may include recurring coworking days, scheduled meetings, and requests for in-person support with limited notice.
Eligibility: U.S. citizenship is required due to the federal government programs Via Logic supports. Candidates must be able to successfully complete applicable background and suitability requirements before beginning work.

Your Adventure Begins Here

Via Logic is looking for a Business Operations and Talent Specialist to help grow our team of Explorers and support the people, programs, and day-to-day operations that keep our business moving forward. We're a growing government contracting company, and like many small businesses, our responsibilities don't always fit neatly into one department. One day, you might be sourcing candidates for a software engineering opportunity. The next, you could be helping coordinate employee onboarding, preparing customer invoices, researching a federal contracting opportunity, or organizing documentation for an upcoming proposal.

That's part of the adventure!

This position brings together talent acquisition, business operations, and company growth support. You'll work closely with leadership and teammates across the business, helping ensure our recruiting efforts, internal processes, and operational priorities stay organized and on track. And here's the thing: you don't need to be an expert in every area to be successful here. We know recruiting, finance, contracts, and business operations each come with their own learning curves. What matters is that you bring a solid foundation in one or more of these areas, along with the curiosity, resourcefulness, and willingness to jump in and learn something new. Whether you're an early-career professional ready to broaden your skills or someone with more experience who enjoys wearing multiple hats, we're looking for an Explorer who's excited to grow with us, contribute wherever they can make a difference, and help shape what's next for Via Logic.

Your Mission

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting

- Support full-cycle recruiting activities, including sourcing, candidate outreach, initial screenings, interview coordination, offers, and onboarding handoffs.

- Build and maintain candidate pipelines for software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, business operations, and other positions supporting federal government programs.

- Conduct introductory conversations to assess candidates' relevant experience, interests, compensation expectations, availability, and alignment with position requirements.

- Coordinate technical assessments, interviews, candidate follow-ups, and next steps with leadership, technical interviewers, and external partners.

- Maintain accurate candidate records, recruiting pipelines, interview notes, and follow-up activities in Greenhouse.

- Prepare candidate summaries, format resumes, and coordinate documentation for partner submissions and proposal staffing needs.

- Help create a positive, personable candidate experience that reflects Via Logic's values and culture.

Business Operations & Program Support

- Support daily business operations, administrative coordination, and follow-through on internal priorities.

- Assist with employee onboarding, offboarding, People Operations activities, and internal communications.

- Help coordinate employee timekeeping, review submissions for completeness, and follow up on missing or outstanding information.

- Support program delivery administration, including employee coordination, performance tracking, customer documentation, and operational reporting.

- Maintain organized documents, trackers, schedules, and repeatable workflows that help our team work efficiently.

- Provide in-person business and administrative support at our Arlington-area coworking space, including meeting preparation, team coordination, events, and other operational needs.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce repetitive work, and strengthen communication across the business.

Finance & Contracts Administration

- Assist with preparing, organizing, and tracking customer invoices and supporting documentation.

- Help coordinate expense reimbursements, vendor bills, payment records, and other routine financial administration.

- Maintain accurate records and follow up on outstanding documentation or approvals.

- Support contracts administration by organizing teaming agreements, nondisclosure agreements (NDAs), subcontractor documentation, and other business records.

- Assist with tracking contract-related deadlines, outstanding action items, and required documentation.

- Coordinate with leadership and external partners to help ensure financial and contractual information is organized, accurate, and accessible.

Business Development & Growth Support

- Research federal contracting opportunities and summarize their scope, requirements, deadlines, and potential alignment with Via Logic's capabilities.

- Review Requests for Information (RFIs), Sources Sought notices, and solicitations to identify response requirements and next steps.

- Assist with drafting and coordinating RFI and Sources Sought responses, gathering input and supporting materials as needed.

- Maintain opportunity trackers and follow up on deadlines, assigned tasks, and outstanding information.

- Gather and organize company capabilities, past performance, resumes, and other materials for partner requests and proposal submissions.

- Support proposal drafting, editing, formatting, and submission preparation, checking materials for accuracy and completeness.

- Help coordinate communication and follow-through with internal stakeholders and external business partners.

Technology & Adaptability

- Learn and use recruiting, finance, timekeeping, document management, and project tracking systems.

- Use AI tools thoughtfully to support research, communication, organization, and process improvement while applying your own judgment.

- Identify practical ways to improve workflows and reduce unnecessary administrative work.

- Adapt to evolving business needs, shifting priorities, and opportunities to take on new responsibilities.

What You Bring to the Expedition

Required

- 2+ years of relevant professional experience in recruiting, business operations, HR, finance administration, or related business support.

- Experience coordinating multiple tasks, projects, or priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Via Logic professionally to candidates, employees, and business partners.

- Experience using business applications, shared documents, spreadsheets, and online collaboration tools.

- Strong organization, follow-through, and the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

- Comfort learning new technology, including AI tools, and applying sound judgment when using them.

- Ability to work independently, ask thoughtful questions, and collaborate closely with a small team.

- A resourceful, adaptable mindset and a willingness to contribute across different business functions.

- Ability to handle confidential employee, candidate, financial, and business information appropriately.

- Residence within reasonable commuting distance of Arlington, VA, with availability for in-person coworking, meetings, events, and business support, including occasional short-notice requests.

Preferred

- Hands-on recruiting experience, including sourcing, candidate screening, interview coordination, or applicant tracking.

- Technical recruiting experience involving software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, or other specialized IT positions.

- Familiarity with federal government contracting, cleared recruiting, citizenship requirements, background investigations, or suitability considerations.

- Experience with Greenhouse or another applicant tracking system.

- Exposure to business operations activities such as timekeeping, invoicing, expense reimbursements, vendor coordination, or employee administration.

- Familiarity with government business development, RFIs, Sources Sought notices, proposal coordination, or opportunity research.

- Experience supporting contracts-related documentation, including NDAs, teaming agreements, or subcontractor paperwork.

- Experience supporting a small business, startup, or growing organization where responsibilities span multiple functions.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace and project management or workflow tools.

- Bachelor's degree in business administration, human resources, communications, or a related field.

Why Explorers Stay

- Healthcare coverage and paid time off that support life outside work.

- Direct collaboration with leadership and visibility into how a growing federal contractor operates.

- Opportunities to develop experience across recruiting, People Operations, finance, contracts, business development, and program delivery.

- Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help one another grow.

- Room to contribute ideas, take ownership of responsibilities, and improve how work gets done.

- A people-focused culture where we recognize milestones, celebrate contributions, and support our Explorers throughout their journey.

How We Work

We're a small team with shared goals and responsibilities that sometimes cross functions. While you'll have recurring priorities, business needs may occasionally call for support in areas outside your usual day-to-day work.We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and early updates when something needs attention. You'll participate in regular team check-ins, keep your work visible, and help move priorities forward. We also recognize that no one knows everything. We appreciate people who are comfortable asking questions, learning from teammates, and taking initiative when something needs to get done. In-person collaboration is an important part of this role. You'll spend time at our Arlington-area coworking space, participate in leadership and team meetings, support company events, and help coordinate business activities that require an onsite presence. The frequency of these activities will vary, and flexibility to accommodate both planned and short-notice requests is essential. Above all, we're looking for someone who enjoys being part of a team, takes pride in helping others succeed, and wants to contribute to the continued growth of Via Logic.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges—not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.
