jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
COMPANY

Pace helps leading insurers run complex operations through AI agents and expert human review. Financial institutions spend nearly $400 billion annually on outsourced work. We’re building technology to transform those operations alongside some of the largest insurers in the world.


ROLE

We’re looking for a Business Operations generalist to help build the systems and processes behind Pace’s next stage of growth.

You’ll work directly across finance, hiring, internal operations, and special projects. You might build a financial model to inform an investment decision, improve how we hire and onboard, or take a new business initiative from an open question to execution.

Your scope will evolve with the company. We’re looking for someone who can identify what matters, bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and take responsibility for getting the work done.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build financial discipline: Support budgeting and forecasting, track spending and runway, manage invoicing and vendor payments, and coordinate with external accounting partners.

 - Drive special projects: Research new opportunities, develop business cases, and lead initiatives across teams with clear decisions, owners, and timelines.

 - Support company planning: Track business performance, prepare leadership and investor materials, and help translate company priorities into plans teams can execute.

 - Help grow the team: Partner with hiring managers on recruiting processes, candidate experience, and onboarding.

 - Improve internal operations: Manage vendors, tools, and administrative workflows, coordinating with legal and other external partners where needed.

 - Build with AI: Automate repetitive work and turn useful experiments into reliable tools and processes.


YOUR BACKGROUND

 - Experience in startup operations, consulting, finance, or another role requiring analytical thinking and independent execution.

 - Confidence working with financial models, spreadsheets, and business data, and explaining what the numbers mean.

 - Evidence of taking an ambiguous problem through to a practical result.

 - Clear writing, strong organization, and good judgment when handling sensitive information.

 - Willingness to move between planning and detailed execution, from evaluating a business opportunity to resolving an invoice.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building internal processes at a growing technology company.

 - Exposure to financial planning, recruiting operations, or board reporting.

 - Experience creating automations or internal tools.


TEAM CHARACTERISTICS

Integrity: We value thoughtful people who earn trust, keep their commitments, and care about the quality of their work.

Ambition: Our goal is a $100bn+ business spanning vertical services. We want teammates who bring equally serious ambitions to their own development, whether as expert practitioners, leaders, or future founders.


TRAJECTORY

This role offers exposure to how the entire company operates. As you build expertise and deliver results, potential paths include leading Business Operations, taking ownership of a function, or helping run a business line.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity ownership

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Unlimited paid time off

jobs.title: Operations Analytics Specialist, Entry
jobs.description:
As a Manufacturing Data Analyst (Operations Analytics Specialist, Entry), you will collaborate with multiple departments, including operations planning, process engineering, and quality, to enhance our manufacturing operations by harnessing the power of data. Reporting directly to the Manufacturing Systems Engineer you will partner with the analyst team onsite at our Delaware, Ohio Plant and help improve our operations through data-driven insights. Your primary responsibilities will revolve around ensuring data accuracy, developing Measurement (KPI) dashboards, and supporting teams with data requests for engineering projects and cause investigations.

Key Responsibilities

- Maintain the accuracy of automated and manual data reporting systems.

- Develop Measurement dashboards to monitor manufacturing performance.

- Assist teams by providing data-driven insights for engineering projects and cause investigations.

- Occasionally gather data directly from the manufacturing process when existing data is unavailable or unreliable. This may involve process observation or interaction with PPG associates.

- Collaborate with the quality department to ensure data accuracy and compliance with quality standards.

Qualifications

- Proficiency in working with datasets in MS excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets).

- Basic knowledge of statistical and quantitative analyses.

- Experience with programming languages or data visualization tools, such as Tableau or MS Power BI.

- Familiarity with process controls tag historians, manufacturing ERP systems, and Lean-SixSigma tools.

- Willingness to occasionally work with manufacturing associates on the shop floor.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Previous experience in a data analysis role within a manufacturing or industrial environment.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, USCA Transportation
jobs.description:
As Data Analyst, USCA Transportation, you are responsible for supporting transportation and logistics operations through data analysis, performance measurement, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. You serve as a key analytical resource supporting logistics transformation, transportation operations, carrier management, network optimization, and continuous improvement efforts. You collaborate with stakeholders across various functions within PPG to develop actionable insights, identify improvement opportunities, and support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis. You will work out of the Corporate HQ office in Pittsburgh and report to the Associate Director, Logistics Operations & Planning.

Responsibilities

-
Analyze transportation performance, freight spend, service levels, network flows, and operational efficiency to identify trends, risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities across all transportation modes.

-
Develop, maintain, and enhance transportation dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and business intelligence tools that support operational and executive decision-making.

-
Ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and consistency across transportation systems, ERP platforms, and reporting solutions while supporting data governance and quality improvement initiatives.

-
Provide analytical support for carrier management, transportation sourcing events, bid analyses, contract reviews, and performance measurement against cost and service objectives.

-
Support transportation network optimization, route design, shipment consolidation, modeling, and other initiatives that improve service, efficiency, and total logistics cost.

-
Participate in logistics transformation projects and digital solution initiatives by supporting system implementation, testing, validation, adoption, continuous improvement, and project execution activities.

-
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Finance, IT, and Commercial teams to communicate insights, present recommendations, drive process improvements, and measure realized business benefits.

Requirements

-
BS/BA degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

-
(3+) years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical roles.

-
Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.

-
Experience working with Transportation Management Systems (OTM, SAP TM, Blue Yonder, or equivalent).

-
Knowledge of SQL, database reporting tools, and data analytics methodologies.

-
Understanding of transportation operations, freight management, and supply chain processes.

-
Experience with logistics network modeling and transportation optimization tools is preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Customer Operations Analyst, you will support customer engagement and delivery recovery at our Huntsville, AL site. In this role, you will partner closely with customers and cross-functional PPG teams to track production progress, communicate delivery status, and provide accurate, timely reporting to support customer commitments.

This position is fully onsite in Huntsville, AL, and offers a mix of shop-floor collaboration, data analysis, reporting, and customer communication. You will report to the Customer Engagement Leader.

Key Responsibilities

- Support customer recovery plans by hosting customers that have approved scheduled visits to discuss part status

- Lead customer meetings that discuss part movement, WIP position, shipping status, and actual performance versus commitment

- Provide daily, weekly, or monthly data to platform or customers to support recovery efforts

- Partner with production supervisors, planners, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, Account Management, and other internal teams to gather and validate part status information

- Spend approximately 50% of your time on the production floor gathering updates and verifying part status, with the remaining time focused on reporting, data analysis, and customer communication

- Utilize available reporting tools and systems to track production progress and provide daily, weekly, or monthly updates to customers and internal stakeholders

- Provide support for customer engagement and marketing activities as needed

Qualification

- Bachelor's Degree preferred but will consider experience in a similar field in lieu of degree

- 2 years + of experience in marketing, data analytics, business analytics, or a related field

- Strong proficiency in Excel and experience analyzing data, developing reports, and translating insights into actionable recommendations

- Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment and spending approximately half of the workday on the production floor

- Only U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, and political asylees or refugees are eligible to apply

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst II
jobs.description:
ABOUT POET

At POET, it is our mission to be good stewards of the Earth by converting renewable resources to energy and other valuable goods as effectively as humanly possible. For over thirty-five years, our drive and passion to change the world has enabled us to become the largest producer and marketer of bioethanol and a leader in sustainable products in the world.

CULTURE IS KING AT POET

We’re all on the same team. We always communicate. And we park our egos at the door. These aren’t just slogans on our walls. It’s the way we do things at POET. We provide an environment for team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance. It’s the best way to optimize health, wellness, and productivity in a sustainable way. We work hard. We play hard. We have frequent team events, volunteer efforts, and we know how to celebrate wins!

JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES

The IT Business Analyst II acts as the primary IT contact for all POET companies and plays a vital role in the planning and execution of information management system initiatives related to this area of the company’s operations. This person is responsible for evaluating existing processes in both the business and IT space, determining how they relate to a common delivery practice.

This is an on-site role located in Sioux Falls, SD. Responsibilities include:

-
Research, design, test and document processes and systems for the enhancement, development and maintenance of business and systems operations.

-
Identify the sources of requirements and understand stakeholder roles.

-
Prepare business ROI and manage projects to meet the stated ROI.

-
Assist in supporting of applications after implementation by providing daily support, training, designing reports and other support tasks.

-
Help to define acceptance criteria for completion of the solution.

-
Organize and lead small groups to resolve current systems conversion business problems.

-
Work with business customers to understand requirements and develop specifications for projects.

-
Create basic to moderately complex test plans using templates and guidelines.

-
Develop an understanding of how present and future business needs will impact the solution.

-
Lead small to medium sized projects.

-
Identify and document all business, technical, product and process needs/requirements.

-
Identify key business process owners to assist in application implementation.

-
Control scope and client expectations; may provide guidance to less experienced analysts.

-
Since we’re all about teamwork and getting the job done, your skills may be put to a lot of other uses!

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

-
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Technology, or Science

-
Minimum of 3 years of progressive analysis/systems experience in mid to large scale computing environment

-
Experience with Great Plains Dynamics, payroll and financial processing is a plus

-
A strong understanding of client/server, web architectures and object-oriented technologies and internet applications

-
Working knowledge of system development life cycle methodologies and Windows operating systems

-
Understanding of relational database concepts and experience with SQL queries

-
Strong project management skills

-
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new programs

A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

-
Strong customer service mindset with a value placed on relationships

-
Excellent organizational and time management skills

-
Strong communication skills – both written and verbal

-
A high level of personal integrity

-
Interpersonal skills – the ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels within/outside the organization

-
Demonstrated problem-solving and critical thinking skills

-
The ability to embrace and promote change

-
An innovative mindset

-
The ability to think objectively

-
Self-awareness in the face of uncertainty

-
The ability to work in a team environment

WORK ENVIRONMENT

-
Some travel, to include overnights, may be required for this position.

-
This position operates in an office environment, working at a personal computer where you may sit or stand. Most of our Sioux Falls office workspace consists of an open-concept design intended to promote open communication and collaboration.

GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

At POET, we encourage internal development and growth by allowing team members to carve their own path to success. jobs.title: Trading Operations Analyst (Asia Market Hours)
jobs.description:
PDT Partners – a quantitative investment manager – is seeking a sharp, independent analyst to join our Technical and Trading Operations team, covering Asian markets (5:30 pm - 2:30 am ET).

The Technical and Trading Operations team manages our production plant and runs our global real-time algorithmic trading around the clock from New York City. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the center of a leading quantitative trading firm, with exposure to many parts of the business and a crucial role in helping them fit together.

You will work collaboratively with fellow team members, as well as technologists, risk managers, and portfolio managers to oversee both our trading and technology and respond to alerts and other signs of irregular activity.

You should thrive on the sense of urgency and quick problem-solving required in such an environment, as you will guide our systems through pre-market activities, real-time trade execution, and post-session processing.  You should also be relentless in driving continual improvement in our processes and tools, making us more efficient and resilient. You will also build tools and automation to improve PDT’s operational capabilities.

This is a hybrid position and will require the person to work from our New York City office 1 day a week.

Why join us?

PDT Partners has a stellar 30+ year track record and a reputation for excellence. Our goal is to be the best quantitative investment manager in the world—measured by the quality of our products, not their size.  PDT’s very high employee-retention rate speaks for itself.  Our people are intellectually extraordinary, and our community is close-knit, down-to-earth, and diverse.

Responsibilities

- Monitor our trading and portfolios to ensure they adhere to risk and trading limits.

- Monitor and guide the successful execution of algorithmic trading, rolls, and hedging.

- Triage outages and order problems - work with internal and external groups if necessary.

- Provide market and trading analysis, proactively investigate new opportunities and provide recommendations.

- Prepare for and respond to market events, corporate actions, and regulatory changes.

- Help manage the deployment of new strategies and models.

- Help design and develop internal tools, dashboards, and automation.

- Support post-trade activities to aid effective clearing and accurate record-keeping.

Below is a list of skills and experiences we think are relevant. Even if you don’t think you’re a perfect match, we still encourage you to apply because we are committed to developing our people.

- 3-10 years of relevant professional experience.

- Exposure to and/or passionate interest in financial markets, asset classes, market structure, industry news, and related systems

- Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, particularly in fast paced, high-pressure environments.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Experience with a variety of technical competencies is desirable, which may include one or more of the following: Python, Flask, Java, C#, SQL, UNIX/Linux, networking, cloud technologies, scheduling/orchestration, etc.

The salary range for this role is between $125,000 and $225,000. This range is not inclusive of any potential bonus amounts. Factors that may impact the agreed upon salary within the range for a particular candidate include years of experience, level of education obtained, skill set, and other external factors.

PRIVACY STATEMENT: For information on ways PDT may collect, use, and process your personal information, please see PDT’s privacy notices.

jobs.title: Aftermarket Product Analyst
jobs.description:
About JLG, an Oshkosh company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

BUILD AND GROW A PRODUCT BUSINESS

The Aftermarket Product Analyst is part of the Aftermarket Product Management function and serves as the business owner for assigned product categories. Working in a Product Manager capacity, this role is responsible for developing and executing product strategies, identifying growth opportunities, managing the product lifecycle, and leading products from opportunity identification through commercialization.

jobs.title: Product Data Scientist - Youth, Families and Learning
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re looking for a product data scientist to help OpenAI create more value and drive sustainable growth for young people, families, and learners. You’ll drive product data science across under-18 audiences, emerging opportunities for children under 13, family experiences, and learning and education more broadly.

You’ll help decide where we should invest, what we should build, and how we’ll know it is working. This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

You’ll partner across Chat Product, Growth, Foundations, SafeSys, and other teams, working closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers. The role focuses and owns product value and growth while dedicated teams own policy and safety.

In this role, you will:

 - Shape strategy and prioritize opportunities. Size unmet needs and growth opportunities across audiences, use cases, and product experiences. Help teams choose where to invest and sequence work based on expected user value, reach, evidence, and effort.

 - Define what value and success mean. Develop an audience-specific measurement framework spanning activation, task success, learning progress, satisfaction, and durable retention. Connect these measures to product goals and assess whether repeat use reflects meaningful benefit.

 - Understand users and growth drivers. Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to uncover where people find value, where they struggle, and what helps them return. Combine behavioral data with surveys and user research to explain differences across ages, family roles, and learning contexts.

 - Measure what changes actually cause. Design experiments and holdouts to evaluate product and model changes. Apply causal methods when randomization is impractical, make assumptions explicit, and account for seasonality, audience composition, and effects that differ across segments.

 - Turn findings into product decisions. Work with partners from initial hypotheses through launch and iteration. Recommend what to build, change, expand, or stop, explaining expected impact, uncertainty, and tradeoffs. Follow through to determine whether decisions delivered the intended results.

 - Build reliable measurement. Partner with engineering on instrumentation, dataset quality, and consistent audience definitions. Create reusable analyses and dashboards that make progress visible and let teams answer recurring questions independently.

 - Create alignment across teams. Bring a coherent view of audience value to work spanning multiple roadmaps. Help partners agree on priorities, success criteria, and the next questions to resolve, even when ownership is distributed and evidence is incomplete.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A record of influencing product strategy and improving user outcomes through hands-on data science, including work from an ambiguous question to a decision and measurable impact.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, sound statistical judgment, and practical experience with experiments, causal inference, cohort analysis, and measurement design.

 - The ability to develop useful definitions of product value, validate imperfect proxies, and distinguish short-term metric movement from lasting improvement.

 - Clear communication and strong product judgment. You can make a recommendation, explain its limits, and influence collaborators across functions without relying on formal authority.

 - Comfort setting priorities independently across a broad scope, staying close to users, and moving between strategic questions and detailed analytical work.

Helpful experience

Experience with consumer product growth, youth or family products, learning and education, or generative AI would be valuable. We also welcome experience measuring learning outcomes, combining quantitative and qualitative research, or evaluating products whose value emerges over time.

OpenAI’s Safety teams work to ensure our products are safe, trusted, and resilient as frontier AI systems scale globally. jobs.description:
About the Team

The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/.

Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models.

The mission of the Preparedness team is to:

 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society

 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems

Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society.



About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes.

This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm).





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas).

 - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments.

 - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases.

 - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions.

 - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes.

 - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts.

 - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs.
   

You might thrive in this role if you are:

 - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end.

 - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented.

 - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements.
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability).

 - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data.

 - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows.

 - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting).

 - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners.

 - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry.

 - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale.
   Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops).

 - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required.

 - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.description:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

 - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

 - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

 - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

 - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

We are hiring a Data Scientist to help build OpenAI's B2B ecosystem and go-to-market data science capability. You will turn ambiguous commercial questions into evidence, recommendations, and operating decisions that help OpenAI understand where to focus as our B2B business expands.

OpenAI's B2B motion is growing quickly across products, customer segments, markets, and field teams. This role will partner with leaders across GTM, Revenue, Product, Finance, RevOps, Strategy, and Data Science to answer questions tied to international strategy, monetization, product penetration, field deployment, customer opportunity, and organizational design.

This is a founding-style opportunity within the broader GTM Data Science organization. The team and stakeholder model are still evolving, so you should be energized by building structure in ambiguity, helping define how the team works, and helping shape the bench around a high-priority commercial area.

The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions.

You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings.

jobs.description:
About the Team

We work across product, growth, and monetization to help people get more value from OpenAI’s products. We identify opportunities for machine learning, build and test early solutions, and partner with engineering and product to bring successful approaches into production.

About the Role

We’re looking for a data scientist who can enter an unfamiliar product area, find a useful ML application, and turn it into a working product intervention. You will own the work from problem definition and data preparation through modeling, experimentation, and launch evaluation.

Projects will include personalization, next-best-action recommendations, lifecycle management, promotion targeting, and models of retention and customer lifetime value. You will help identify opportunities, build proofs of concept, evaluate, and iterate.

In this role, you will:

 - Identify opportunities with product and business partners, define the decision a model will inform, and prioritize work by user value, feasibility, and expected impact.

 - Build datasets, features, reproducible training workflows, and models. You’ll use a combination of tools appropriate to the task at hand. 

 - Translate predictions into product actions. Design experiments and use causal reasoning to establish whether those actions improve user and business outcomes.

 - Partner with engineers on integration, serving or batch scoring, monitoring, and rollout. Stay involved through launch and iteration.

 - Explain results and limitations clearly, document decisions, and build reusable methods that other teams can adopt.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have built and evaluated applied ML systems that influenced a product or business decision, with clear ownership of the modeling work.

 - Write effective Python and SQL and can investigate imperfect data, debug models, and make pragmatic implementation choices. 

 - Build and schedule production scoring pipelines using dbt, airflow, and flyte.

 - Understand supervised learning, evaluation, experimentation, and the difference between predicting an outcome and changing it.

 - Can scope ambiguous problems, work across disciplines, and explain technical tradeoffs to colleagues with different backgrounds.

 - Are motivated by helping people use AI effectively and by learning unfamiliar product domains.

 - Are excited to take on challenging, impactful ML problems across multiple areas.

 - Have experience with recommendation systems, personalization, growth, retention, lifetime value, or treatment-effect modeling would be useful. We welcome candidates whose relevant experience comes from other domains.

TRANSPARENCY. FAIRNESS. COMPLIANCE. The Oklahoma Tax Commission is committed to leading Oklahoma with unparalleled customer service. JOB SUMMARY

The Data Analyst plays a key role in the Innovation Division, responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large data sets to support strategic business decisions. This position works closely with cross-functional teams to identify critical metrics, develop comprehensive reports, and produce clear, actionable visualizations. The Data Analyst contributes to the evaluation and enhancement of the agency’s products, processes, and overall performance, with a focus on maintaining high standards, streamlining operations, and improving customer experience. Additionally, the role supports project management and organizational assessments, helping to optimize internal structures, business processes, and IT systems.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work closely with management to prioritize business and information needs.

- Collect and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

- Work closely with business teams to present data-driven insights and recommendations.

- Develop and implement reports, dashboards, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.

- Interpret complex data and present findings in a clear and understandable way.

- Create visuals and dashboards to communicate data insights effectively.

- Identify data issues and inconsistencies and recommend solutions for improving data quality.

- Ensure compliance with data governance policies and industry regulations.

- Support decision making with data-driven insights and strategies.

- Assist in the development and automation of data analysis processes.

- Perform other job duties as assigned.

COMPLEXITY OF KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

Knowledge of

· Data processing hardware and software; of computer capabilities; of systems analysis and development; of coding and implementation; of project management and documentation.

· An in-depth understanding of organizational data flow and its use in management decision-making.

· An understanding of requirements gathering, data analysis, process specification, validation, and management practices.

· Data modeling, data mining, and segmentation techniques.

· Data visualization tools and best practices.

Skills in

· Analytical and systems thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving.

· Prioritizing, scheduling, organizing, and allocating work with competing deadlines.

· Writing for business or technical audiences, presenting information, and negotiating.

· Collecting, organizing, analyzing, and disseminating significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

· Writing SQL queries and reports and presenting findings.

· Version control and working in a team environment within GitHub.

· Data modeling in SQL and/or Python.

Ability to

· Work independently and coordinate a wide variety of activities.

· Communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

· Interpret and apply policies and procedures.

· Create charts and graphs utilizing data visualization best practices.

· Clean and transform data sets for analysis and reporting.

· Solve complex problems using statistical analysis.

· Work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of

- A bachelor’s degree in business administration, information systems, or a related field. Plus, two years of professional experience in statistical modeling and/or data analytics.

· OR an equivalent combination of education and experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- undefined

- Familiarity with Agile and Lean methodologies.

- Experience with Qlik Analytics, DBT, Snowflake or Google BigQuery.

- Experience with predictive modeling in a production environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Exhibit manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination to operate a computer, keyboard, photocopier, telephone, calculator and other office equipment. Duties are normally performed in an office environment with a moderate noise level.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ONEPAY

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

 - Ready to run

 - Hungry and driven by urgency

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

 - Comfortable operating in motion




THE ROLE

As an Analytics Engineer at OnePay, you'll own the analytics foundation (dbt models, testing, and Databricks BI) so the business can move fast on trusted data. We build for humans and AI, so you’ll use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) daily to move faster and design models, metrics, and documentation that agents and analysts can both rely on.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build production dbt models on Databricks that the organization uses as the source of truth for what’s happening in the business

 - Support external reporting with accurate, governed data that stakeholders and partners can trust

 - Own data quality: testing, CI/CD, documentation, and patterns the team follows

 - Build and evolve Databricks dashboards and semantic metrics for self-service across the business

 - Partner with Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and analytics stakeholders to turn messy business problems into durable data products

 - Drive AI-native workflows: Cursor/Claude (or equivalent) in daily development; model and doc design that works for LLM consumers

 


YOU BRING

 - 3+ years in analytics engineering or equivalent: you’ve owned production models end-to-end, not just ad hoc analysis

 - Expert SQL and deep dbt experience (architecture, incremental models, tests, macros, CI/CD)

 - Strong Databricks BI (or equivalent semantic layer) delivery

 - AI-savvy in practice: you already use AI coding tools daily, validate outputs rigorously, and design data for both humans and agents

 - Proven ability to execute in ambiguity: startup pace, incomplete specs, bias toward shipping

 - Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences

 - Owner mentality: you see what’s broken, fix it, and raise the bar for others

 


TOOLS WE USE

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.

 
 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

 - 401(k) plan with company match

 - Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact




STANDARD INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through:

 - AI-assisted initial screen

 - Interview with Talent Partner

 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

 - Team Interview

 - Executive Interview

 - Offer!




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

- Shop-floor systems ownership and integration: Support the functional operation and lifecycle of manufacturing execution systems (MES), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA), human-machine interface (HMI), machine connectivity, data collection, labeling, quality, and other plant-floor applications. - Integrations: Analyze and support interfaces between Oracle EBS and manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, banking, customer, supplier, and other enterprise platforms. Coordinate monitoring, error resolution, data reconciliation, and enhancement requirements.

- Reporting and analytics: Develop and support operational and management reporting using approved tools such as Oracle BI Publisher, Oracle Reports, SQL-based data extracts, data warehouses, and business intelligence platforms.

- Solution delivery: Create functional specifications, process flows, data mappings, test scripts, training materials, and deployment plans. Partner with technical teams and vendors through design, build, validation, release, and stabilization.

- Testing and release management: Lead or coordinate unit, system integration, regression, and user acceptance testing; document results; manage defects; and confirm business readiness.

- Operational support: Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and minor enhancements in line with service levels. Communicate impact, workarounds, progress, and resolution to stakeholders.

- Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify processes, standardize practices across sites, reduce manual work, strengthen controls, and improve system adoption and business performance.

- Knowledge management: Maintain process, configuration, support, and training documentation; contribute to knowledge articles; and provide effective knowledge transfer to users and support teams.

- Global collaboration: Work across locations, functions, cultures, and time zones while aligning divisional priorities with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and governance standards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Three or more years supporting Oracle EBS, ERP, MES, or plant-floor applications in a manufacturing environment.

- Functional knowledge of Oracle EBS manufacturing and supply-chain modules, including Inventory, Bills of Material, Work in Process, Cost Management, Quality, Order Management, or Procurement.

- Experience with manufacturing processes, shop-floor systems, and production data such as orders, routings, material, labor, inventory, cost, and quality.

- Experience supporting Oracle EBS integrations through APIs, middleware, EDI, database, or file-based interfaces.

- Ability to gather requirements, map processes, prepare specifications, coordinate testing, and support deployments with minimal production disruption.

- Working knowledge of SQL or reporting tools for troubleshooting, validation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis.

- Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Knowledge of traceability, serialization, nonconformance, product genealogy, OEE, and plant performance metrics.

- Experience with Oracle BI Publisher, Power BI, OTBI, data warehouses, or similar analytics tools.

- Familiarity with OT/IT controls, cybersecurity, data governance, change control, disaster recovery, and SOX requirements.

The Sales Operations Specialist will support and optimize core commercial operations processes across contracting, billing, and sales support functions. jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

About Us

NLG Capital, the investment management company of NLG, manages approximately $40+ billion in AUM. Our purpose is simple – to allow NLG to keep its promises. How we do this – an obsessive focus on delivering investment results. We drive results through a rigorous but collaborative investment process, and we hold ourselves to the highest of standards, both as investors and teammates. While our process is based on rigor, our culture is based on our guiding principles: Meritocracy, Uncompromising Transparency, Intellectual Honesty, Performance Driven Learning, Relentless Pursuit of Excellence. These principles serve as the foundation of our team. They govern the way we conduct ourselves, how we interact with teammates and how we approach every investment decision. We act with the integrity and humility required to make the investment decision that is right for the firm, and ultimately our policyholders. Our culture has been deliberately built to foster curiosity and provide opportunities to learn and grow, both as people and investors. The flat and collaborative nature of our team promotes an atmosphere where the best ideas are continually expressed and rewarded. Our pursuit of excellence is unwavering.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The Associate, Mortgage Analytics is responsible for residential whole loan and RMBS analytics used for trading, portfolio management, asset management, and servicing oversight. This is a hands-on role supporting a rapidly growing $5bn+ AUM residential mortgage platform spanning residential whole loans and RMBS.

The Associate works closely with analysts, traders, portfolio managers, and the Investment Committee, who rely on the role’s analytical output to drive the decision process. The successful candidate is fluent in residential mortgage risk, prepayment analytics, loan credit characteristics, and the plumbing of the mortgage market, including how loans are originated, packaged, sold, and serviced.

This is a technical role requiring fluency in Python, SQL, and a data platform such as Databricks.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days. Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Build and maintain the models used to price residential whole loans and RMBS and run their cash flows, updating assumptions as rates and borrower behavior change.

- Crack and clean bid tapes and loan-level data, price pools, and prepare memos for Transaction Committees overseeing whole loan trading activity.

- Evaluate securitization vs. whole loan markets, and quantify both prepayment and credit risk.

- Evaluate portfolio data and develop repeatable institutional analytics tracking portfolio performance.

- Model prepay and default behavior, develop market comparables and benchmarks, and present performance data to portfolio managers and Investment Committee.

- Support servicing oversight by converting raw servicing data into clear takeaways on servicer performance and loan-level exceptions.

- Own the data pipelines and tooling behind the analytics, including Databricks, Python, and SQL, with a focus on continual improvement.

- Reconcile loan data across systems and work with Operations and Transaction Management to resolve.

- Provide ad hoc analysis and support for trading and portfolio management functions.

- All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

- A quantitative degree or equivalent work experience.

- 2–5 years experience in mortgage analytics or a related field.

- A strong understanding of mortgage cash flows, prepayment modeling, and pricing of residential mortgage risk in both whole loan and securitized form.

- Comfortable working with servicing and remittance data.

- Strong Python and SQL skills and experience, plus hands-on work in Databricks or a similar platform.

- A solid grasp of mortgage analytics and prepayment modeling systems (Aladdin, Intex, Bloomberg, etc.).

AI Proficiency Expectations:

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

- Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

- Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

- Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

- Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life's AI guiding principles.

- Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention, and intellectual property.

- Additional Expectations for AI-Forward Roles

Applicants in AI-forward roles are also expected to:

- Identify practical opportunities to apply AI to improve workflows, productivity, analysis, and business outcomes.

- Create effective prompts, workflows, controls, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) review processes that support responsible AI use.

- Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, quality, bias, fairness, confidentiality, compliance, security, and business relevance.

- Partner appropriately with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Security, Data/Technology, and business stakeholders to move AI ideas from experimentation to responsible adoption.

- Help model responsible, human-centered AI adoption across the organization.

Core Competencies

Service Focus - Demonstrates a client centric focus for satisfying one’s external and/or internal customers; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.

Decision Making - Makes sense of complex information, critically evaluates, and creates solutions.

Results Oriented - Sets performance and personal goals; Driven to meet or exceed goals and objectives.

Plans and Aligns - Plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals; Aligns people and skills to tasks and assignments; Evaluates results of work.

Demonstrates Learning Agility - Enhances skills and knowledge through continuous learning; Focuses on personal results by establishing stretch goals; Seeks feedback and changes accordingly.

Establishes Relationships - Builds partnerships with others to instill trust, collaborate, and meet shared objectives.

Communicates Effectively - Actively listens, conveys messages to meet different audience needs, and remains open to new ideas and opinions.

Fosters Diversity - Values diversity and difference in thought, experience, and perspective; Promotes an environment that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion; Supports equal and fair treatment for all.

Benefits

- Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range. The base pay range for this position is the range National Life reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors, including: prior experience and job-related knowledge; education, training and certificates; current business needs; and market factors. The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.

The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. If hired, the employee will be in an "at-will position" and National Life reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

jobs.title: Remote Sensing Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About the role

Muon Space is building a family of infrared imaging missions designed for global wildfire detection and monitoring, weather and cloud characterization, and space-based environmental monitoring. Muon's IR Data Products team builds the analytics system that processes the data from our spacecraft's custom multispectral imaging instruments into data products and analytics for diverse end-user stakeholders from these missions. We are seeking a Geospatial Data Scientist to join this team with a focus on building derived data products from Muon's FireSat and Space-Based Environmental Monitoring (SBEM) missions.

This role will be a hands-on contributor to the development of derived data products from Muon's IR data missions. You will dive deep into real-world data from brand new imaging systems, prototype and productionize algorithms that turn Level-1 imagery into higher-level derived products, and write production-ready code that feeds directly into customer-facing services. Working alongside senior scientists and product owners on the IR Data Products team, you will build expertise across both missions while contributing to product design, validation, and documentation. This is a high-impact, multi-mission role that sits at the intersection of rigorous Earth observation science and fast-moving product development, and is well-suited for someone who thrives on hands-on technical work and cross-functional collaboration.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our Denver, CO office three days per week.

Responsibilities

- Build derived data products from Muon's infrared imaging missions, spanning Muon’s IR programs

- Implement and improve scalable algorithms for processing, transforming, and analyzing multispectral infrared imagery into derived geospatial products.

- Contribute to derived product design and roadmap under the direction of senior scientists and product owners on the IR Data team.

- Contribute to technical and customer-facing design documents for derived products, supporting alignment between internal capabilities and external stakeholder requirements.

- Support engagement with customer technical stakeholders including Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs), customer questions, and program meetings

- Write production-ready code that integrates into customer-facing data product pipelines and operational services.

- Contribute to the scientific quality, quantitative validation, and integrity of derived products across Muon’s IR missions.

- Work cross-functionally with software engineers, calibration scientists, and instrument engineers to design, build, and maintain operational data product services.

- Learn new topics as needed (e.g., sensor geometry and characterization, georeferencing techniques, wildfire and environmental monitoring applications, cloud-native geospatial data engineering).

Qualifications

- Degree & Experience: PhD; or MS with 3+ years industry experience; or BS with 5+ years industry experience

- Geospatial Processing: Hands-on experience building geospatial data products, particularly from new or novel imaging instruments.

- Scientific Rigor: Demonstrated experience applying first principles to solve complex problems.

- Sensor Data: Experience working with real-world data from new or novel imaging instruments

- Software Development: Strong skills in Python-based development and analysis

- Geospatial Technical Stack: Strong Python development skills utilizing standard geospatial formats and libraries (e.g., COGs, Xarray, GDAL).

- Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of collaborating across distributed, interdisciplinary teams (scientists, engineers, product).

- Distributed Team: Ability to work with a distributed, interdisciplinary team (scientists, engineers, data support)

- Startup Adaptability: Ability to prioritize, pivot, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Infrared sensing: Experience processing multispectral or infrared satellite imagery

- Domain Expertise: Domain expertise in wildfire monitoring, meteorology, weather, environmental remote sensing, or related Earth observation applications

- Mission & Operational Lifecycle: Experience supporting satellite mission product development, commissioning, early operations, or delivering operational pipelines to external customers.

- ML/AI: Demonstrated experience applying ML/DL and advanced image processing to remote sensing data

- Cloud Architecture: Familiarity with cloud-native geospatial workflows and large-scale data processing (AWS preferred).

- Technical Documentation: Experience authoring technical design documents, product specifications, or algorithm theoretical basis documents (ATBDs).

Salary

The salary range for this role is $171,000 - $191,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

About Morningstar and the Individual Investor Business

Morningstar’s Individual Investor business empowers investors with data, research, and tools to help them make informed financial decisions. Our flagship Morningstar Investor platform provides deep insights, portfolio tracking, and investment research, while Morningstar.com serves as a hub for market news, analysis, and educational content.

*NOTE: We’re not considering candidates who require sponsorship now or in the future.

The Role

We are seeking a Business Data Analyst to bring analytical rigor to our product efforts. The role will help us measure performance, analyze visitor and subscriber behavior, and optimize customer acquisition and retention efforts. This role will own data analytics architecture, reporting, forecasting models, user behavior analysis, and work cross-functionally to enhance our product and marketing strategies.

You will be responsible for building and tracking KPIs across Morningstar Investor, Morningstar.com, and our broader suite of investor products, implementing analytics solutions, and driving insights that support strategic decision-making. This role will report to the Head of Revenue and will partner with the engineering team to ensure seamless tracking and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Reporting

• Track and analyze daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly KPIs to measure the product’s effectiveness and progress toward growth goals.

• Build, maintain and continuously evolve dashboards that monitor trials, subscriber growth, page views, engagement, and on-site behavior across Morningstar Investor and Morningstar.com to meet the needs of the product.

• Consolidate data from various sources such as Google suite, Redshift, Stripe, and AWS to create automated reporting solutions that provide actionable insights.

• Collaborate with the engineering team to design solutions to better surface and analyze these insights.

• Monitor and validate data from third-party sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.

• Define baseline targets and use data-driven insights to optimize acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies.

• Conduct cohort analysis, customer lifetime value (LTV) modeling, and retention analysis to inform product investment decisions.

Forecasting & Financial Modeling

• Develop and maintain financial forecasting models to project revenue growth and subscription trends over the next three years based on historical data and market assumptions.

• Evaluate the impact of pricing, marketing spend, and customer acquisition efforts on financial performance.

Data Infrastructure & Collaboration

• Work with engineering and data teams to build and maintain a centralized data infrastructure that supports product analytics.

• Define and implement data tracking solutions using Google Tag Manager (GTM) and SQL-based data pipelines.

Qualifications & Skills

• 2-5 years of experience in data analytics or business intelligence.

• Strong experience in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.

• Proficiency in Google Marketing Platform (Google Analytics, Google Ads, Looker Studio).

• Experience working with data visualization tools (Tableau, QuickSight, Looker Studio).

• Strong analytical skills, including financial modeling, forecasting, and trend analysis.

• Ability to clean, structure, and interpret large datasets to generate actionable insights.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate data into business recommendations.

• Experience with AWS (Athena, Redshift, QuickSight) for data analysis.

• Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Google Optimize, Optimizely) and tracking platforms.

• Programming experience in Python or R for advanced data analysis.

• Knowledge of subscription-based business models and customer retention metrics.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re seeking a Revenue Operations Manager with a strong track record, a builder’s mindset, and a bias for action to join our in-person team in New York or SF.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll own the entire revenue operations function, from top-of-funnel lead routing through deal close and commission administration. You’ll work closely with our Head of Finance & People Ops and sales leadership to build the systems, dashboards, and processes that scale our go-to-market motion.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Own the inbound lead routing process, partnering with Marketing to ensure proper attribution

 - Run territory management and strategy for geo-based decision-making

 - Support and strategize on every aspect of revenue operations in your territory

 - Own capacity forecasting strategy, including inputs, throughputs, and outputs, and serve as the conduit back to Finance in the US for effective capacity forecasting

 - Provide input and strategy on comp-based decisions and benchmarking

 - Support leadership on overall regional operations and finance strategy across all functions, including sales, presales, and ecosystem

 - Evaluate new tools on the market and be responsible for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales team

 - Build and maintain dashboards, leaderboards, and pipeline reporting to give leadership real-time visibility

 - Monitor deal progression and hold reps accountable for CRM hygiene and accuracy

 - Support deal reviews at the pricing and negotiation stages, coordinating with outside counsel as needed

 - Own the closed-won process from signature through handoff to post-sale

 - Administer commission plans across the sales org, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and serving as the source of truth for comp-related questions




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 3–7 years in Sales Operations or Revenue Operations at a high-growth, usage-based sales organization

 - You’ve built core GTM infrastructure before: lead routing, CRM architecture, pipeline reporting, commission administration, and deal desk

 - You have deep proficiency in CRM workflows, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and data hygiene

 - You’ve owned commissions end-to-end: building the model, calculating payouts, fielding rep disputes, and keeping it reconciled with Finance

 - You’ve run a deal desk, know what makes a contract clean, and catch errors before they become problems

 - You’re strong in Excel or Google Sheets: you can build a pipeline coverage model and know which metrics actually matter

 - You’ve earned trust with a sales team by making their lives easier while holding them accountable to process

 - You have a builder’s mentality: you identify gaps, propose solutions, and execute without being asked twice

 - You can zoom out and think strategically while staying close enough to the work to get your hands on the keyboard

 - You have an AI-forward mindset: you actively use AI in your work and are excited to pioneer its use in go-to-market operations

 - You have strong communication and collaboration skills and earn trust across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

 - You’re a player-coach: you’re not above the details, and you’re excited to own the work yourself

- Manage the department’s subscription services, which includes management of ALD’s subscription roasters, invoice processes, and aggregation of monthly usage reports.

- Support Onit Mailbox operation and take a back-up role with an e-billing/matter mgmt. coordinator, including legal invoice communication with Account Payable and internal & external clients, updating user profiles, submitting access requests, maintaining security groups and vendor profiles.

- Experience in vendor management, third-party risk, legal operations, or a comparable operational role – law firm/legal vendor management experience preferred.

Preferred

- Experience in a financial services or other highly regulated environment.

- Familiarity with outside counsel guidelines, TPRM processes, and enterprise legal management (ELM) systems.
