jobs.title: Data Scientist, Product
jobs.description:
Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media.

We get to rethink how people collaborate with AI that can actually do creative work with them—defining entirely new interaction paradigms for AI-native video tools. We make that possible by building multimodal agents that turn creative direction into edits, rendering engines that composite multiple layers of video and graphics, and generative video models trained from the ground up that create new media when needed.

All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs.

Explore our work
Captions https://apps.apple.com/us/app/captions-ai-edits-your-video/id1541407007 — Our flagship creative workspace 
Tesseract https://x.com/trymirage/status/2102429594804429138 — Our professional video engine for AI agents 
Research https://mirage.app/research?utm_source=chatgpt.com — The foundation models we build in-house 
Updates https://x.com/trymirage — The latest from Mirage 
TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/24/mirage-raises-75m-to-continue-building-models-for-its-ai-video-editing-app-captions/, Forbes https://www.forbes.com/companies/captions/?list=ai50, Fast Company https://www.fastcompany.com/91270234/video-most-innovative-companies-fast-company-2025-youtube-roku-tubi-vimeo-captions-descript-cour-procreate-synthesia-beeble — Press

Our Investors

We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more.

Please note that most of our roles will require you to be in-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square) 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring two Product Data Scientists to ground the decisions behind Captions in clear metrics, rigorous analysis, and a deep understanding of how people use the product. One person will embed with our iOS team and the other with our web team, working day to day with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data Engineering.

You’ll be present as questions and product ideas take shape, not brought in after launch to explain what happened. You’ll define success, evaluate experiments, investigate user behavior, and turn ambiguous findings into clear recommendations. You’ll then follow them through by communicating the reasoning, building alignment, and making sure decisions result in action.

We care about analytical depth, product judgment, and the ability to make a team more rigorous. We work AI-first: Codex and Claude Code are part of the everyday workflow, and you’ll be expected to validate the work they help produce.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Embed with either the iOS or web team from planning through launch, defining hypotheses, success criteria, core metrics, and measurement approaches while partnering with Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality.

 - Lead analysis to uncover patterns in product and user behavior, prioritize high-leverage opportunities, recommend actions, and measure realized impact.

 - Design and evaluate A/B tests and other product measurements, setting appropriate guardrails and turning results into decisions.

 - Create executive-ready visualizations, dashboards, experiment readouts, and decision memos that drive alignment on what happened and what the team should do next.

 - Build machine learning and statistical models to solve core user problems, improve the product experience, and deliver measurable user impact.

 - Design AI-native tools, systems, and automated workflows that accelerate data science and analytics while enabling self-service capabilities.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - A bachelor’s degree in a behavioral or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience, with a strong statistical foundation.

 - 3+ years of experience in product analytics or product data science, acting as the analytics voice within a consumer product team.

 - High proficiency in SQL and either Python or R, including libraries such as pandas, NumPy, SciPy, or Tidyverse, with strong data-model reasoning and the ability to write and understand analytical code.

 - Experience applying statistical analysis, experimental design, causal inference, and machine learning to product problems, with the judgment to choose an appropriately simple method and translate the result into a specific, actionable recommendation.

 - Fluency using AI across exploration, analysis, experimentation, and modeling, including providing relevant context, debugging incorrect outputs, and converting repeatable work into reliable workflows.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain uncertainty and limitations, persuade technical and nontechnical partners, and lead decisions through to action.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with iOS or web analytics, including instrumentation, release measurement, funnels, or experimentation.

 - Experience with dbt, cloud data warehouses, and large event datasets.

 - Experience applying product analytics to a consumer creative product.

 - Experience building reusable AI-powered data science systems, such as agents, orchestration layers, automated analyses, or evaluation and review workflows.

 - Strong user empathy, curiosity, and excitement about learning in a fast-moving environment.

 - A proactive, independent working style: you pursue leads, find the people and context you need, operate through ambiguity, and follow work through from recommendation to action.


BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans

 - 401K with employer match

 - Commuter Benefits

 - Catered lunch multiple days per week

 - Dinner stipend every night if you're working late and want a bite! 

 - Grubhub subscription

 - Health & Wellness Perks

 - Multiple team offsites per year with team events every month

 - Generous PTO policy

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Job Description

Join our Revenue Operations team and help shape how we balance customer demand, supply availability, and revenue priorities across the business! As a Supply Demand Analyst, you will collaborate with Sales, Supply Chain, Demand Management, Operations, and Business Unit partners to transform complex data into actionable insights. You will analyze demand and supply signals, identify risks and opportunities, support planning decisions, and drive continuous improvements through analytics, automation, and AI-supported workflows. Your work will have a meaningful impact on planning accuracy, customer commitments, and business performance.

Responsibilities

- Analyze demand, backlog, forecasts, supply availability, and customer support signals to identify risks, opportunities, and planning gaps.

- Collaborate with Sales, Business Units, Supply Chain Planning, Demand Management, Operations, and Finance partners to align demand and supply assumptions and improve planning accuracy.

- Evaluate supply constraints, allocation requirements, demand changes, and plan feasibility to support consensus planning and customer commitments.

- Develop recommendations such as allocation, build-ahead, pull-in, and supply optimization actions to improve execution and revenue outcomes.

- Utilize RapidResponse, Snowflake, Power BI, Excel, and AI-assisted analytics tools to perform scenario analysis, reporting, process improvements, and automation initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Data Analytics, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience supporting demand planning, supply chain planning, sales operations, revenue operations, finance, or a related analytical function.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.

- Proficiency in Excel and business intelligence, planning, or reporting tools.

- Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with RapidResponse, Snowflake, Power BI, or similar planning and analytics platforms.

- Knowledge of semiconductor, technology, manufacturing, or supply chain planning environments.

- Experience supporting cross-functional planning processes involving Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations partners.

- Passion for learning, building, and improving AI-supported workflows that drive efficiency and innovation.

Your work will have a meaningful impact on planning accuracy, customer commitments, and business performance.

Responsibilities

- Analyze demand, backlog, forecasts, supply availability, and customer support signals to identify risks, opportunities, and planning gaps.

- Collaborate with Sales, Business Units, Supply Chain Planning, Demand Management, Operations, and Finance partners to align demand and supply assumptions and improve planning accuracy.

- Evaluate supply constraints, allocation requirements, demand changes, and plan feasibility to support consensus planning and customer commitments.

- Develop recommendations such as allocation, build-ahead, pull-in, and supply optimization actions to improve execution and revenue outcomes.

- Utilize RapidResponse, Snowflake, Power BI, Excel, and AI-assisted analytics tools to perform scenario analysis, reporting, process improvements, and automation initiatives.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Data Analytics, Operations, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience supporting demand planning, supply chain planning, sales operations, revenue operations, finance, or a related analytical function.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-support skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations.

- Proficiency in Excel and business intelligence, planning, or reporting tools.

- Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

- Experience with RapidResponse, Snowflake, Power BI, or similar planning and analytics platforms.

- Knowledge of semiconductor, technology, manufacturing, or supply chain planning environments.

- Experience supporting cross-functional planning processes involving Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations partners.

- Passion for learning, building, and improving AI-supported workflows that drive efficiency and innovation.

jobs.description:
Role Overview:

We're looking for a hands-on Treasury Operations Analyst to own the day-to-day execution of Mercury's cash management and reporting processes. This is an execution- and build-focused role: you'll manage cash movements and approvals, maintain Treasury's core reporting cadence, and — critically — design and build the automated tools and workflows that let Treasury operate without relying on manual spreadsheet work or costly third-party platforms.

We're especially interested in candidates who are fluent with modern AI and prioritize process and reporting automations. If you've automated processes to gain scale and efficiency we want to hear about it.

Cash Management & Operations:

- Execute and approve daily cash movements across Mercury's accounts, ensuring accuracy, proper authorization, and timely settlement

- Maintain daily cash positioning and reporting, tracking balances across operating, reserve, and partner bank accounts

- Manage reserve account funding across Mercury's partner bank relationships, ensuring balances comply with contractual requirements and reconciling reserve calculations against underlying agreements

- Support cash forecasting by maintaining and refreshing short-term cash flow models

- Own bank account access and rights administration

Reporting & Automation (Build Focus):

- Design, build, and maintain automated cash and liquidity reporting — reducing reliance on manual spreadsheet processes and off-the-shelf treasury management tooling

- Build scalable tools for cash positioning, reserve tracking, and reporting workflows

- Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting packages (e.g., ALCO materials, deposit summaries, liquidity metrics)

- Own data pulls and validation from internal systems (e.g., NetSuite, Snowflake) to support reporting accuracy

- Continuously look for manual, error-prone, or repetitive Treasury processes and propose/build automated replacements

Cross-Functional Support:

- Partner with Accounting to ensure cash activity, reserve movements, and facility transactions are properly reflected in the GL

- Work with Data/Analytics teams to acquire cash data feeds from third-party banks to support Treasury and broader Finance reporting

- Support ALCO and management reporting with accurate, well-formatted, timely inputs

- Assist with ad hoc requests from the Treasurer and broader Finance team

What We're Looking For:

- Prior experience at a fintech, bank, or other regulated financial institution

- 2–5 years of experience in treasury operations, corporate treasury, FP&A, or a related finance/accounting function

- High attention to detail — this role involves approving real money movements and compliance-sensitive reporting

- Strong data modeling skills; comfort with large datasets

- Demonstrated experience thoughtfully transitioning manual processes to scalable automations to gain efficiencies

- Familiarity with SQL and/or willingness to learn (Snowflake, Omni experience a plus)

- Exposure to NetSuite or similar ERP/GL systems a plus

- Strong written communication; comfortable producing clean, concise reporting for senior stakeholders and external counterparties (third-party banks, lenders)

- Self-starter comfortable in an ambiguous, build-as-you-go environment

- Experience using AI tools to prototype automated processes

Nice to Have:

- Experience with partner bank / BaaS reserve account structures

- Prior use of Treasury Management Systems

- Familiarity with deposit sweep networks

- Experience supporting Federal Reserve account operations

- Project management skills — this role will involve owning trackers and multi-workstream initiatives

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

The Role

The Analyst, Treasury Operations is a key member in McKesson’s Medical Surgical (MMS) business unit’s treasury function with responsibility for managing and optimizing MMS’ global liquidity. Other responsibility includes partnering with business units to develop payment solutions to enhance efficiencies and to manage and enhance our treasury systems and tools.

Key Responsibilities

- Monitor and manage MMS’ daily cash position, make recommendations on Investments and quarter-back this process to reduce cost of cash

- Provide operational and analytical support for short-term and long-term borrowing arrangements, hedging activities and share repurchases

- Assist the capital markets team in executing transactions in the financial markets, as needed

- Work with other Treasury team members to prepare insightful departmental reports

- Partner with internal business groups to understand sources and uses of cash and maintain a robust cash forecast

- Prepare executive-level treasury reporting, including liquidity metrics, cash forecasts, investment performance, and CFO dashboards to support strategic planning and capital allocation decisions

- Evaluate short-term investment opportunities, bank deposits, and cash management strategies while balancing liquidity, yield, risk exposure, and banking costs

- Monitor regulatory, tax, and market developments impacting investments, treasury operations, and cash management activities

- Assist in the coordination of derivatives settlement confirmation

- Assist with and coordinate spot & forward FX trades

- Partner with the Capital Markets group and assist in settlement of cross-currency swaps to support intercompany funding structures and risk management strategies

- Support the company’s hedging strategies by helping execute, value, and manage derivative trades to hedge FX, interest, and other operational risks

- Administer online banking platforms, user entitlements, security controls, and bank portal access

- Maintain bank account documentation, signer authority records, and eBAM workflows to ensure compliance with corporate governance and banking requirements

- Collaborate with banking partners to maintain and develop cash management structure and resolve day-to-day operational issues

- Proactively collaborate with business units and corporate departments to aid in the construction and execution of the cash forecast, intercompany financing structures, and help identify and implement new services as the business grows and banking industry evolves

- Find ways to continuously improve processes, procedures and controls surrounding cash movement, bank balance/fee monitoring and other Treasury-related activities including SOX documentation

- Manage multiple relationships with vendors, including banks, credit rating agencies, investment managers and retirement plan administrators

- Maintain and improve the Treasury’s technology platform and tools (Kyriba) to support efficient and effective operations of the team

- Participate in treasury system enhancements, process automation initiatives to improve treasury operations and reporting capabilities

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

- 3+ years Finance or Treasury related experience

- BS degree in Finance or related field

Critical Skills

- Experience in Treasury operations preferred with demonstrated knowledge in cash management, commercial paper issuance, bank infrastructure and investments

- Demonstrated skills in navigating large, complex organizations and collaborating with multiple businesses and functional areas

- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize various responsibilities with competing, short deadlines and under pressure with a “can-do” attitude

- Demonstrated the ability to ramp-up quickly on challenging topics

- Experience using Kyriba or other treasury management systems preferred

- Strong Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets and analytical skills

Additional Skills

- A business partner mindset and understand the internal and external issues facing the business and industry and use that understanding to forge partnerships and build relationships

- Demonstrated ability to understand complex business problems, conduct analysis, and identify well-reasoned solutions

- Highly organized and detail oriented due to the criticality of the function

- A results orientation mind-set with a personal commitment and drive to set and meet or exceed the operational and financial goals for this position

- Strong communication skills to interact up and across the organization

About McKesson Medical-Surgical

McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers.

Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private-label medical-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID-19 tests.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

$78,000 - $130,000

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) Disability_Accommodation@McKesson.com or (Canada) Accessibility@mckesson.ca. jobs.title: Fleet Operations & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.
The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:
Pragmatic Optimism
Excellence without Ego
Proactive Collaboration


Job Overview
The Linear Generator is a sophisticated, automated, and integrated system spanning a wide range of engineering disciplines including thermodynamics, mechanical, electrical, software, and controls. As a member of our Fleet Operations & Analytics Team, you will be part of a dynamic group that delivers the best product and experience that Mainspring Energy has to offer. This includes operation and monitoring of our fleet of Linear Generators (LGens), debugging issues, management of incident resolution and advanced data analysis aimed at improving our product and communicating on our fleet performance. 
 
This is a highly cross-functional role in a rapidly-scaling company function, and there is an enormous opportunity to influence how this work is done now and into the future.  The breadth of this role is perfect for an engineer who wants to use their advanced analytical and technical skills in a fast-paced and challenging environment. We are looking for an ambitious and curious individual excited to work at the interface of operations, systems engineering, and analytics.

Responsibilities
- Manage daily operations of Mainspring Energy’s growing Linear Generator fleet, including remote operation, troubleshooting, and incident resolution

- Contribute to a cross-functional team that designs, implements, and uses a real-time monitoring and communication platform

- Provide high-quality analytics on fleet availability, performance, and connectivity to Service, Engineering, and Sales teams

- Report on NERC compliance metrics and ensure ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements

- Identify and communicate major opportunities for performance and reliability improvements

- Track and document operational issues along with their root causes and resolutions

- Generate accurate, detailed data reports for customers and regulatory agencies

- Improve automation and reporting workflows by developing and deploying internal tools

- Coordinate with the Operations & Maintenance team to plan and execute scheduled and reactive service events

- Collaborate across functions, gaining exposure to quality assurance, reliability engineering, product validation, test engineering, and software development

- Support team growth by helping to identify, onboard, and train new team members in a rapidly scaling organization

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, with 2–5 years of relevant engineering experience.

- Demonstrated ability to build and maintain highly disciplined operations and training processes, including methodical workflow documentation, clear hand-off communication, and detailed incident reporting/analysis

- Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple priorities at once

- Strong engineering fundamentals and experience applying these concepts to large-scale physical systems

- Previous experience with system-level engineering analysis and troubleshooting, understanding how mechanical, electrical, controls, and software components interact across a broader system

- Demonstrated ability to resolve complex troubleshooting problems and independently make right decisions under high pressure situations, employing clear and methodical communication and documentation

- Experience with engineering data analysis, including time-series data and dashboard development using cloud-based or industry-standard tools

- Demonstrated interest and ability in development of automated software tools and processes (Python preferred)

- Role requires full-time presence at our Menlo Park headquarters

Does your experience not meet all of our posted requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to positions unless they meet every listed requirement. At Mainspring, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, flexible, and collaborative environment, so if you want to help us transition the world to clean and affordable electricity, and don’t meet all posted requirements for a particular role, we’d still love to hear from you. Mainspring can sometimes be flexible enough to shift responsibilities for the right person, or otherwise identify open or upcoming roles that may better fit your professional background.
In more traditional words, Mainspring Energy, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
This compensation and benefits information is based on Mainspring Energy's estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future. We generally do not negotiate on salary once we have made an offer. The level of pay within the range will depend on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant prior experience and/or education, or particular skills and expertise. New hires joining the company tend to be paid within the starting base pay range noted above, with opportunities to increase pay over time based on development of additional skills, competencies, and company-specific knowledge.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Madhive is the leading independent and fully customizable operating system built to help local media professionals build profitable, differentiated, and efficient businesses. Madhive empowers sales teams to extend their reach into streaming and connects local advertisers with the communities they serve. Madhive’s platform provides the unique ability to reach local audiences at national scale, with premium supply partnerships and end-to-end tools for planning, targeting, and measuring full-funnel campaign outcomes. Powering campaigns for over 30,000 small and medium businesses per day, Madhive is driving the evolution of local media. 

We are seeking a highly analytical, structured, and execution-oriented Business Analyst to partner directly with the CEO. This individual will serve as a force multiplier, translating ideas into structured plans, building executive-ready materials, and driving high-priority initiatives from concept through completion.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and hands-on project leadership. You will help shape board materials, leadership presentations, and company-wide initiatives while ensuring alignment, accountability, and measurable progress across teams.

This role will be based in our NYC office, with an expectation of 4 - 5 days per week on-site.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner closely with the CEO to translate ideas into structured narratives, strategic plans, and presentation materials

 - Build and own executive-level decks for board meetings, investor updates, and leadership offsites

 - Assist with cross-functional strategic initiatives, defining scope, milestones, owners, and success metrics

 - Drive end-to-end project management for CEO-sponsored priorities, ensuring timelines are met and risks are proactively managed

 - Establish clear operating cadences, tracking mechanisms, and reporting structures for high-impact initiatives

 - Conduct research and synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights

 - Analyze business performance data to inform decision-making and highlight risks or opportunities

 - Prepare briefing materials ahead of key internal and external meetings

 - Identify operational gaps and implement scalable solutions

 - Act as connective tissue across departments to maintain alignment on CEO priorities


WHO YOU ARE

 - 2-4 years of experience, preferably in adtech, digital media, programmatic, or a closely related ecosystem, ideally in strategy, business operations, revenue operations, consulting, or similar execution-heavy roles

 - Proven experience leading cross-functional projects from strategy through execution, with clear examples of driving outcomes

 - Strong analytical and structured thinking skills with the ability to synthesize business performance data into clear executive narratives

 - Exceptional Google Slides skills, with experience building board-level, investor, and executive-facing materials from scratch

 - Comfortable working directly with revenue, product, and financial data to inform decision-making

 - Highly organized with strong project management discipline, including defining milestones, managing stakeholders, and mitigating risk

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-moving, high-growth environments

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

 - Low ego, high ownership, and strong accountability
   
    

The approximate compensation range for this position is $95,000-$120,000. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors, including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

We are Madhive

Madhive is a dynamic, diverse, innovative, and friendly place to work. We embrace our differences and believe they fuel our creativity. We come from varied backgrounds and think that’s important. Whether it’s taking ideas from previous lives and applying them in different ways or creating something completely new, we are all trail-blazing team players who think big and want to make an impact. 

We are committed to cultivating a culture of inclusion and collaboration. We welcome diversity in education, culture, opinions, race, ethnicity, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, sexual orientation, and beliefs.

Please be advised that we will NOT be using third-party recruiting agencies for this search.

jobs.title: 2027 Management Development Program - IS Forward Deployed Product Analyst (Wilmington, DE)
jobs.description:
Overview:

Serves as a member of the Management Development Program (MDP) and participates in ten weeks of Core Training and one year of On-the-Job training (OJT). Core Training responsibilities include participation in classroom training, observations of departmental presentations, interaction with senior management, peer networking, and working in teams on group project assignments. OJT responsibilities vary by department and are assigned by the department manager. The position may be responsible for additional projects assigned by the department manager or Leadership Development Manager.

Department Description:

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve.

Wilmington Trust is seeking a Forward Deployed Digital Product Analyst to join its Management Development Program and help accelerate digital transformation across core operations. This early-career role is designed for candidates interested in developing digital products, AI products, business transformation, or client-facing technology leaders.

This role is a hybrid between a junior product manager, business analyst, AI-enabled process analyst, and workflow designer. The role focuses on identifying operational problems, defining user needs, documenting requirements, testing solutions, and using agentic AI tools to rapidly analyze, prototype, and improve business workflows.

Ideal candidates are curious, analytical, hands-on, and comfortable working across business and technology teams. They should have exposure to digital product management concepts such as writing user stories or specifications, mapping process flows, creating simple UI designs or wireframes, testing software or workflows, or using AI tools to improve productivity and solution design.

Department Responsibilities:

- Help discover, design, test, and launch digital workflow solutions across Wilmington Trust Institutional Services.

- Sit down with business product owners, operations teams, technology partners, and senior product leaders to learn what is not working today and where automation could help.

- Turn what you hear into clear write-ups: user stories (short descriptions of what a user needs), acceptance criteria (the checklist that says when the work is done), process flows, and wireframes (simple screen sketches).

- Use agentic AI tools (AI that can carry out multi-step tasks for you) to analyze processes, draft documentation, generate test cases, and prototype workflows faster.

- Think through big, unclear problems in a structured way: break them into smaller pieces, get to the root cause, weigh the options, and recommend practical next steps.

- Join working sessions where the team maps how a process runs today versus how it should run, and shape early MVP ideas (a first, simple version of a solution).

- Build quick prototypes using enterprise tools, agentic AI tools, low-code or no-code platforms (build with little or no programming), and design collaboration tools.

- Partner with product owners and delivery teams to keep the backlog (the prioritized list of work) clear, current, and tied to business goals.

- Support QA, UAT (user acceptance testing, where real users confirm a solution works), and production checks by writing test scenarios, logging defects, and confirming fixes.

- Help define and track the numbers that show whether a solution is working, such as user adoption, cycle time, exception rates, and business impact.

- Work with technology partners to understand how systems connect and where data, system limits, or operational risks could get in the way.

- Learn and apply agile, lean, design thinking, process engineering, and product management practices on real transformation work.

- Keep up with new agentic AI capabilities, digital product tools, workflow automation practices, and responsible ways to use AI.

- Share what you find, including requirements, risks, test results, and recommendations, in language that business, product, and technology partners can act on.

- Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.

- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Department Experience Required:

This role is built for junior candidates and anyone interested in a Management Development Program, and recent college graduates are encouraged to apply. Experience from internships, co-ops, capstones, campus consulting projects, fintech labs, digital product projects, or AI projects is welcome, but none of it is required to apply.

- A real interest in digital product management, business transformation, financial technology, AI-enabled operations, or workflow automation.

- Some exposure, through coursework, an internship, a class project, or a job, to product work such as writing user stories, documenting requirements, mapping processes, or sketching wireframes.

- Some hands-on time with agentic AI or AI-assisted tools, such as Open Claw, Hermes, Claude Code, or Codex, used to help plan, build, test, analyze, or automate work.

- Comfort taking an open-ended problem apart, working through the information, spotting patterns, and explaining what you’ve found.

- Some exposure to testing software: QA, UAT (having real users confirm a solution works), writing test cases, logging defects, or checking data.

- The ability to explain things clearly in writing and out loud, from requirements and processes flows to feedback, test results, and recommendations.

- A collaborative style that works well with business, products, operations, design, and technology partners.

- Curiosity about how AI, automation, and digital products can improve business processes, client experiences, and day-to-day operations.

- Attention to detail, good organization, strong follow-through, and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Department Experience Preferred:

- An internship, co-op, project, or first job touching financial services, fintech, banking, wealth management, trust services, capital markets, payments, operations, risk, or compliance.

- Exposure to low-code or no-code workflow tools (platforms that let you build with little or no programming) such as Appian, Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Pega, Airtable, Retool, or Mendix.

- Coursework or hands-on work in process mapping, workflow or service design, user journey mapping, or operational improvement.

- Any time spent building, configuring, testing, or documenting workflows and screens in Appian Designer - Appian Level 1 certification or similar exposure is a plus, not a must.

- A general sense of what Appian can do, such as process models, interfaces, records, reports, dashboards, case management, AI features, or RPA (software robots that handle repetitive tasks).

- Using AI tools to help with requirements, prototypes, test generation, documentation, code review, workflow design, or data analysis.

- Exposure to product management methods and agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog management (keeping the work list prioritized), and retrospectives (short team check-ins on what to improve).

- Practice writing user stories and acceptance criteria that are detailed enough for a team to act on.

- Creating wireframes, user flows, journey maps, process diagrams, or simple screen designs in tools such as Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, Visio, Jira, or Confluence.

- Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and tracking KPIs (the key numbers that show how well something is performing).

- Exposure to test planning, regression testing (rechecking that existing features still work), UAT coordination, defect triage, or production readiness checks.

- An ability to sit between business and technical teams, turning business needs into clear requirements and explaining technical limits back in plain terms.

- Strong written and verbal communication, with a user-first mindset and a knack for simplifying complex topics.

- Some grounding in Agile, Lean, design thinking, system thinking, or continuous improvement.

- An interest in growing into a product owner, AI product manager, business architect, digital transformation leader, or forward deployed product manager

Primary Program Responsibilities:

- Participate in and complete a one-year long, non-rotational training program while creating and adding value to assigned department. Receive job specific training, general training in banking, communication and leadership, and personalized coaching and feedback. Performance measures may include several objective test scores, peer and sponsor feedback from group projects, facilitator feedback, Leadership Development Manager-MDP feedback, Department Manager feedback, final assessment score, and year-end performance appraisal from Department Manager.

- Core Training - Participate in training throughout the one-year assignment to learn banking, basic financial skills, technical skills, and leadership/interpersonal skills. Develop a solid understanding of banking functions, processes, and operations.

- Group Projects - Participate in group project assignments, working with a team of their peers to build relationships within their teams as well as with project sponsors, internal and external contacts, and senior management. Teams make a presentation to senior management at the conclusion of each project providing recommendations and potential project solutions.

- On-the-Job Training - The fundamental skills taught in core training are combined with On-the-Job training based on the incumbent's assignment. Job specific training teaches departmental policies, procedures, systems, and products. Upon completion of MDP, all incumbents attain basic skills necessary to contribute as individual contributors and/or managers in their assigned department.

- Complete tasks in a manner that are compliant with applicable laws and regulations and/or that serve to help the Company be in compliance with laws and regulations that apply to the business line the position supports.

- Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite.

- Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.

- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Program Scope of Responsibilities:

The Management Development Program is a non-rotational, one-year training program for recent college graduates where participants learn about sales, accounting, project management and leadership skills depending upon their career track. Various methods of training include classroom study, divisional orientations, and teamwork on group projects. These fundamentals are coupled with on-the-job training to allow for immediate application in the area for which the participant has been hired.

Program Education and Experience Required:

- Bachelor's Degree candidate at a school where M&T Bank recruits MDPs (or an MBA student with no work experience).

- Outstanding academic credentials (GPA of 3.0 or better).

- Up to 1 year of work experience.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Demonstrated interpersonal skills.

- Demonstrated analytical skills.

- Demonstrated computer skills.

- Demonstrated presentation skills.

- Demonstrated leadership abilities.

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $29.57 - $43.99 per hour. The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. The range listed above encompasses all geographic locations. The pay rate specific to your location will fall within this range and is available from your recruiter.

Location
Wilmington, Delaware, United States of America

jobs.description:
Overview:

Serves as a member of the Management Development Program (MDP) and participates in ten weeks of Core Training and one year of On-the-Job training (OJT). Core Training responsibilities include participation in classroom training, observations of departmental presentations, interaction with senior management, peer networking, and working in teams on group project assignments. OJT responsibilities vary by department and are assigned by the department manager. The position may be responsible for additional projects assigned by the department manager or Leadership Development Manager.

Department Description:

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve.

Wilmington Trust is seeking a Forward Deployed Digital Product Analyst to join its Management Development Program and help accelerate digital transformation across core operations. This early-career role is designed for candidates interested in developing digital products, AI products, business transformation, or client-facing technology leaders.

This role is a hybrid between a junior product manager, business analyst, AI-enabled process analyst, and workflow designer. The role focuses on identifying operational problems, defining user needs, documenting requirements, testing solutions, and using agentic AI tools to rapidly analyze, prototype, and improve business workflows.

Ideal candidates are curious, analytical, hands-on, and comfortable working across business and technology teams. They should have exposure to digital product management concepts such as writing user stories or specifications, mapping process flows, creating simple UI designs or wireframes, testing software or workflows, or using AI tools to improve productivity and solution design.

Department Responsibilities:

- Help discover, design, test, and launch digital workflow solutions across Wilmington Trust Institutional Services.

- Sit down with business product owners, operations teams, technology partners, and senior product leaders to learn what is not working today and where automation could help.

- Turn what you hear into clear write-ups: user stories (short descriptions of what a user needs), acceptance criteria (the checklist that says when the work is done), process flows, and wireframes (simple screen sketches).

- Use agentic AI tools (AI that can carry out multi-step tasks for you) to analyze processes, draft documentation, generate test cases, and prototype workflows faster.

- Think through big, unclear problems in a structured way: break them into smaller pieces, get to the root cause, weigh the options, and recommend practical next steps.

- Join working sessions where the team maps how a process runs today versus how it should run, and shape early MVP ideas (a first, simple version of a solution).

- Build quick prototypes using enterprise tools, agentic AI tools, low-code or no-code platforms (build with little or no programming), and design collaboration tools.

- Partner with product owners and delivery teams to keep the backlog (the prioritized list of work) clear, current, and tied to business goals.

- Support QA, UAT (user acceptance testing, where real users confirm a solution works), and production checks by writing test scenarios, logging defects, and confirming fixes.

- Help define and track the numbers that show whether a solution is working, such as user adoption, cycle time, exception rates, and business impact.

- Work with technology partners to understand how systems connect and where data, system limits, or operational risks could get in the way.

- Learn and apply agile, lean, design thinking, process engineering, and product management practices on real transformation work.

- Keep up with new agentic AI capabilities, digital product tools, workflow automation practices, and responsible ways to use AI.

- Share what you find, including requirements, risks, test results, and recommendations, in language that business, product, and technology partners can act on.

- Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.

- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Department Experience Required:

This role is built for junior candidates and anyone interested in a Management Development Program, and recent college graduates are encouraged to apply. Experience from internships, co-ops, capstones, campus consulting projects, fintech labs, digital product projects, or AI projects is welcome, but none of it is required to apply.

- A real interest in digital product management, business transformation, financial technology, AI-enabled operations, or workflow automation.

- Some exposure, through coursework, an internship, a class project, or a job, to product work such as writing user stories, documenting requirements, mapping processes, or sketching wireframes.

- Some hands-on time with agentic AI or AI-assisted tools, such as Open Claw, Hermes, Claude Code, or Codex, used to help plan, build, test, analyze, or automate work.

- Comfort taking an open-ended problem apart, working through the information, spotting patterns, and explaining what you’ve found.

- Some exposure to testing software: QA, UAT (having real users confirm a solution works), writing test cases, logging defects, or checking data.

- The ability to explain things clearly in writing and out loud, from requirements and processes flows to feedback, test results, and recommendations.

- A collaborative style that works well with business, products, operations, design, and technology partners.

- Curiosity about how AI, automation, and digital products can improve business processes, client experiences, and day-to-day operations.

- Attention to detail, good organization, strong follow-through, and a willingness to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Department Experience Preferred:

- An internship, co-op, project, or first job touching financial services, fintech, banking, wealth management, trust services, capital markets, payments, operations, risk, or compliance.

- Exposure to low-code or no-code workflow tools (platforms that let you build with little or no programming) such as Appian, Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Pega, Airtable, Retool, or Mendix.

- Coursework or hands-on work in process mapping, workflow or service design, user journey mapping, or operational improvement.

- Any time spent building, configuring, testing, or documenting workflows and screens in Appian Designer - Appian Level 1 certification or similar exposure is a plus, not a must.

- A general sense of what Appian can do, such as process models, interfaces, records, reports, dashboards, case management, AI features, or RPA (software robots that handle repetitive tasks).

- Using AI tools to help with requirements, prototypes, test generation, documentation, code review, workflow design, or data analysis.

- Exposure to product management methods and agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog management (keeping the work list prioritized), and retrospectives (short team check-ins on what to improve).

- Practice writing user stories and acceptance criteria that are detailed enough for a team to act on.

- Creating wireframes, user flows, journey maps, process diagrams, or simple screen designs in tools such as Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, Visio, Jira, or Confluence.

- Familiarity with data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and tracking KPIs (the key numbers that show how well something is performing).

- Exposure to test planning, regression testing (rechecking that existing features still work), UAT coordination, defect triage, or production readiness checks.

- An ability to sit between business and technical teams, turning business needs into clear requirements and explaining technical limits back in plain terms.

- Strong written and verbal communication, with a user-first mindset and a knack for simplifying complex topics.

- Some grounding in Agile, Lean, design thinking, system thinking, or continuous improvement.

- An interest in growing into a product owner, AI product manager, business architect, digital transformation leader, or forward deployed product manager

Primary Program Responsibilities:

- Participate in and complete a one-year long, non-rotational training program while creating and adding value to assigned department. Receive job specific training, general training in banking, communication and leadership, and personalized coaching and feedback. Performance measures may include several objective test scores, peer and sponsor feedback from group projects, facilitator feedback, Leadership Development Manager-MDP feedback, Department Manager feedback, final assessment score, and year-end performance appraisal from Department Manager.

- Core Training - Participate in training throughout the one-year assignment to learn banking, basic financial skills, technical skills, and leadership/interpersonal skills. Develop a solid understanding of banking functions, processes, and operations.

- Group Projects - Participate in group project assignments, working with a team of their peers to build relationships within their teams as well as with project sponsors, internal and external contacts, and senior management. Teams make a presentation to senior management at the conclusion of each project providing recommendations and potential project solutions.

- On-the-Job Training - The fundamental skills taught in core training are combined with On-the-Job training based on the incumbent's assignment. Job specific training teaches departmental policies, procedures, systems, and products. Upon completion of MDP, all incumbents attain basic skills necessary to contribute as individual contributors and/or managers in their assigned department.

- Complete tasks in a manner that are compliant with applicable laws and regulations and/or that serve to help the Company be in compliance with laws and regulations that apply to the business line the position supports.

- Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite.

- Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

- Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.

- Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.

- Complete other related duties as assigned.

Program Scope of Responsibilities:

The Management Development Program is a non-rotational, one-year training program for recent college graduates where participants learn about sales, accounting, project management and leadership skills depending upon their career track. Various methods of training include classroom study, divisional orientations, and teamwork on group projects. These fundamentals are coupled with on-the-job training to allow for immediate application in the area for which the participant has been hired.

Program Education and Experience Required:

- Bachelor's Degree candidate at a school where M&T Bank recruits MDPs (or an MBA student with no work experience).

- Outstanding academic credentials (GPA of 3.0 or better).

- Up to 1 year of work experience.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Demonstrated interpersonal skills.

- Demonstrated analytical skills.

- Demonstrated computer skills.

- Demonstrated presentation skills.

- Demonstrated leadership abilities.

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $29.57 - $43.99 per hour. The pay rate specific to your location will fall within this range and is available from your recruiter.

jobs.title: Technology Operations Analyst SP - Data Center Services
jobs.description:
Your Impact

The primary purpose of this role is to provide technical support for technology products and applications, including computer hardware and software, telecommunications equipment, and networks operating in stores, supply chain facilities, and corporate office locations. This includes performing tracking and documentation by entering details of problems, status of service requests, and resolutions into the company incident management system. This role may also directly or indirectly support corporate initiatives or deployment projects.

This role works the hours and schedule required to support the enterprise and may be on call and/or work alternate schedules to meet department needs.

What You Will Do

-
Provides remote or in-person technical support for technology products and applications, including computer hardware and software, telecommunications equipment, and networks.

-
Attempts to resolve problems, then escalates problems as necessary to appropriate resources.

-
Analyzes and prioritizes incoming requests and alerts.

-
Tracks and documents problem details, service request status, and resolutions into the company incident management system. Monitors problem resolutions to achieve closure.

-
Interacts with third-party hardware and/or software vendors by initiating and supporting vendor services as necessary.

-
Identifies recurring problems and escalates to senior staff for prioritization and investigation.

-
Installs and/or upgrades hardware and software to set up and maintain computer systems.

-
Performs basic preventative maintenance and break/fix repairs on technology, including more complex devices.

-
Contributes to the knowledge repository for technical support; documents workarounds for problem records; compiles information related to new technology.

-
Performs system backups and ensures integrity of backup media and peripherals.

-
Participates in meetings with vendors to resolve service failures or issues

-
Identifies and suggests possible improvements on procedures.

Minimum Qualifications

-
Associate degree in computer science, computer information systems, or related field or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

-
2 years of IT experience in a support or operations environment working with personal computers or client/server platforms and/or hardware

Preferred Skills/Education

-
Experience working with third-party IT vendors and/or software/hardware suppliers

-
IT experience in the retail industry

-
Experience writing technical documentation or standard operating procedures related to IT technical support or deployment

About Lowe’s

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week, with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe's employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,700 home improvement stores, 530 branches and 130 distribution centers. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Company Description
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun — where everyone can succeed.

Job Description
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn's Data Science team turns member and customer behavior into product decisions across one of the world's largest professional networks. We design experiments, investigate metric movements, and partner with PM and Engineering to ship features that create real economic opportunity for members, including the next generation of AI-powered experiences.

We're hiring an early-career data scientist to join a product team and grow under the mentorship of more senior Data Science ICs. You'll be responsible for writing SQL and Python to investigate how members use the product, read and interpret A/B test results, build dashboards and analysis docs that inform real decisions, and learn the craft of experimentation on data at LinkedIn's scale. You’ll deep dive into the tracking and algorithms of our AI stacks and learn how to use agentic data science to understand these systems and create insights that drive impact. As you grow, you'll take on more ambiguous problems and shape the metrics our team uses.

Responsibilities:

-
Performs data-driven experiments and causal analyses to test and validate new product ideas or go-to-market strategies, develop ecosystem understanding, and monitor current products or systems.

-
Performs analyses to support the definition of metrics that leads to data-driven target setting and decision-making.

-
Leverage AI tools in day-to-day workflows to increase productivity

-
Develops and employs models and causal analyses (e.g., panel analysis, A/B testing) to help determine what drives metric relationships and create actionable insights within basic product domains.

-
Collaborates with relevant partners on defining metrics and frameworks for evaluating AI/LLM systems and agentic product performance.

-
Supports AI system roadmaps through assessing model performance.

-
Prototypes data solutions, and/or collaborates with relevant partners (e.g., Data Science teams, AI, Engineering) to operationalize, build, and validate scalable tools/applications/solutions for use by internal customers to convert data into insights at scale, with guidance.

-
Embeds data science best practices and principles through all phases of development of customized and/or scalable data solutions.

-
Provides consultation to partners on basic data questions to enable data democratization.

-
Understands and identifies patterns of user behavior leveraging data mining techniques and provides insights and data-informed recommendations to internal partners.

-
Creates compelling, data-centric stories based on analytical findings to support internal customers' decision-making.

Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:

-
Bachelor's Degree in in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Informatics, Statistics, or related field

-
1+ year of experience in data science (e.g., managing structured and unstructured data, applying statistical techniques and reporting results) OR equivalent experience.

-
Background in at least one programming language (eg. R, Python, Java, Ruby, Scala/Spark or Perl)

Preferred Qualifications:

-
Master's Degree or Doctorate in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Informatics, Statistics, or related field.

-
Experience with experimentation platforms, causal inference, product domain expertise or evaluating AI / LLM-powered features.

-
Written communication and structured thinking abilities

jobs.title: Fraud Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Business

LexisNexis® Risk Solutions provides customers with solutions and decision tools that assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing fraud detection. We use the power of data and advanced analytics to help our customers make better, timelier decisions. Our innovative solutions enable our clients to manage risks like identity theft, fraud, money laundering and terrorism, and prevent financial crimes. Our core mission is to ultimately help make communities safer and to protect those who may be vulnerable to fraud. Drawing from the collective expertise of our experienced team, we continuously evolve to stay a step ahead of fraudsters. Every day, as millions go about their lives, it's our behind-the-scenes efforts that ensure their security, giving them the confidence to trust and engage online without fear of being de-frauded.

About the Team

LexisNexis® Risk Solutions helps organizations make better decisions by leveraging data, advanced analytics, and technology to evaluate and predict risk, detect fraud, and combat financial crime. Our solutions empower customers across banking, financial services, and e-commerce to address challenges such as identity theft, account takeover, money laundering, social engineering, and other emerging fraud threats.

Our Fraud and Identity Professional Services team works directly with leading financial institutions and global organizations to optimize fraud prevention strategies and maximize the value of LexisNexis Risk Solutions products. We are a collaborative team of consultants, analysts, and subject matter experts who combine technical expertise, data-driven insights, and industry knowledge to help clients reduce risk, improve customer experiences, and stay ahead of evolving fraud trends.

About the Role

The Fraud Data Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and analytical consultant, supporting large banking, financial services, and e-commerce clients in the implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of fraud and identity solutions. This role blends data analytics, fraud investigation, technical consulting, and client engagement.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, customer-focused, and passionate about solving complex fraud and risk challenges. You will work closely with clients to assess fraud patterns, analyze performance data, develop detection strategies, and provide actionable recommendations that improve fraud prevention outcomes while minimizing friction for legitimate customers.

Responsibilities

- Review suspicious activity, fraud alerts, and complex fraud cases to identify emerging risks, trends, and vulnerabilities.

- Analyze large datasets to build, optimize, and maintain fraud detection rules, models, and workflows that improve fraud prevention and operational efficiency.

- Conduct root cause analyses to investigate client issues, identify contributing factors, and develop effective solutions.

- Deliver impactful analyses and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders through presentations, reports, and client consultations.

- Advise clients on best practices for implementing and optimizing ThreatMetrix® Digital Identity Network, Digital Device Profiling (DDP), and other LexisNexis Risk Solutions products.

- Partner with clients to improve fraud mitigation strategies while balancing customer experience and operational objectives.

- Perform proof-of-concept analyses and demonstrate measurable business value through data-driven insights.

- Collaborate closely with fraud managers, risk analysts, developers, project managers, and other customer stakeholders to support solution adoption and performance optimization.

- Build and maintain strong client relationships by serving as a trusted consultant and subject matter expert.

- Develop reports, dashboards, and analytical deliverables using SQL, Excel, Python, R, and other analytics tools.

- Research emerging fraud techniques, cybersecurity trends, and financial crime risks to provide proactive recommendations.

- Support internal teams with product feedback, solution enhancements, and client-related insights.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical, analytical, or related field.

- 3+ years of experience supporting customer-facing technology, analytics, or fraud prevention solutions.

- 3+ years of experience working within financial services, banking, fintech, payments, risk management, or e-commerce environments.

- 3+ years of experience performing advanced analytics using Python (including pandas, scikit-learn, and matplotlib), R, or similar analytical tools.

- Strong proficiency with SQL and Excel for data analysis, reporting, and performance monitoring.

- Experience investigating fraud, financial crimes, or suspicious activity, including account takeover, card-not-present fraud, money laundering, and social engineering attacks.

- Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and solve complex business and technical challenges.

- Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business-focused recommendations.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

- Strong customer service mindset with a passion for helping clients achieve measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with fraud prevention, digital identity, authentication, risk management, or financial crime solutions.

- Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, including browser fingerprinting, device intelligence, public key infrastructure (PKI), computer networking, and device authentication.

- Experience with ThreatMetrix® solutions or similar fraud and identity platforms.

- Familiarity with machine learning, predictive analytics, statistical modeling, scorecard development, or graph analytics.

- Experience developing fraud detection strategies and risk-based decisioning frameworks.

- Knowledge of AML, KYC, fraud operations, and regulatory compliance practices.

- Experience working directly with enterprise banking, financial services, or large e-commerce organizations.

- Ability to influence client strategy and serve as a trusted advisor across both business and technical teams.

jobs.title: Data Product Analyst
jobs.description:
Data Product Analyst

Location: Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Data Product Analyst to help transform business needs into trusted, usable data products that power reporting, analytics, and better business decisions. In this role, you’ll help bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data products are thoughtfully designed, well-documented, and built to solve real business problems.

You’ll have the opportunity to contribute throughout the data product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering to testing, documentation, and ongoing improvement. If you’re curious about data, enjoy solving problems, and like bringing people together to turn ideas into action, this is an opportunity to build your expertise while making a meaningful impact.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Translate Business Needs into Actionable Requirements: Partner with business stakeholders to understand their goals, reporting needs, workflows, and data challenges. Document requirements and translate discovery findings into clear user stories, development tickets, and acceptance criteria.

- Support Data Product Design and Development: Collaborate with Data Product leads, reporting teams, and data engineers to define data needs, business rules, definitions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

- Build Trusted Product Documentation: Write and maintain product requirements documents (PRDs), data contracts, business definitions, and usage guidance. Partner with Data Governance and engineering teams to document data structures, quality expectations, ownership, and refresh requirements.

- Validate Data Products and Deliver Quality: Use basic SQL and reporting tools to explore data, investigate discrepancies, and validate results. Prepare and execute user acceptance testing (UAT), coordinate business participation, document defects, and confirm fixes meet acceptance criteria.

- Strengthen Stakeholder Alignment: Communicate requirements, proposed designs, testing results, and product demonstrations to technical and business audiences. Keep partners informed of open questions, issues, and progress.

- Identify Opportunities for Improvement: Monitor product usage, performance, and user feedback to identify issues and opportunities to make data products more accurate, accessible, and useful.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll work closely with Reporting, Data Governance, and Data Product leads, business stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers to bring data products from discovery through delivery. This is a collaborative, cross-functional role where you’ll help connect business priorities with technical execution, build shared understanding, and ensure the products we deliver are trusted and useful. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn from experienced partners as you deepen your understanding of our data ecosystem and product practices.

What You’ll Bring

- A college degree.

- At least two years of experience working alongside data or analytics teams in a business, analytical, technical, or product support capacity.

- Basic SQL skills, including the ability to query, filter, join, and summarize data.

- Experience working with databases or reporting and business intelligence tools.

- Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into clear, organized documentation.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data concepts to business audiences and communicate business needs to technical teams.

- A collaborative approach to working with stakeholders, analysts, and data engineers.

- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to organize work and follow through on open items.

What Will Help You Thrive

- Hands-on experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering.

- Experience writing user stories, development tickets, acceptance criteria, or product requirements documents.

- Experience supporting user acceptance testing or validating reports, datasets, or data pipelines.

- Familiarity with data governance concepts, including data quality, business definitions, ownership, lineage, and data contracts.

- Experience using tools for project tracking, documentation, or data cataloging.

- Curiosity about how data products are designed, developed, governed, and used to solve business problems.

- Comfort using AI tools to support discovery, requirements gathering, data product design, prototyping, and documentation, while validating outputs for accuracy and ensuring responsible data use.

- Experience designing or building AI agent workflows and automations to streamline tasks, connect tools or data sources, and support business processes.

- A proactive mindset, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate open questions and evolving requirements.

What Success Looks Like

- Business needs are clearly captured and translated into actionable requirements, user stories, and development tickets.

- Data products are well-documented, with clear definitions, ownership, usage guidance, and quality expectations that help business users understand and trust the data.

- Testing identifies issues early, discrepancies are resolved collaboratively, and delivered products meet agreed-upon acceptance criteria.

- Business and technical partners stay aligned through clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, and timely follow-through.

- Product usage and stakeholder feedback inform improvements that make data products more valuable, accessible, and effective.

We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that’s curious, creative, and always ready to roll up our sleeves and get things done. You’ll work alongside smart, driven people who care about doing great work — and about helping each other succeed.

We believe the best ideas come from different perspectives, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where people feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to make an impact. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Incident Detection & Characterization: Perform computer network incident detection and response activities to detect, correlate, identify, and characterize anomalous activity indicative of enterprise threats.
