Company Description
By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard Medical School?

Harvard Medical School's mission is to nurture a diverse, inclusive community dedicated to alleviating suffering and improving health and well-being for all through excellence in teaching and learning, discovery and scholarship, and service and leadership.

You’ll be at the heart of biomedical discovery, education, and innovation, working alongside world-renowned faculty and a community dedicated to improving human health. This is more than a job - it’s an opportunity to shape the future of medicine.

Job Description
Harvard Medical School Information Systems seeks a Business Systems Analyst professional skilled in leading requirements elicitation, journey mapping, business process redesign, and user-centered design.

This position will support the Harvard Integrated Life Sciences (HILS) Administration and will design, develop, and implement solutions to streamline HILS operations and data collection processes. The position will collaborate regularly with the HILS Director of Academic Administration and Education Staff to translate business needs into technology strategies and systems requirements. The position will participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) from project inception through ongoing production support, including data analysis, testing, and training.

The position will require experience with desktop, mobile, or web-based software applications and relational databases with a service delivery approach. Familiarity with Peoplesoft Campus Solutions and/or Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Suite and/or Oracle Analytics will be a plus.

jobs.title: Military SkillBridge – Social Impact Data & Insights Analyst
jobs.location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jobs.description:
Military SkillBridge – Social Impact Data & Insights Analyst

Description -

Military Bridge participants must be active-duty service members approved to participate through the Department of Defense SkillBridge program and Hiring Our Heroes.

The Social Impact Data & Insights Analyst turns HP’s volunteering, giving and HP LIFE data into insights that support the commercial organization. Based within HP Inc’s Social Impact team through HP’s Military Bridge Program, this role helps commercial teams demonstrate HP’s social impact capabilities in customer opportunities that include social good requirements or priorities.

Working primarily with finalized datasets, the analyst applies strong data mining and analytical skills to uncover patterns, answer business questions and develop clear findings, visualizations and recommendations. Military experience analyzing intelligence, logistics, operational or mission-performance data is directly relevant.

Core Responsibilities

Data Mining and Advanced Analysis

- Mine finalized volunteering, giving and HP LIFE datasets to identify meaningful patterns, trends and connections.

- Analyze results across geographies, time periods and program segments to answer specific business questions.

- Apply appropriate statistical methods to explore relationships and explain differences in program results.

Commercial Insights and Evidence

- Translate customer priorities and commercial questions into focused analyses of HP’s social impact programs.

- Develop reusable analytical summaries and evidence that teams can use in customer conversations and proposals.

- Explain what findings support, including the relevant time period, assumptions and limits of interpretation.

Data Visualization and Storytelling

- Create clear charts, dashboards and presentation materials that make complex findings easy to understand.

- Translate analysis into practical recommendations for colleagues without a technical background.

- Connect program metrics to customer questions while preserving the meaning and context of the data.

Reusable Tools and Team Collaboration

- Work closely with Anshu Grover and Mary Baskerville to prioritize questions, interpret findings and develop recommendations.

- Build reusable analytical tools, queries or templates so the team can update and extend the work.

- Document analytical methods, calculations and assumptions so others can reproduce and use the findings.

Technical and Analytical Competencies

Data Analysis

- Data mining, segmentation and trend analysis

- Statistical analysis and interpretation

- Advanced spreadsheet analysis, including formulas and pivot tables

Analytical Tools and Communication

- Analytical or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R

- Data visualization and clear explanations of findings

- Reusable analysis and documentation of methods

Leadership Competencies

- Analytical curiosity and structured problem solving

- Judgment about the meaning and limits of findings

- Clear communication with technical and nontechnical colleagues

- Collaboration and responsiveness to business questions

- Ownership of deliverables and willingness to learn

Education and Experience

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience analyzing substantial datasets and using findings to support decisions. Military experience in intelligence, logistics, operations or mission-performance analysis is directly applicable.

- Advanced spreadsheet skills and demonstrated capability with analytical or visualization tools.

- Relevant military training, education or demonstrated work experience in analytics, statistics, operations research, intelligence or a related discipline.

- Experience explaining analytical findings through written reports, briefings, charts or other materials for decision-makers.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using SQL, Python or R to query data or automate analysis.

- Experience building dashboards or reusable analytical models.

- Interest in applying analysis to social impact and business opportunities.

jobs.location: Vancouver, Washington, United States of America
jobs.description:
CSS Service Insights Analyst

Description -

The CSS Service Insights Analyst is responsible for delivering advanced analytical insights that drive business growth, improve customer engagement, and support strategic decision-making across the Services organization. The role analyzes large, complex datasets using SQL, Python, statistical methods, and AI-assisted analytical techniques to identify customer behaviors, performance trends, and business opportunities. Working closely with cross-functional business, product, and data engineering teams, the analyst develops measurement frameworks, defines analytical requirements, and translates data into actionable recommendations. The position creates executive-ready dashboards, visualizations, and data-driven narratives that influence product strategy, customer experience, and monetization initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical problem-solving skills, effective stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to transform complex data into meaningful business outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Support growth initiatives and strategic programs through experiment design, performance measurement, customer insight development, and AI-assisted analytical techniques that improve business understanding and decision-making.

- Partner with customer engagement and cross-functional business teams to identify opportunities that increase subscriptions, customer engagement, retention, and product purchases through data-driven insights.

- Define measurement frameworks, analytical requirements, and data product specifications, partnering closely with data engineering teams to develop scalable data assets that enable advanced analytics and business insights.

- Deliver actionable insights by synthesizing data from multiple sources, including enterprise data warehouses, customer research, surveys, and behavioral data. Develop hypotheses, validate findings, and recommend actions that influence business strategy.

- Create compelling data stories and executive-ready presentations that clearly communicate analytical findings, business opportunities, and recommendations to stakeholders at all organizational levels.

- Apply statistical methods, machine learning techniques, and AI-enabled analytical capabilities, where appropriate, to uncover patterns, explain business performance, and support data-driven decision-making.

- Continuously identify new opportunities to leverage data, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve analytical efficiency, enhance business insights, and support strategic business objectives.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- Bachelor’s or Graduate degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Engineering, or Economics. Graduate degree preferred.

- 7+ years of analytic work experience with an emphasis on email and in-app campaigns and experiences in support of digital products.

- 3+ years working collaboratively with product teams.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIRED

Analytical Tools

- Expertise in business intelligence and analytics platforms, including Power BI, Looker, ThoughtSpot, Google Analytics, and other visualization tools used to transform complex data into actionable business insights.

- Advanced SQL proficiency with experience developing complex queries, optimizing data retrieval, and analyzing large datasets; proficiency in Python for analytical workflows, automation, and advanced data analysis.

- Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks SQL, Amazon Redshift, and modern cloud-based data warehouse technologies.

- Familiarity with AI-enabled analytical tools that enhance data exploration, insight generation, and analyst productivity while maintaining strong analytical rigor and validation.

Analytical Skills

- Demonstrated expertise in quantitative analysis with the ability to transform complex, large-scale datasets into meaningful business insights, strategic recommendations, and measurable outcomes.

- Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, frame complex business problems, perform exploratory analysis with minimal direction, and develop structured analytical approaches to answer open-ended business questions.

- Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, multivariate experiments, and campaign performance across digital channels—including email, mobile applications, web experiences to measure impact and support data-driven decision-making.

- Strong understanding of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques, including logistic regression, generalized linear models, decision trees, clustering, factor analysis, and other predictive or descriptive analytical methods.

- Experience leveraging AI-assisted analytical capabilities to accelerate insight generation, summarize analytical findings, and improve decision support while applying sound statistical methods and business judgment to validate results.

Cross-Org Skills

- Effective Communication

- Results Orientation

- Learning Agility

- Digital Fluency

- Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope

- Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.

Complexity

- Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.

-

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management

Comp and Benefits

The pay range for this role is $105,050.00 - 152,350.00 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits:

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

Health insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

Long term/short term disability insurance

Employee assistance program

Flexible spending account

Life insurance

Generous time off policies, including;

4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure

11 paid holidays

Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

jobs.title: Capital Markets Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About GoodLeap:
GoodLeap is a technology company delivering best-in-class financing and software products for sustainable solutions, from solar panels and batteries to energy-efficient HVAC, heat pumps, roofing, windows, and more. Over 1 million homeowners have benefited from our simple, fast, and frictionless technology that makes the adoption of these products more affordable, accessible, and easier to understand. Thousands of professionals deploying home efficiency and solar solutions rely on GoodLeap’s proprietary, AI-powered applications and developer tools to drive more transparent customer communication, deeper business intelligence, and streamlined payment and operations. Our platform has led to more than $30 billion in financing for sustainable solutions since 2018.
 
GoodLeap is also proud to support our award-winning nonprofit, GivePower, which is building and deploying life-saving water and clean electricity systems, changing the lives of more than 1.6 million people across Africa, Asia, and South America.


The Capital Markets Strategy & Operations Analyst supports the funding and sale of GoodLeap’s consumer finance loans by operationalizing revolving credit facilities, whole loan purchase agreements, and asset-backed securitizations. The Analyst manages day-to-day loan funding and sales activity, supports and maintains GoodLeap’s investor relationships, and works directly with lenders, capital partners, and their third-party vendors. Reporting to the Vice President of Capital Markets Strategy & Operations, the Analyst collaborates closely with Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:
- Initiates whole loan sales by determining loan pool eligibility against investor criteria, then preparing and delivering loan schedules, loan agreements, and underwriting documentation to investors.

- Serves as a point of contact for investors and their vendors during loan reviews, partnering with Product, Engineering, Servicing, and Underwriting to answer questions, evaluate exceptions, and resolve them.

- Manages day-to-day activity on GoodLeap’s revolving warehouse credit facilities, including borrowing base calculations, funding requests, and covenant compliance monitoring.

- Develops and maintains Excel-based models, including the Sales Engine and Funding Engine, and drives automation by identifying process improvements, defining requirements, and helping build and maintain capital markets software solutions.

- Analyzes alternatives, makes recommendations to management, and implements consumer finance funding and sales strategies.

- Leads new investor onboarding and prepares and analyzes ongoing investor and management reporting, flagging trends and issues for leadership.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities:
- At least 2 years of experience in financial modeling and analysis, along with at least 2 years of experience in capital markets, treasury, or finance

- Bachelor's degree in business, economics, finance, or a related field required

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Databricks, and AI tools (e.g., Claude), with the technical ability to manipulate and analyze large datasets and apply statistical methods to them

- Ability to clearly communicate findings, both verbally and in writing, to management, investors, and other external parties

- Solid grasp of capital markets, finance, accounting, and business operations concepts

- Experience in financial services, consumer finance, fintech, or renewable energy finance strongly preferred

- Collaborates effectively across Capital Markets, Legal, Servicing, Underwriting, Product, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, and Business Development while representing GoodLeap professionally and building lasting relationships with funding and capital partners

- Curious, tenacious problem-solver, and strong team player

Compensation: $95,000–$105,000 annually, plus bonus.

This job description is meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and other skills required for the position. jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role

As an L6 Data Scientist supporting Sales, Brand & Dealer, you will lead the execution of one or more workstreams within an AI, machine learning, or data science product. You will build deep technical expertise under the guidance of the product’s lead scientist while actively contributing to product decisions, methodological direction, and the development of high-impact solutions.

What You Will Do

- Lead the execution of assigned AI, machine learning, or data science workstreams from methodology through delivery.

- Contribute to product decisions and help shape the ideation, design, and development of analytical methods and solutions.

- Develop high-quality code that is methodologically sound, maintainable, scalable, and operationally robust.

- Explore and apply new methods, technologies, and approaches to expand the product’s technical capabilities.

- Deliver results on time while managing risks and maintaining methodological and operational quality.

- Partner cross-functionally with data engineering, software delivery, product delivery teams, business units, and other stakeholders to drive product development and business outcomes.

- Translate complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, assumptions, and risks into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders and leaders.

- Present workstream progress, findings, and business impact to technical and business audiences.

- Demonstrated use of innovative methodologies and approaches to solving business problems, resulting in meaningful business impact;

- Experience across multiple AI/ML and analytics domains (LLMs, forecasting, deep learning, operations research, prescriptive & predictive methods, etc.);

- Expertise in Python and other cloud-based data science platforms (Databricks preferred), and proficiency in SQL;

- Experience with generative AI tools and platforms such as Cursor, GitHub and/or Microsoft Copilot, Glean, Databricks Genie, etc.

- Strong presentation and communication skills; and

- M.S. or Ph.D. in operations research, engineering, computer science, applied statistics, economics, physics, or related field. Equivalent additional experience may substitute for advanced degree.

- Experience contributing to AI, machine learning, or data science products from concept through production delivery.

- Experience influencing product decisions and shaping methodological direction.

- Experience building solutions that are reliable, maintainable, scalable, and operationally ready.

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt.

We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

The Role

The Lab Quality Engineer is a recognized technical contributor and resource in Engine Dyno Testing. The position requires the ability to address the broadest and most complex problems.

What You’ll Do

- Provide guidance to the engineering team for the instrumentation, equipment and software required for compliant testing

- Provide guidance and support to laboratory operations and quality teams to relative to the processes and procedures required to ensure compliant testing

- Lead innovation activities in the Quality Department

- Complete Quality systems related activities

- Train team members on tools and processes

- Maintain documents related to Standard Work for projects

- Review data and perform statistical analysis

- Maintain status of department, projects, and Business Plan Deployment related tasks

- Maintain quality reports related to laboratory and operations, issuing monthly reports for status

- Refer to the employee training documents maintained and held by the supervisor for specifics as to required job training

jobs.title: Payments Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

Who we want

This is a role for someone who wants to work on a hard problem, deliver real impact and be pushed to be the best version of themselves. As a Payments Operations Analyst, you’ll be part of the Payments team within Claims Operations, reporting to the Payments Operations lead. You’ll help run and improve the operations that move money to our members every week, working directly with the partners who receive it. Your work will directly shape the member experience as Garner grows and launches new ways to reward members for choosing great care.

What you will do

- Run day-to-day payment operations, including weekly payment cycles, funding, and the checks and controls that keep member payments accurate and on time

- Serve as a point of contact for external payment partners, working through file delivery, funding, error reports, and issue resolution

- Investigate payment issues end to end: analyze error reports, find the root cause, and drive fixes with internal teams and partners

- Support new client and partner launches, setting up payment workflows and confirming everything works once real payments start flowing

- Analyze and resolve payment questions and issues raised by clients, members, and internal teams, within our service standards

- Help maintain and improve the reporting, trackers, and dashboards that show the status of all payments work

- Contribute to internal tools, documentation, and process improvements, using automation and AI tools to make recurring work faster and more reliable

- Raise risks early and keep the right people informed, so issues are resolved before they reach members

What we're looking for

- 1-4 years of experience in operations, analytics, or a similar role; experience in payments, fintech, payroll, benefits, or healthcare operations is a plus, not a requirement

- Experience working with external partners or vendors to troubleshoot and resolve issues

- An analytical mindset with a keen attention to detail; you dig for the root cause before jumping to a fix

- Comfort working with financial data and reconciliations in Excel/Google Sheets

- Familiarity with file-based integrations (for example, SFTP, encryption, or file mapping) is a plus

- Clear, proactive communication with internal teams and external partners, and comfort using AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- A combination of high ownership mentality and detail orientation, including sound judgment and rigor on high-stakes, sensitive operational work, that has resulted in a track record of delivering operational initiatives on tight deadlines

- A willingness to “roll up your sleeves” and do whatever is necessary to ensure company success

- A methodical problem-solver who drives continuous improvement, readily gives and absorbs feedback, and operates with individual accountability and integrity as part of a mission-driven team.

- A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team’s metrics.

Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Compensation Transparency:

The base salary range for this position is $65,000 - $78,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more.

jobs.description:
What you’ll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

About the role:

We are seeking an exceptional AI-Native Data Analyst to join Garner and drive how data shapes business decisions at scale. You'll be the person the business trusts to turn fuzzy questions into the metrics, dashboards, and deep-dive analyses that decisions actually get made on — owning that work end-to-end.

Where you will work:

This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

What you will do:

- Own KPIs and dashboards end-to-end. Build, maintain, and govern key KPIs and dashboards across business domains, managing the full lifecycle of analytics projects from scoping to delivery.

- Be a thought partner on measurement. Partner with stakeholders to define how success is measured across Garner's products and operations.

- Build scalable data pipelines. Collaborate with the data engineering team to create maintainable pipelines that power reliable reporting.

- Develop deep domain expertise. Build a strong understanding of your analytical domain so you can independently drive meaningful insights.

- Close reporting gaps. Identify where coverage is missing and proactively develop new dashboards and insights to fill them.

- Raise the bar on data practices. Advocate for best practices in visualization, documentation, metric consistency, and stakeholder communication across teams.

- Answer high-stakes, ambiguous questions. Run deep-dive investigations into complex business problems — the kind of analysis leadership uses to make strategic calls.

The ideal candidate has:

- 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar data-centric role.

- Cross-functional translation. Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into data-driven solutions and to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders.

- Autonomy and ownership. Comfortable working independently and owning reporting projects end-to-end.

- Automation mindset. Attention to detail with a bias toward automation and scalability over one-off work.

- AI Nativity. Comfort with and excitement about building analytics, building dashboards, and validating results by harnessing the power of AI agents.

- Making data accessible. A track record of getting stakeholders trustworthy, self-serve access to the information they need. Experience with a BI/visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) helps — but the outcome matters more than the specific tool.

- Modern data stack. Hands-on with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse) and SQL at scale; experience with dbt strongly preferred — you'll partner with Data Management in governed pipelines, not just consume their outputs.

- A desire to be part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact as Data Scientist II supporting mission critical work on an exciting program. GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects, build your skills, and grow a rewarding career.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Human Performance Data Scientist II supporting our customer, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Data Scientist II Technician joining our team.

The Human Performance (HP) Data Scientist II supports the program by applying advanced analytical skills to optimize the readiness, resiliency, and performance of Special Operations Forces (SOF) personnel. The position focuses on human performance insights rather than general data science functions. The role works directly with SOF HP staff, with priority on SOF Operators and Direct Combat Support personnel, to evaluate physical, psychological, cognitive, and social performance indicators.

HOW A DATA SCIENTIST II WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

- The HP Data Scientist II is responsible for entering, cleaning, and analyzing HP data collected through program initiatives.

- Works in collaboration with performance teams and the Government biostatistician, the HP Data Scientist II provides subject matter expertise in program evaluation, research methodologies, and applied performance analytics.

- Partners with strength coaches, dietitians, athletic trainers, physical therapists, psychologists, and cognitive specialists to identify data collection opportunities that support operational readiness and force preservation.

- Supports development of performance dashboards, readiness trends, return to duty outcomes, and longitudinal monitoring products that directly inform commanders and HP leaders.

- Prepares reports and presentations that communicate performance trends, risk indicators, and program impact in clear and actionable formats for leadership.

- Receives access to Government systems for the purpose of HP data entry, management, and analysis.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

EDUCATION: Master’s or Doctoral degree in quantitative science, social science or related discipline.

- Must have at least 3 years of research experience in academic, social services, government, healthcare or laboratory settings

- Advanced proficiency in statistical software such as SPSS, SAS, or R, with emphasis on applied research and performance analytics.

- Demonstrate advanced proficiency through prior work within performance research, sport science, military HP programs, or similar environments where continuous data collection and evaluation occur.

- Proficiency is also demonstrated through a record of scientific publications or applied HP research.

- Possesses excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and at least three years of experience working in HP, government, healthcare, or research settings.

- Proficient with the suite of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel and Access.

LOCATION: Various CONUS SITES

CLEARANCE: Ability to obtain and maintain Secret or Top-Secret Clearance.

This is a contingent posting, expected to start in 2026.

LOCATION: Various CONUS SITES

We think. We act. We deliver. There is no challenge we can’t turn into opportunity. And our work depends on an Data Science Advisor joining our team to support customer activities.

The Data Science Advisor (DSA) leads the POTFF Enterprise Data and Analytics function and serves as the primary analytical advisor to the Enterprise POTFF Director, Domain Leads, and the Human Factors Council (HFC) on research methodologies, data collection strategies, and program evaluation. The DSA coordinates and directs the technical work of the Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Senior Data Scientists under their purview, subject to Government direction; sets the analytical agenda in response to Government priorities; ensures that methods are sound, reproducible, and defensible; and delivers findings to Government leadership in a form suitable for decision-making.

HOW A DATA SCIENCE ADVISOR (DSA) WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

- Serve as the lead for the Enterprise Data and Analytics function: plan, prioritize, assign, and review the work of the Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Senior Data Scientists under their purview in response to Government-directed requirements, and manage the analytical backlog using an Agile or comparable framework.

- Serve as the primary analytical advisor to the Enterprise POTFF Director, Domain Leads, and the HFC regarding research methodologies, data collection strategies, study design, and program evaluation.

- Design and oversee Government-directed program evaluations, analyses, and experiments that measure the validity, efficacy, and Return on Investment (ROI) of POTFF interventions; select appropriate statistical models and study designs; and ensure data quality and defensible, reproducible methodology.

- Establish and maintain the team’s analytical standards, data governance practices, reporting methodologies, and performance-measurement frameworks in coordination with Government data governance, and ensure compliance with DoW Impact Level 5 (IL5), HIPAA, Privacy Act, and applicable DoW artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) policy.

- Translate Government priorities into analytical requirements; support the strategic planning process for POTFF programs with data-driven decision support; and support the development of enterprise performance measures, executive dashboards, and readiness metrics.

- Prepare and deliver reports, briefings, and decision-support products that accurately convey findings, limitations, and recommendations to Government leadership.

- Provide consultation to supported units and POTFF staff on opportunities and methods for capturing data on POTFF programs and initiatives, and on the interpretation of analytical products.

- Coordinate with the USSOCOM Enterprise Data Team and other Government data organizations on data access, standards, and shared platforms, as directed by the Government.

- Perform advanced analysis personally when required, and maintain currency in statistical analysis, data science, AI/ML, data engineering, and visualization technologies.

- Coordinate and advise on the training and professional development of the data science personnel under their purview, subject to Government approval.

EDUCATION: Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline, including but not limited to statistics, biostatistics, mathematics, applied mathematics, data science, operations research, computer science, engineering, physics, economics or econometrics, epidemiology, geospatial science or geoinformatics, or psychology or another behavioral science with a quantitative-methods concentration, with documented coursework or professional application in statistics, programming, and quantitative analysis; or a bachelor’s degree in such a discipline with the additional experience stated under Required Minimum Experience/Skills below.

- With a Master’s degree: minimum of seven (7) years of professional experience applying data science, statistics, or research methods to real-world problems, including at least two (2) years supervising or leading analysts. With a bachelor’s degree: minimum of ten (10) years of such experience, including at least two (2) years supervising or leading analysts. In either path, at least three (3) years must be hands-on practice as a data scientist, statistician, or equivalent analyst personally performing the analyses, rather than supervising or advising. Degree-program work does not count toward the Data Science Advisor experience requirement.

- Demonstrated expertise in research methods, study design, and program evaluation, including quantitative and qualitative methods, sufficient to design defensible evaluations and to advise senior leaders on their limitations.

- Advanced proficiency in Python or R and in SQL, and demonstrated experience delivering statistical or predictive models and decision-support products to organizational leadership.

- Demonstrated supervisory experience leading a data science, analytics, or research team, and experience running a program or project of comparable scope.

- Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with senior leadership, negotiate complex issues, develop a range of alternatives when there is no single solution, and establish and maintain good working relations with stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Desired (not required): Experience with human performance, sports science, health, clinical, or biomedical data or research.

- Desired (not required): Agile or Scrum certification (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner) or comparable training.

- Desired (not required): A doctoral degree in one of the disciplines listed above, or a history of peer-reviewed publications.

- Desired (not required): Familiarity with the Government-furnished technology stack (e.g., Databricks and Apache Spark, Power BI, Microsoft Power Platform) and with Palantir Foundry.

GDIT is your place. You make it your own by embracing autonomy, seizing opportunity, and being rusted to deliver your best every day.

We think. We act. We deliver. There is no challenge we can’t turn into opportunity. And our work depends on a Data Scientist joining our team to support customer activities.

The Data Scientist applies statistical analysis, data mining, and machine learning to human performance, behavioral health, and readiness data to produce actionable insights, forecasts, and decision-support products for the POTFF enterprise. The Data Scientist frames analytical questions with Government stakeholders, prepares and explores data, selects and applies appropriate methods, validates results, and communicates findings to technical and non-technical audiences through reports, briefings, and visual analytics built on the Government-furnished technology stack.

HOW DATA SCIENTIST WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

- Query, clean, transform, and prepare data from the Government-designated Human Performance System of Record (e.g., HPDMS) and other Government-approved sources for analysis, using the curated datasets maintained by the Data Engineer where available.

- Develop, validate, and document predictive and prescriptive models, forecasting methods, clustering, and other advanced statistical techniques to generate actionable forecasts regarding operator readiness, injury risk, program efficacy, and performance optimization, as directed by the Government.

- Support text-heavy use cases using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques (e.g., cleaning, entity extraction, classification) to analyze unstructured clinical or survey data and apply Large Language Model (LLM) and agent-style workflows only within Government-approved tools and datasets.

- Develop, deploy, and maintain visual analytics, dashboards, and executive reports using Government-furnished tools (e.g., Power BI, including semantic modeling and DAX), and integrate data products into low-code operational workflows (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform) where directed.

- Support Government-designed analyses and experiments that measure the validity, efficacy, and Return on Investment (ROI) of POTFF interventions, including computation of program-efficacy metrics as directed by the Government.

- Automate recurring analyses and the generation of required monthly and quarterly reports, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy.

- Document data sources, transformations, assumptions, methods, and validation procedures so that analyses are reproducible and can be transferred to other personnel.

- Communicate complex concepts, methods, and results clearly to non-technical command leadership and to clinical and performance staff, in writing and in briefings.

- Collaborate with embedded clinical and performance staff to identify opportunities for capturing data and improving the quality of input into Government systems.

- Maintain rigorous data quality, security, and privacy controls, including DoW Impact Level 5 (IL5), HIPAA, and Privacy Act protocols, in all analytic work.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline, including but not limited to statistics, biostatistics, mathematics, applied mathematics, data science, operations research, computer science, engineering, physics, economics or econometrics, epidemiology, geospatial science or geoinformatics, or psychology or another behavioral science with a quantitative-methods concentration, with documented coursework or professional application in statistics, programming, and quantitative analysis.

- Minimum of one (1) year of experience applying data science or statistical methods to real-world problems. A Bachelor’s degree program that included documented internship, cooperative-education, capstone, thesis, or project work applying data science methods to real-world data satisfies this requirement.

- Demonstrated proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning, and in SQL for querying relational data, demonstrated through professional work experience or degree-program projects.

- Working knowledge of applied statistics and of supervised and unsupervised machine-learning methods.

- Ability to prepare and clean data for analysis, including familiarity with data engineering concepts (ETL/ELT, data modeling basics, reproducible workflows, and version control with Git).

- Experience producing visual analytics and reports for decision-makers (Power BI preferred).

- Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders and translate mission needs into analytical questions and outputs.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience with Databricks and Apache Spark (PySpark) or a comparable distributed processing system.

- Familiarity with NLP and LLM use cases, including text preparation, evaluation datasets, and governance considerations.

- Familiarity with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps and Power Automate) and with Palantir Foundry.

- Experience with web application development technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Django, or ASP.NET Core) or with deploying analytics into applications. Software engineering or web-development experience is not required.

- Experience with human performance, sports science, health, clinical, or biomedical data.

Position Summary

The Cyber Operations Analyst II supports a DHS agency’s national cyber operations center by receiving, triaging, routing, and tracking cyber incidents and operational requests. Working with watch officers, senior analysts, and government personnel, the analyst maintains situational awareness, supports shift transitions, and helps ensure consistent, documented operations.

The analyst also supports adoption of modernized workflows and AI-assisted triage tools by using them in daily operations, validating outputs, and providing feedback to improve effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

Event Intake, Triage & Routing

- Receive incident reports, information requests, and operational tasking through the center’s intake process.

- Triage and categorize events using established procedures and escalation criteria.

- Route events to appropriate teams and track them through resolution.

- Maintain accurate case records and classification markings.

Situational Awareness & Shift Operations

- Monitor operational feeds, dashboards, and collaboration tools.

- Support shift turnover packages, operational summaries, and leadership reporting.

- Assist with surge and crisis response activities as required.

Coordination & Information Sharing

- Coordinate with government, critical infrastructure, and private-sector partners.

- Prepare and track stakeholder notifications.

- Support cross-functional response efforts during significant incidents.

Data Quality & Process Improvement

- Apply data quality and governance standards to incident records and escalations.

- Follow and help maintain SOPs and playbooks.

- Review AI-assisted triage outputs and identify errors before escalation.

- Recommend workflow and process improvements.

Required Qualifications

- Degree, certification, or technical training in Cybersecurity, IT, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience in cyber operations, SOC, incident management, or watch floor environments.

- Experience with incident triage, escalation, and ticket/case management systems.

- Working knowledge of networking, common attack techniques, and MITRE ATT&CK.

- Strong written communication skills for reports and notifications.

- Ability to work assigned shifts and support surges when required.

- Active Top Secret clearance with eligibility for TS/SCI access.

- Ability to work onsite at DHS Headquarters and other National Capital Region locations.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting national-level cyber operations centers, fusion centers, or DHS/CISA, NSA, FBI, or USCYBERCOM environments.

- Familiarity with OT/ICS environments, including SCADA, PLC, and DCS technologies.

- Knowledge of NCISS or similar scoring frameworks.

- Experience with SIEM, SOAR, ServiceNow, or comparable platforms.

- Experience with Palantir Foundry or enterprise analytics tools.

- Experience using AI-assisted or automated triage capabilities.

- Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCIA, or similar certifications.

- Knowledge of federal incident reporting requirements and timelines.

jobs.description:
At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose.

Position Overview:

Freddie Mac’s Investments & Capital Markets Division is currently seeking a Quantitative Analytics Professional within the Models & Analytics team to be responsible for the creation, development, and execution of analytic models in support of Counterparty Risk Management. The key focus is on exposure measurement driven by market risk factors for various products and counterparty types, but the tasks may also include counterparty credit risk exposure, LGD, and credit rating models. The position encourages continued learning and development across other modeling areas, such as market risk capital, operational loss forecast, prepayment and default, and rates and derivatives.

Our Impact:

Key focus of this job is the design, development, and implementation of counterparty risk models for a variety of financial institutions, with primary focus on Exposure at Default models. These models support multiple corporate and divisional objectives by providing key inputs into counterparty credit risk management, both at individual counterparty and portfolio levels.

Your Impact:

- Design, code and maintain consistent counterparty risk models (EAD/PD/LGD). Incorporate best practices while simultaneously accounting for the unique characteristics and risks of each financial institution.

- Collaborate with the Counterparty Credit Risk Management (CCRM) to gain in-depth understanding of various types of financial products (e.g. MBS, CMO, ARM, Whole Loans, Credit Risk Transfer, Insurers) in order to appropriately model unique associated risks

- Design and code model enhancements to address agreed-upon actions (AUAs) in response to findings from model reviewers, internal auditors, and regulatory examiners

- Design and produce Performance Monitoring Reports on a regular cadence, respond to inquiries from various stakeholders

- Periodically review and understand changes in relevant corporate policies, standards and procedures and act as a liaison in associated model implementation validation

- Understand and comply with all model controls related to models owned by the team

- Collaborate with the Divisional Model Governance team to ensure compliance with model governance standards

- Proactively partner with teammates and users to facilitate ideas and keep improving models

Qualifications:

- Master's Degree in quantitative finance, statistics or a related quantitative field

- Qualifying coursework may include – but not limited to — econometrics, statistics, mathematical programming, optimization, computational methods, simulation, mortgage-backed securities, derivatives pricing, fixed income and term structure of interest rates

- Must have coursework or work experience developing and implementing financial models, with demonstrable knowledge in quantitative modeling and statistical analysis

- Experience with market risk and mortgage-related modeling and analytics strongly preferred

- Must have strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Familiarity with other languages such as Java, C++, MATLAB, SAS useful.

Keys to Success in this Role:

- Strong programming skills

- Strong technical skills

- Strong analytical skills with orientation to detail

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Join Formlabs if you want to bring ground-breaking professional 3D printers to the desktop of every designer, engineer, researcher, and artist in the world.

As a Strategy & Operations Analyst at Formlabs, you will turn messy business problems into shipped solutions. You’ll take problem statements from teams across the company — Finance, Operations, Sales, Support, R&D — scope them, rally the right people, and build much of the solution yourself with SQL, Python, automation, and AI tools. You’ll also be a key partner to the CIO in running the IT & Systems organization: driving OKRs, reporting, and roadmapping across a 26-person team spanning data platform, digital systems, financial systems, infrastructure, and cybersecurity.

This is a role for someone early in their career with a very strong ability to learn quickly — someone who has done analytical or operations work at a consulting firm, startup, or BizOps team, and who would rather build the fix than write the deck about it.

You will report directly to the CIO and work closely with the leaders of each IT & Systems team.

This role is based in our Somerville, MA office and will be a hybrid role with the expectation of at least 3 days a week in office.

The Job:

- Business Problem Delivery: Take ambiguous problem statements from the business, define requirements and success measures, and lead small cross-functional teams from scoping through launch.

- Hands-On Building: Write the SQL queries, Python scripts, integrations, and low-code or AI-powered automations that close gaps between systems — then hand off steady-state ownership to the right domain team.

- OKRs & Planning: Run the IT & Systems OKR process — gather inputs, track progress, and surface risks early so leadership can make decisions.

- Reporting & Roadmaps: Own the data, cadence, and first draft of recurring leadership reporting, roadmap rollups, and spend reporting (cloud, SaaS, and AI tools).

- Operational Excellence: Improve how the organization runs — software purchasing, renewals, license hygiene, and vendor coordination — with a bias toward automating the process rather than doing it by hand.

- Executive Support: Prepare analysis and materials for executive and cross-functional discussions, translating technical work into business outcomes.

You:

- Experience: 2–4 years in consulting, business operations, strategy & operations, or a similar analytical role.

- MBA: From a top-tier program (or equivalent strategic experience in fast-paced, high-growth companies)

- Builder Mindset: Have shipped something real that other people used — a tool, dashboard, automation, or script — not just a spreadsheet model.

- Technical Skills: Comfortable writing SQL and working in Python or a similar scripting language; able to learn new systems and APIs quickly.

- Structured Thinking: Can break down an ambiguous problem, size it, and communicate a clear recommendation in writing and in person.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Lead without authority — you build trust with engineers, finance partners, and business stakeholders alike.

- Ownership: Highly organized, follow through on commitments, and are comfortable juggling several workstreams at once.

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, economics, business, or a related field.

Bonus Points:

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, agentic workflows) to automate business processes.

- Exposure to enterprise systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Shopify, or a modern data stack (dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

- Experience running an OKR, planning, or budgeting process.

- Familiarity with software procurement, vendor management, or SaaS spend management.

- Interest in hardware, manufacturing, or 3D printing.

Our Perks & Benefits:

- Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

- Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

- Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors

- Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

- Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

- Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

- Ample free on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

- Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

- Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

- Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

- And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don’t check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

jobs.title: Pricing & Order Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on both companies' strengths while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a Pricing & Order Operations Analyst to join our Order Operations & Monetization team. This role restores dedicated capacity for pricing and order operations testing, quote-to-cash (QTC) release validation, and order execution support.

You’ll help ensure system changes are tested, validated, and operationally ready before they go live. You’ll provide Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expertise and execute assigned business validation across signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, and booking-to-order management handoffs. This role partners closely with Order Operations & Monetization, IT’s business systems team, Pricing Operations, Sales, and Deal Desk.

Reporting & Prioritization

- Reports to the Order Operations & Monetization lead, Jamie Calkins.

- The Senior Pricing Operations Manager may help prioritize pricing-related test cases and QTC issues tied specifically to pricing and quoting.

- The Order Operations & Monetization lead owns final prioritization of the analyst’s workload across order operations, assigned non-pricing UAT participation, and pricing-related support work.

This is a hybrid role, 1-2 days in the office.

Technologies You’ll Use

- Salesforce CPQ

- Jira

- Suger and marketplace user interfaces, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake

- Notion

- Metronome

- Hex

What You’ll Do

Pricing Operations & QTC Support

- Support pricing operations changes through business requirement review, data validation, configuration checks, and documentation, helping ensure pricing logic is accurately reflected in QTC workflows.

- Validate pricing-related QTC changes across quoting, approvals, discounting logic, product configuration, and downstream order execution.

- Help confirm that pricing changes are operationally ready before launch, including impacts to Sales, Deal Desk, Order Operations, Billing, Revenue, and marketplace workflows.

- Partner with the Senior Pricing Operations Manager to prioritize pricing-related test cases, identify gaps in business requirements, and document expected system behavior.

- Help maintain documentation for pricing- and order-related system configurations, known dependencies, and release-readiness criteria.

UAT & Testing

- Participate as a Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expert in UAT project-managed by Technical Program Management (TPM) and executed under RevOps coordination, ensuring relevant business scenarios and expected outcomes are represented.

- Execute assigned Pricing and Order Operations test cases and collaborate with the GTM subject-matter experts identified by RevOps.

- Partner with RevOps and relevant subject-matter experts to develop and maintain Pricing and Order Operations test cases, including scenarios for quoting, approvals, signature packets, bookings, marketplace offers, billing, and order management.

- Document test results and defects with clear traceability from business requirement to test outcome, and provide domain-specific readiness input through the established UAT sign-off process.

- Maintain the Pricing and Order Operations portion of the regression test suite for recurring QTC changes.

Order Operations

- Operate under defined business requirements for order operations rules within the QTC flow, validating execution across signature packet generation and e-signature routing, booking rules, marketplace offer configuration—including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake—and the booking-to-order management handoff.

- Partner with IT’s business systems team and the Proposal-to-Order Lead to keep order operations rules aligned with upstream pricing and quoting logic and downstream billing and revenue systems.

- Ensure signature packets and marketplace offers accurately reflect the underlying order and pricing terms before execution.

- Identify and troubleshoot order operations issues across bookings, signature packets, and marketplace offers, escalating systemic problems to the appropriate system owner.

Skills We’re Looking For

- 2–3 years of experience in pricing operations, order operations, business systems analysis, or quality assurance within an agile environment, ideally involving quote-to-cash processes.

- Working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ and order management or billing systems, with the ability to read and understand configuration logic without necessarily building it directly.

- Strong attention to detail and comfort performing structured, repeatable testing work.

- Comfort using conversational AI tools—such as Claude, ChatGPT, or internal chatbots—to support daily and project work, combined with sound judgment about when human review or decision-making is necessary.

- Clear written communication skills, with the ability to document test cases, defects, and sign-off criteria for technical and business audiences.

- A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to work across IT, Pricing and Order Operations, and Sales and Deal Desk with minimal oversight.

Bonus Skills​

- Exposure to Revenue Recognition or Professional Services systems and processes.

- Reports to the Order Operations & Monetization lead, Jamie Calkins.

- The Senior Pricing Operations Manager may help prioritize pricing-related test cases and QTC issues tied specifically to pricing and quoting.

- The Order Operations & Monetization lead owns final prioritization of the analyst’s workload across order operations, assigned non-pricing UAT participation, and pricing-related support work.

Technologies You’ll Use

- Salesforce CPQ

- Jira

- Suger and marketplace user interfaces, including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake

- Notion

- Metronome

- Hex

What You’ll Do

Pricing Operations & QTC Support

- Support pricing operations changes through business requirement review, data validation, configuration checks, and documentation, helping ensure pricing logic is accurately reflected in QTC workflows.

- Validate pricing-related QTC changes across quoting, approvals, discounting logic, product configuration, and downstream order execution.

- Help confirm that pricing changes are operationally ready before launch, including impacts to Sales, Deal Desk, Order Operations, Billing, Revenue, and marketplace workflows.

- Partner with the Senior Pricing Operations Manager to prioritize pricing-related test cases, identify gaps in business requirements, and document expected system behavior.

- Help maintain documentation for pricing- and order-related system configurations, known dependencies, and release-readiness criteria.

- Participate as a Pricing and Order Operations subject-matter expert in UAT project-managed by Technical Program Management (TPM) and executed under RevOps coordination, ensuring relevant business scenarios and expected outcomes are represented.

- Maintain the Pricing and Order Operations portion of the regression test suite for recurring QTC changes.

- Operate under defined business requirements for order operations rules within the QTC flow, validating execution across signature packet generation and e-signature routing, booking rules, marketplace offer configuration—including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Snowflake—and the booking-to-order management handoff.

- Clear written communication skills, with the ability to document test cases, defects, and sign-off criteria for technical and business audiences.

- A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to work across IT, Pricing and Order Operations, and Sales and Deal Desk with minimal oversight.

Bonus Skills​

- Exposure to Revenue Recognition or Professional Services systems and processes.

- Support onboarding and offboarding for employees and contractors, including device setup and access provisioning across core systems

- Troubleshoot common issues with collaboration and productivity tools (e.g., Slack, Google Workspace, Notion)

- Support office technology, including conference room AV and video-conferencing equipment

- Maintain accurate records of hardware inventory and ticket resolution

- Escalate systems-level issues (SSO configuration, elevated access, integration troubleshooting) to the IT Systems team

- Experience in an IT helpdesk, service desk, or end-user support role

- Strong customer service and written communication skills

- Basic hardware troubleshooting on Mac and/or Windows laptops

- Experience supporting SaaS application access requests across multiple systems

- Familiarity with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration basics

- Experience supporting new-hire onboarding/offboarding at scale

- Experience in a fast-growing or multi-office environment

jobs.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Technical Operations Analyst II, AI Platform Reliability & Insights

About the team

The AI & Automation Team onboards and manages AI tools, and partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products and services. We deliver high-quality experiences for employees worldwide with best-in-class technology to boost productivity and enable AI in the flow of work.

About the role

We're hiring a Technical Operations Analyst II to keep our enterprise AI platforms reliable and to turn the data they produce into decisions. Many of our apps are vendor-managed, so you'll work with vendors to get the data and fixes we need. You'll sit between the engineers who build our telemetry and integrations, the vendors who run parts of our stack, and the leaders who rely on both: investigating incidents, watching the signals, and showing how our AI tools perform, how they are adopted and what they cost. This is a technical, data-driven analyst role, not a software engineering role.

In this role, you will

- Own observability for our AI platforms and integrations: take in OpenTelemetry and platform telemetry and turn it into clear reporting and recommendations on reliability, performance, usage and cost, including token consumption and spend.

- Manage vendors for our vendor-managed apps: track logged issues to resolution against agreed service levels, escalate when needed, and secure the telemetry, usage and audit data they own.

- Lead first response and cross-team investigation for incidents, restore service quickly, write evidence-based incident reports, and harden runbooks and preventive checks so issues don't recur.

- Design SLO-aligned monitors, tune alerts to cut noise, and correlate tickets, alerts, telemetry and vendor reports to surface systemic risks and prioritize fixes by impact.

- Build and maintain BI dashboards and reports with metric definitions consistent with enterprise standards, and model demand and capacity to recommend changes.

- Identify routine diagnostic and reporting work to automate, and partner with engineering owners to implement it.

- Design AI-ready knowledge articles, runbooks and self-service content, and measure ticket deflection and customer satisfaction.

- Plan and run cross-team changes, such as tool rollouts and feature adoption, and measure uptake.

- Mentor peers and build relationships across engineering, support, security, vendors and business teams.

Minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, Master's degree or equivalent professional experience.

- 2+ years of experience in technical operations, application or production support, or monitoring (or 0-2 years with a Master's degree).

- Hands-on incident and problem management experience, including coordinating response across teams and writing root cause and incident summaries.

- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (for example Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace or CloudWatch), including building dashboards and tuning alerts.

- Experience managing vendor or third-party support relationships, including tracking issues to resolution against service levels.

- Comfort analyzing data to find trends and reporting on it, using spreadsheets and a BI or dashboard tool.

- Working knowledge of AI assistants and LLM-based tools, including how to validate AI-generated guidance and spot hallucinations or risky outputs.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to quantify the impact of operational issues and propose cost-effective fixes.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar telemetry pipelines, and with SLO and SLI reporting.

- Experience managing vendors of SaaS or enterprise platforms, including escalations and service-level reviews.

- Experience administering or supporting enterprise AI or knowledge platforms (for example Glean, Claude or similar), including usage, adoption and cost reporting.

- Familiarity with FinOps or cost-attribution practices for cloud or AI spend.

- Experience with an ITSM platform such as ServiceNow, and ITIL Foundation knowledge.

- Experience with Looker, Tableau or a similar dashboard tool, and with defining metrics against a shared metrics platform or data lake.

- Experience writing knowledge articles and runbooks designed for self-service and AI search.

- Experience leading change or tool adoption across teams.

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $87,000.00 to $121,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $139,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Finance Analyst – Expedia Controllership

Position Description

The Expedia Business to Business Controllership team is seeking a Finance Analyst to supervise and report on the direct billing and cash settlement processes for B2B partnerships which is a growing and innovative business.

You will report to the Finance Manager of B2B Controllership and closely partner with Account Management, Accounting, Corporate Accounts Payable/Receivable, Tax, Treasury, and Technology teams. You will prepare contractual results supporting processes for strategic B2B partners and gain a deep understanding of the product and insight into the end-to-end business process.

This position is part of the B2B team, located in Springfield, MO, and is responsible for supporting receivables and payables processes, partner requests, user acceptance testing, and process improvement initiatives for B2B Loyalty Points partners. Responsibilities include supporting month-end close activities, coordinating AR/AP processes, assisting with daily communications with partners and internal stakeholders, and contributing to the continued growth and evolution of the Loyalty Points operations business.

· Support partner requirements for billing, cash receipts, cash settlements, automated reporting, and reconciliations.

· Prepare, distribute, and maintain the daily aging report for the EPS Loyalty portfolio, with partial ownership of reporting accuracy, remediation tracking, and aging-related business insights.

· Prepare monthly AR snapshot reports and support analysis of receivable trends.

· Assist with month-end close activities, including AR and AP reconciliations, accrual support, account analysis, and other close-related responsibilities.

· Support the execution and monitoring of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

· Assist with new partner intake, including setup for billing, cash settlement, and daily/monthly reporting packages.

· Partner with multiple teams to continuously monitor and evaluate the quality of financial outputs and proactively drive process improvements.
