Job Description:

Summary:

The Business Systems Analyst is a critical role in the delivery of products for Lifetime Healthcare Companies. This position collaborates with stakeholders throughout the organization to understand business objectives and defines IT system requirements and specifications for the implementation of IT system solutions. The Business Systems Analyst will serve as the primary interface between the business and IT teams to gather, document and analyze all level of requirements with the emphasis on delivering functional and non-functional requirements to solution architects and IT teams. Business Systems Analyst, in collaboration, with their stakeholders sets scope for work items.

Essential Accountabilities:

All Levels:

- Collaborates with all stakeholders to elicit, analyze, specify, and gather business, stakeholder, and solution requirements. This will include assisting and/or contributing to the creation of documented requirements leveraging the organization’s requirements methodology.

- Creates functional and non-functional requirements based on stakeholder requirements including business, IT and recommended best practices.

- Develops an understanding & expertise of the business, application, and data domain they are assigned.

- Conducts or participates in peer reviews of business, stakeholder, and solution requirements.

- Defines scope as they flow from business stakeholders to development teams in an iterative release process.

- Consistently demonstrates high standards of integrity by supporting the Lifetime Healthcare Companies’ mission and values, adhering to the Corporate Code of Conduct, and leading to the Lifetime Way values and beliefs.

- Maintains high regard for group, member, and agency privacy in accordance with the corporate privacy policies and procedures.

- Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required.

- Performs other functions as assigned by management.

Level II (in addition to Level I essential accountabilities

- Conducts research and systems analysis required to deliver IT systems related requirements including data and cloud technologies.

- Proactively manages changes in scope, identifies potential risks, and works with management and development team(s) to create recovery plans.

- Works with Business Stakeholders to identify the minimal viable product (MVP).

Level III (in addition to Level II essential responsibilities/accountabilities)

- Assesses requirements to provide recommendations for improvements.

- Mentors and trains other Business Systems Analyst I/II’s in various practices and other products.

- Considered a subject matter expert in their assigned business area and data domain.

- Leads complex projects and work efforts to obtain requirements to ensure solutions are appropriate and directly support the business, enterprise, and data strategies.

Level IV (in addition to Level III essential responsibilities/accountabilities)

- Leads peer reviews with other Business Systems Analyst to assess quality and completeness of requirements, providing feedback and guidance.

- Works collaboratively across the organization to identify potential areas for process or implementation improvements, addressing any impediments to the product or project.

- Directly negotiates with and functions as a liaison with other IT resources, business stakeholders and external vendors/partners. Often fills the role of project spokesperson. Writes and speaks fluently on all aspects of work.

- Considered a subject matter expert across many business areas and data domains.

- Demonstrated leadership in creating requirements while working collaboratively with multiple levels of management and architects from across the enterprise.

Minimum Qualifications:

NOTE: We include multiple levels of classification differentiated by demonstrated knowledge, skills, and the ability to manage increasingly independent and/or complex assignments, broader responsibility, additional decision making, and in some cases, becoming a resource to others. In addition to using this differentiated approach to place new hires, it also provides guideposts for employee development and promotional opportunities.

Level I:

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) years of relevant work experience is required.

- Basic understanding of various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated basic understanding of data and systems analytics skills.

- Basic experience writing requirements or user stories that are clear, concise, and well organized.

- Basic understanding of waterfall or agile scrum methodologies and familiarity with Automated Testing preferred.

- Demonstrated Intermediate communication skills: oral presentations, writing, facilitation, elicitation, negotiation, active listening, influence positive team dynamics.

- Advanced MS Office knowledge.

- Ability to prioritize work components and define objectives effectively without assistance and with minimal supervision.

- Demonstrated critical thinking and analytical approach to providing solutions at an intermediate level.

- Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Level II: All qualifications of Level I, as well as the following

- Three (3) years of relevant work experience.

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) additional years of relevant work experience is required.

- Basic SQL skills with the ability to effectively execute SQL queries, interpret data and read through procedural code.

- Intermediate knowledge of business, technology, and data domain they are assigned.

- Intermediate data and systems analytics skills.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience with various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience in the Health Plan or healthcare industry especially as it relates to overall health insurance value chain and processes preferred.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience writing requirements or user stories that are clear, concise, and well organized.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience with waterfall or agile scrum methodologies and familiarity with Automated Testing preferred.

Level III: All qualifications of Level II, as well as the following:

- Five (5) years of relevant work experience.

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) additional years of relevant work experience is required.

About us:

EverQuote is a leading AI-powered growth solutions partner for regulated property and casualty insurance entities, enabling the largest insurance carriers and thousands of agents to maximize customer acquisition across digital channels. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share.

EverQuote is seeking a Data Scientist to join our growing team! As a member of the Data Science team, you will be instrumental in delivering and deploying artificial intelligence and machine learning models that drive Everquote’s long term success.

What you'll do:

- Work with a cross-functional team to convert business problems into scalable solutions using your knowledge of mathematics, statistics, and machine learning. You will be joining a team of talented and collaborative data scientists and machine learning engineers eager to grow our business and deliver measurable results. - Advanced knowledge of applied mathematics and statistics and their common applications in online businesses

- Experience with or strong interest in understanding and optimizing online auctions for both bidders and sellers

- Experience with or strong interest in optimization using reinforcement learning and contextual multi-armed bandits

- Strong skills in statistical and scientific programming in Python, fluent in SQL, proficient with Jupyter notebooks

- Experience with packaging your code for deployment and reusability

- Passionate about sharing knowledge and mentoring teammates, and communicating designs to technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Keen sense about data science technologies, stay on top of industry trends and actively help the team to expand the tech stack

- Entrepreneurial mindset, want to grow a business, and love working with an Agile team

- Thrive in a fast-paced work environment where everyday contributions have a big impact

Education & Experience:

- Bachelors degree in a technical field, with an advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Math/Statistics, or a related field strongly preferred

- Internship or equivalent professional experience in Data Science/MLE required. At least 2 years of professional experience in Data Science/ML preferred (preferred more strongly for candidates without an advanced degree)

- Proven experience building and delivering ML solutions in a production eng environment preferred

- Languages: Python, SQL (other languages a plus but not required)

- ML Operations and comfortability with the model development lifecycle and related technologies (Snowflake/analytics DBs, AWS SageMaker or similar ML Platforms, MLFlow, GitHub, etcetera)

- Strong fundamentals in modeling and ML, and related technologies

- Strong fundamentals in software development, with an emphasis on coachability

- Strong stakeholder management abilities, with a knack for understanding user needs and aligning them with technical solutions

- Strong product sense and the ability to contribute to understand product strategy and roadmap discussions

- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly

The base salary actually offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant's job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location. The base salary for this full-time hybrid role is $129,900-$152,800.

jobs.description:
ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Job Description:
- Review workplace injury, illness, and fatality records and apply standardized case‑classification codes using the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Occupational Injury and Illness Classification System (OIICS)

- Exercise thoughtful, independent judgment to accurately classify complex or ambiguous cases while maintaining speed and consistency

- Draft brief, clear incident narratives that summarize the circumstances of each case in plain, concise language

- Manage multiple work queues and deadlines while maintaining high quality and attention to detail

- Collaborate regularly with team members and senior analysts for guidance, quality checks, and knowledge sharing

- Contribute to documentation, process improvements, and evolving analytical practices over time

- Experience with occupational health and safety and structured coding (e.g. OIICS, ICD coding) is preferred. However, training for OIICS version 3.03 coding will be provided

Qualifications and Skills:
- A bachelor’s degree in communications, health/environmental science, mathematics/statistics, or a related field

- Experience required: 0 to 5 years

- Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to apply rules consistently

- Excellent writing, editing, and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely

- Outstanding time-management and organizational skills with the ability to work independently in a remote environment to accomplish assignments in a timely manner

- Experience or strong interest in data analysis, public health, occupational safety, epidemiology, or related fields.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Access, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint)

- Willingness and ability to learn new software and technical skills as required

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with structured classification or coding systems (e.g., OIICS, ICD, or similar)

- Experience or coursework in data analysis or data management. Prior exposure to occupational health, injury or illness surveillance, or public health research

ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro-rated for part-time) and more. If you’re a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ERG’s online application process as a result of your disability. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources via email at Resumes-Lex@erg.com or call (781) 674-7293.

jobs.title: Transaction Reporting Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe access to financial markets shouldn’t be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. Our API-based platform empowers partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, with US equities, ETFs, mutual funds, fixed income, options, and fractional shares.

Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the stability and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while holding ourselves to institutional-grade execution and compliance. Join us and help build the future of global investing!


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Transaction Reporting Analyst is a critical role responsible for the operational integrity of DriveWealth's regulatory trade reporting. This role is responsible for performing the Firm's front-line supervisory reviews: working exception reports generated across trading, order handling, and FINRA trade reporting activity; investigating and documenting findings; and escalating issues to the appropriate supervisor or principal in line with the Firm's Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs). 
This is an operational, evidence-driven function. It requires the ability to read and apply the Firm's supervisory procedures, work efficiently through exception queues, spot patterns that need escalation, and maintain clean, examiner-ready records of every review performed. Prior experience with order/trade surveillance systems, exception-based reporting, or retail brokerage operations is highly desirable but not required. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Perform daily/periodic Level 1 supervisory reviews of assigned exception reports (e.g., trade and order exceptions, CAT/CAIS/TRF/ORF/TRACE supervisory report exceptions)

 - Investigate flagged items to determine root cause, gather supporting evidence, and reach a documented conclusion

 - Clear reviewed items from the queue and log the review, findings, and disposition in the Firm's designated system of record

 - Track issues through to resolution and confirm that corrective action was taken and evidenced

 - Identify recurring exception patterns and recommend process, control, or system improvements to reduce false positives and close gaps

 - Maintain organized, accurate records to support compliance testing, internal audit, and regulatory examinations

 - Assist in gathering facts and documentation in response to regulatory inquiries or exams

 - Partner with Engineering and Brokerage Operations to improve the automation and reliability of monitoring workflows.

 - Stay current on the FINRA rules and internal procedures governing the reviews performed
   
   


YOU BRING

 - Minimum 3+ years of experience in a compliance, supervision, operations, or analytical role, preferably at a broker-dealer or other financial services firm

 - Direct exposure to FINRA trade reporting (CAT/CAIS/TRF/ORF/TRACE), SEC Rule 605 and 606 reporting or equivalent regulatory transaction reporting is a plus.

 - Demonstrated background handling regulatory reporting across diverse asset classes, such as Equities, Options, Fixed Income, Futures, and Crypto, is highly desirable.

 - A track record of ownership and disciplined execution in high-stakes, deadline-driven environments.

 - The ability to prioritize effectively and know when to escalate versus resolve independently.

 - Strong written communication skills — able to document findings and escalations clearly and defensibly

 - Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, high attention to detail and a deep respect for risk, control, and regulatory obligations.

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

 - Experience with SQL, AI-assisted tools (e.g., using AI to summarize, triage, test, or draft first-pass analysis of exception data), or other technical/data skills is a strong plus and will be weighted favorably

 - Active Series 7 required 

 - Series 3, 4, 24 (or willingness to obtain) is a plus
   
   


LOCATION

This role is open to candidates in the following location: Chicago, Ilinois - Hybrid

 - This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.

 - If you're not based in the location listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

 - Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $70,000 – $90,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a mid-level Operations Analyst with a manufacturing analytics focus to turn production data into operational insight and decision tools. This candidate will apply statistical and machine learning methods to production data and help develop models for granular time and cost prediction, unifying factory data sources into a cohesive data model. The analyst will partner with the central Data team to operationalize this data and, where data does not yet exist, partner with cross-functional teams to drive its exposure. The role spans Manufacturing Intelligence workstreams, including process improvement, simulation, equipment connectivity, and factory scaling, as priorities shift.

The Role

- Develop and validate statistical and ML models correlating process time, staffing, and engineering data to enable granular time and cost prediction; initial application in pricing, extending to simulation and factory scaling.

- Unify equipment, MES, ERP/BOM, staffing, and engineering data into a cohesive data model that serves as a shared foundation for pricing, simulation, factory scaling, predictive models, and the team’s broader set of tools.

- Define source mappings, metric definitions, and data quality rules, including anomaly detection to flag inconsistencies in data inputs (e.g., work orders); partner with the central Data, AI, and Software teams to operationalize data and software tools.

- Identify operational inefficiencies and implement data-driven process improvements with operations and automation teams, validating data against shop floor conditions.

- Lead cross-functional projects from discovery and requirements through prototyping, business case and ROI justification, and implementation.

- Conduct ad hoc and scenario analyses supporting pricing, capacity, staffing, and investment decisions.

- Communicate and document data models, methodology, and assumptions for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

- Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

- Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Statistics, CS, Operations Research, or related field (or equivalent experience)

- Python: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, matplotlib/Plotly; data extraction, API integration, task automation

- SQL: complex joins, window functions, CTEs; relational data modeling; cleaning and validation of high-volume operational and time-series data

- Applied statistics and supervised ML: hypothesis testing, regression, classification, tree-based ensembles; feature engineering, cross-validation, model evaluation; anomaly detection for input data validation

- Git; documented, reproducible code

- Integration of AI tools into daily workflow

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
About Us

David Yurman is a celebrated American jewelry company founded in New York by David Yurman, a sculptor, and his wife, Sybil, a painter and ceramicist. When the artists began collaborating, their goal was simply to make beautiful objects to wear. Led today by their son Evan, David Yurman creates timeless, yet contemporary collections for women and men defined by inspiration, innovation, consummate craftsmanship and cable – the brand’s artistic signature. David Yurman collections are available at retail stores throughout the United States, Canada, Hong Kong and France and at locations worldwide, through their exclusive authorized fine jewelry and timepiece network of retailers.

Our Values

At David Yurman, creativity, innovation and impeccable craftsmanship are at the core of everything we do. Fueled by the energy of our hometown, New York City, artistic passion informs each and every jewelry design. The Yurman family’s guiding vision continually defines and redefines what it means to be the preeminent American luxury jewelry brand. We are committed to responsible business and social practices and to the protection and advancement of human rights. We believe in partnering with others who share these values and understand their importance.

Job Description

Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Inventory and Demand Planner to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for optimizing inventory levels and demand forecasting across our Retail and E-commerce network. This role requires a strong understanding of sales and inventory analysis, forecasting, and collaboration with various teams to ensure our products are available and meet customer demand.

Key Responsibilities:

- Sales & Inventory Analysis: Demand and assortment plan at the Style and SKU level to ensure that Omni Retail store and E-Commerce networks’ bulk orders are placed sufficiently and timely to meet demand.

- Weekly Order Projections: Update and manage projected weekly orders to ensure timely stock replenishment.

- Inventory Review: Analyze door inventory and sell-through rates to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

- Store Stock Monitoring: Evaluate and monitor store stock levels at the SKU level to optimize inventory and maintain healthy stock levels across the network.

- Forecasting Parameter Changes in Logility: Recommend changes to inventory and replenishment parameters in the Logility forecasting system based on sales forecasts.

- Store Stock Requests: Fulfill store stock requests to support upcoming events and customer needs effectively.

- Product Replenishment Strategy: Develop and maintain an efficient product replenishment strategy to ensure optimal inventory levels.

- Analytical Dashboards: Build and maintain analytical dashboards to visualize key metrics and support decision-making.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Merchant Buyers and the Supply Chain team to improve customer forecast accuracy and ensure proper inventory replenishment to maximize sales and maintain retail in-stock conditions while driving inventory efficiency.

Qualifications:

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.

- Experience: 3-5 years of experience in demand planning, inventory management, sales forecasting and analysis, or a related field.

- Technical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel) and experience with demand planning and inventory management systems (e.g., Logility).

- Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.

- Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

- Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Location: New York, NY

Working Mode: Hybrid

Estimate Salary Range: $95k – 110k

Base pay is one component of David Yurman’s total compensation package, which may also include the following for eligible employees: access to healthcare benefits, 401(k) plan, bonus, employee discounts, Summer Fridays (corporate roles), generous paid time off, sick time, and more.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at David Yurman

As a company founded by artists, David Yurman champions self-expression in everything we do. We are committed to fostering a culture of openness and creative collaboration within our entire community, and we cherish the diversity of our employees’ backgrounds and perspectives. We will always advocate for equity and inclusion for all.

David Yurman is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender).

jobs.title: Transportation Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Under general direction of Transportation Business leadership, supports analytics, data modeling, and forecasting efforts to optimize traffic, transportation, and parking operations across the Transportation Business Unit (TBU). Utilizes statistical and quantitative analysis, predictive modeling, and other data science methodologies to inform operational decisions that enhance customer experience and strengthen daily airport operations

What you will be doing:

- Supports the development and application of advanced quantitative analyses, predictive modeling, and AI-driven forecasting to assess and optimize parking and transportation operations.

- Supports parking and transportation operations by maintaining a holistic understanding of business risks and opportunities, and leverages technology to help the team improve efficiency and maintain competitive advantage.

- Maintains dynamic dashboards and reporting tools using software such as Tableau, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools to provide real-time operational insights.

- Automates data processing and analytics workflows to enhance efficiency and scalability, utilizing Python, R, SQL, or other cloud-based data solutions.

- Conducts market and financial trend analysis to forecast business activity and generate strategic models and recommendations for senior leadership.

- Leverages business intelligence tools and quantitative data from multiple sources to manage trend analysis, forecasts, market share analysis, and customer experience at the Airport and in the industry.

- Collaborates with DFW Information Technology Services (ITS) to develop and manage the reporting of parking and transportation related data.

- Assists with maintaining data integrity and reliable data pipelines, by collaborating within the Transportation Business unit in maintaining data governance as a TBU Data Steward.

- Prepares and delivers presentations and reports on analytical findings and strategic insights, while incorporating automation, developing forecasts, and managing data quality.

- Collaborates with teams across the airport to integrate analytics-driven strategies into operational planning and execution, while supporting junior analysts in fostering a data-driven culture within the Transportation Business Unit.

- Performs other related duties as assigned.

What you need:

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business or related field.

- Three (3) plus years of experience in business analysis, data analytics, business planning, or quantitative analysis or research, preferably in a transportation, parking, or operations-focused environment.

- Any equivalent combination of training, education and/or experience may be substituted for the above.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- Knowledge of statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning techniques such as regression models, time series forecasting, decision trees, and neural networks, to solve problems.

- Skill in designing and implementing automated data reporting and monitoring solutions.

- Skill in problem-solving with an aptitude for leveraging data to optimize business processes and operational efficiency.

- Ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights and clearly communicate and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across airport departments, including executives.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships both inside and outside the organization.

Desirable:

- Master’s degree in a related field.

- Experience working with parking, transportation, or airport operations analytics.

- Hands-on experience with time series modeling, reinforcement learning, or advanced optimization techniques.

- Proficiency in cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for big data analytics.

- Skill in Python, R (including Shiny), SQL, and data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or MicroStrategy).

- Skill in data engineering, including experience with ETL processes, data warehousing, and cloud-based data platforms.

- Experience in developing predictive business models with operational or economic data.

- Experience in integrating AI/ML solutions into business intelligence workflows.

About Us

We are Dallas Fort Worth International (DFW) Airport-one of the most successful airports in the world by any definition. We are recognized for our innovation, leadership, drive for excellence and talented employees.

Our success is made possible because of the diverse talents of over 2,100 employees who champion our mission of providing an exceptional airport experience to our customers and connect our community to the world. We are looking for the best talent to join us and help reimagine what an airport can be.

Bring your talents to DFW. Live and work with purpose.

DXC's Insurance Software and BPS (ISB) help insurers around the world modernize and run their core operations at scale by combining deep industry expertise, proven software platforms, and innovative AI-driven solutions.

A global market leader in core insurance platforms, ISB delivers solutions across policy administration, claims, billing, analytics, and digital engagement supporting Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets.

You’ll directly shape how the world's leading insurers operate by helping to transform the policy, underwriting, and claims systems that millions of people rely on every day.

We are hiring a Document Management Business Analyst (BA) who will play a critical role in supporting future Transformation & Transition (T&T) growth projects and ongoing BAU Document Management Savings and Efficiency initiatives.

This role focuses on supporting document management operations within Life Insurance and Annuities environments by ensuring the efficient movement of inbound and outbound mail, scanned images, and workflows between vendors, DXC systems, and internal business teams.

This position operates as a key middle layer between outsourced mail/document vendors and internal DXC operational business areas. While the actual insurance processing is handled by downstream operational teams, this role is responsible for helping ensure documents and images are received, routed, delivered, and managed accurately and efficiently across the workflow lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

• Vendor Coordination: Acting as the primary liaison between clients and outsourced inbound/outbound mail vendors to ensure smooth operations, document routing accuracy, image delivery, operational readiness, and compliance with service-level agreements.

• Client-Facing Role: Engaging directly with clients to gather requirements, support onboarding and transition activities, provide project updates, and resolve issues related to document management operations and workflows.

• Transformation & Transition (T&T) Support: Supporting onboarding and implementation activities for new insurance clients by helping establish mail operations, PO Box setups, document workflows, routing rules, vendor coordination, and image delivery processes within required project timelines.

• Managed Services & Workflow Coordination: Supporting operational setup activities related to inbound and outbound mail services, vendor-managed mail operations, workflow routing, image delivery, and coordination between vendors and internal DXC business areas.

• Process Improvement & BAU Optimization: Driving efficiency, automation, and cost-saving initiatives within document management workflows by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times, and enhance operational performance.

• Workflow & Routing Management: Assisting with configuration and optimization of document and image routing workflows to ensure documents are delivered accurately and efficiently to the appropriate operational teams.

• Metrics & Reporting: Monitoring operational metrics and reporting related to document management processes, including turnaround times, workflow accuracy, SLA adherence, vendor performance, and process efficiency.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working closely with various BPS business areas, vendors, clients, and operational teams to align document management strategies with broader organizational goals and ensure successful project execution.

• Stakeholder & Relationship Management: Acting as a bridge between clients, vendors, and internal teams while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, project-based environment.

• Travel Requirements: Traveling within the U.S. to client sites and vendor locations as needed to support project implementation, onboarding activities, and relationship management. Approximately 10% travel may be required.

This role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder management, project coordination abilities, and a process improvement mindset, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Job Functions:

• Assist in managing business process improvement projects to enhance customer and client experience.

• Support onboarding and transition activities for new document management clients and workflows.

• Support operational setup activities related to vendor-managed inbound and outbound mail services.

• Support the identification of process optimization, automation, and cost-saving opportunities.

• Execute process enhancements and workflow improvements under the guidance of senior team members.

• Assist with project communication, operational reporting, and metrics tracking.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, vendors, and clients to ensure project success.

• Act as a liaison between internal teams, external vendors, clients, and stakeholders.

• Assist in resource allocation, project planning, workflow coordination, and transition management activities.

• Learn and apply process optimization methodologies effectively.

• Support workflow routing validation, image delivery processes, operational handoffs, and efficiency initiatives.

• This role operates in a collaborative, project-based environment supporting both ongoing operational efficiencies and new client implementations for document management services within the insurance industry

Mandatory Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Typically, 6+ years of relevant work experience in business process services, document management operations, project coordination, or workflow management environments, with at least 1–2 years in a similar Business Analyst or project-based operational/junior leadership capacity

• Experience within the Life Insurance and Annuities industry is required

• Experience coordinating with outsourced vendors and managing operational relationships to support mail intake, document imaging, workflow routing, and service delivery processes

• Experience supporting client onboarding, transition, implementation, or Transformation & Transition (T&T) projects within a business process services environment

Understanding document workflow lifecycles, including mail setup, image delivery, routing coordination, operational handoffs, and workflow optimization processes

jobs.title: Campus Planner, Strategy & Analytics
jobs.description:
DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.

DLR Group is seeking a Campus Planner focusing on space strategy and analytics to join our national Campus Planning Team within our Higher Education practice.

Position Summary

This role sits at the intersection of campus planning, facilities strategy, data analytics, and design. We are looking for a curious, systems-oriented thinker who can take complex quantitative and qualitative information and turn it into a compelling story that helps colleges and universities make better decisions about their campuses.

You will work alongside campus planners, architects, designers, and institutional leaders to understand existing facilities, incorporate non-facilities data sources, identify emerging needs, test future scenarios, and translate those findings into actionable planning strategies. The right person may come from an AEC consulting environment, directly from a college or university, or bring a different perspective.

This is not a traditional data analyst position. Data is one of the tools you will use to uncover insights, influence planning decisions, and connect institutional priorities to the physical campus.

What You Will Do

- Partner with DLR Group's national Campus Planning Team and higher education clients to connect institutional strategy, academic priorities, facilities data, and physical space.

- Analyze quantitative and qualitative information including space inventories, utilization, enrollment, scheduling, facilities conditions, stakeholder input, and institutional trends.

- Translate complex data into clear visualizations, narratives, scenarios, and recommendations that clients can understand and act upon.

- Identify patterns across buildings, departments, programs, and campus systems to help institutions understand where they have opportunities, constraints, and unmet space needs.

- Contribute to campus master plans, facility plans, programming studies, space utilization studies, and other strategic planning engagements.

- Manage data validation and visualization processes to ensure high-quality deliverables that meet client needs.

- Facilitate conversations with institutional stakeholders to understand not only what the data says, but why it matters.

- Develop strategies and recommendations related to space utilization, allocation, policies, standards, and future facility needs.

- Work alongside architects and interior designers to translate planning findings into physical design and programming solutions.

- Build and improve processes, tools, dashboards, and methodologies that make our campus planning analysis more efficient, accurate, and insightful.

- Create presentations, reports, and reference materials that combine quantitative data with qualitative insights and industry best practices.

- Contribute to the continued evolution of DLR Group's capabilities around space analytics, facility strategy, data visualization, and digital planning tools.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in planning, architecture, facilities management, data analytics, business, social sciences, engineering, or another relevant field.

- Strong systems-thinking skills and an ability to understand how people, programs, policies, facilities, and institutional priorities interact.

- Experience using data to identify patterns, develop insights, and communicate a compelling story.

- Strong Excel skills and experience working with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

- Experience organizing, transforming, or working with complex datasets; experience with Power Query or similar tools is a plus.

- Strong written, verbal, graphic, and presentation skills.

- Ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Curiosity and a desire to understand the underlying reasons behind the data rather than simply report results.

- Ability to collaborate across disciplines and manage multiple priorities within a national team.

- Ability and willingness to travel and work with clients across the United States.

- Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience within an architecture, engineering, planning, real estate, or other professional consulting environment, or experience working within a college or university.

- Experience in campus planning, facilities planning, space planning, space management, institutional planning, academic planning, or facilities management.

- Familiarity with higher education organizational structures, academic programs, scheduling, enrollment, research, student life, or institutional decision-making.

- Experience with CAFM/IWMS or facilities management systems and the data associated with buildings, rooms, occupancy, assets, or space inventories.

- Experience developing or influencing policies, standards, guidelines, or institutional processes, especially those related to space management.

- Experience connecting data to policy or processes and making changes that influence outcomes.

- Experience with coding, database tools, GIS, data automation, or digital tool development.

- Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or other planning/graphic communication tools.

- Master's degree or multidisciplinary background.

DLR Group is an integrated design firm delivering architecture, engineering, interiors, planning, and building optimization for new builds, renovations, and adaptive reuse projects.

We are 100% employee-owned: every employee is literally invested in our clients’ success. At the core of our firm are interdisciplinary teams engaged in every step of project lifecycles. Our teams champion true collaboration, open information sharing, shared risk and reward, value-based decision making, and proficient use of technology to deliver exceptional design. We are pursuing the goals of the 2030 Challenge, the ME2040, and the SE2050, and are an initial signatory of the China Accord and the AIA 2030 Commitment.

Through our values – commitment, creativity, environmental stewardship, fun, integrity, ownership, sharing, teamwork – we elevate the human experience through design, together.

DLR Group follows a four-day in-office work model, with employees having the flexibility to work somewhere other than the office on Fridays.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action/M/F/Veteran/Disabled employer.

Buyouts

This role reports directly to the Principal of Credit & Financial Operations and plays a critical supporting role in one of DAT's most operationally demanding workstreams: forward flow receivables purchase facility reporting and Outgo month-end close.

As DAT scales its AR sales and related distribution cadence from once monthly to four times per month, the volume and frequency of credit facility reporting has grown significantly. This role exists to ensure DAT has operational depth and redundancy in this function — and to give a high-potential analyst meaningful exposure to credit facilities, FinTech financial operations, and Roper-level reporting standards.

Credit Facility — Weekly AR Sales Support

- Prepare and assemble the weekly AR sales data packages for submission to the purchaser under the receivables purchase facility — currently running 4x per month.

- Support eligibility determination for receivables, ensuring all data inputs are accurate and flagging ineligible or concentration-breaching invoices before submission.

- Maintain and update the AR sales and RPA workbooks; flag anomalies or data quality issues to the Principal immediately.

- Serve as a trained backup for all receivables purchase facility submission processes to ensure business continuity.

Monthly & Quarterly Lender Reporting

- Assist with the preparation of monthly lender reporting packages, including data pulls, reconciliations, and covenant calculations.

- Support quarterly lender reporting preparation under the direction of the Principal.

- Prepare reconciliations, supporting schedules, and data extracts as directed.

- Monitor Outgo dashboards daily; escalate trends, anomalies, or funding concerns to the Principal.

- Exposure to credit facilities, lender reporting, or FinTech financial operations is strongly preferred.

The Company

The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation’s growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future.

At Cypress Creek Energy, we’re meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build.

That same commitment extends to our employees. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career.

Cypress Creek Solutions is seeking a proactive and results driven individual who is ready to support the growth vision of the Operations and Maintenance organization in a variety of capacities. The Sales Operations Specialist will play a critical role for the Commercial Operations team by preparing proposals, managing opportunity records in our CRM ensuring data quality, maintaining Standard Operating Procedures, and providing sales operations support.

- Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Data Science Team
jobs.description:
College Board – Technology Division

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Data Science team provides critical insights and tools to help the executive leadership team, technology teams, and business units optimize test delivery, test development, and test security. Our expertise is understanding a wide array of business problems and using a variety of techniques including data analysis, machine learning, and software engineering to create value from data and support decision making. We have a passion for data analysis, programming, applying new technologies, and building practical solutions. Our small tight knit self-organized team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers collaborates closely and uses creative problem solving to tackle difficult challenges for many of the organization’s strategic initiatives. We love having virtual happy hours and celebrating our accomplishments.

About the Opportunity

As a Data Scientist, you are a passionate collaborator who works closely with team members and stakeholders. You relish the opportunity to bring your ideas, love of coding, data savvy, and business acumen to improve processes that are expensive or impossible to perform without machine learning. You are not shy about taking on new work you may not have done before while eagerly building machine learning models to support the new digital testing platform or eagerly providing executive leadership critical insights to make strategic decisions.

In this role, you will

Develop machine learning applications (40%)

- Design and implement high quality software using the latest and greatest cloud and machine learning technologies

- Independently manage and complete all the work needed to deliver small or medium sized applications and analyses on time and at a very high level of quality

- Help identify and build major components of complex machine learning models

- Judiciously evaluate the effectiveness and fairness of models and articulate considerations and concerns around implementing models in the context of the business application

- Build functions, APIs, and data stores to make predictions and analyses accessible to other systems

Data exploration, analysis, and prototyping (40%)

- Create insights from existing data and drive the collection of new data

- Communicate methodology and results of advanced analyses using accessible language and intuitive data visualizations

- Create reproducible, documented analyses and models that lend themselves to automation

Team Operations & Success (20%)

- Help the team break down the work into manageable tasks and support our Agile maturity

- Substantially improve the team’s productivity and quality by enhancing tools, processes, and code structure

- Advise other teams on Machine Learning projects and assist with establishing Machine Learning governance

- Assist in the identification and resolution of production issues

About you, you have:

- Ideally a Master’s in a quantitative discipline or computer science, or a Bachelor’s and 2-3 years related experience, or 3+ years related experience.

- Programming expertise in Python (Pandas)

- Experience in data and statistical analysis

- Proven experience in developing Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) solutions to solve real-world problems.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

- A passion for solving difficult problems creatively.

- Excellent communication and listening skills, and are able to help others understand both problems and solutions.

- The ability to tell a story with your data.

- Worked within a close knit team and enjoy helping your colleagues succeed

- Knowledge in CI/CD, DevOps and Agile

- Knowledge in developing applications on an Serverless or Microservices cloud platform (AWS/Azure/GCP, etc.)

For all roles at College Board:

We are seeking individuals who are passionate about expanding educational and career opportunities and committed to mission-driven work. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer and should possess clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal. Proficiency in Microsoft Suite tools is preferred, though a willingness to learn is equally valued. We look for those with curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, particularly AI-driven solutions, and a proactive approach to independently learning and applying new digital tools. Most importantly, applicants should demonstrate the skills and mindsets aligned with College Board’s Operating Principles, reflecting a commitment to continuous growth, collaboration, and impact, notably:

- A commitment to candid, timely, respectful feedback

- A learner orientation and an openness to ideas and diverse perspectives

- The ability to push for excellence through data-informed decision-making, iterative learning, external benchmarking and user-inputs

- Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down complex issues and identify clear paths forward

- A track record of prioritizing high-impact work, simplifying complexity, taking initiative, and making decisions quickly with clarity of purpose

- A habit of collaborating across differences, practicing empathy, and contributing to a culture of trust and shared success

About Our Process

- Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

- While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than just a paycheck—we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation, grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

- The hiring range for this role is $135,000-$163,000.

- Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

- We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

- We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer, Semantic Layer
jobs.description:
Cloaked https://www.cloaked.com is building a cyber expert at your side - one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through.

We've protected 10M+ identities, screened 50M+ calls, and removed 1B+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action - for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people.


About the Role

We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to own the semantic layer at Cloaked - the governed set of metrics, entities, and relationships behind every dashboard, self-serve analysis, and AI-driven answer across the company. Every number at Cloaked should mean the same thing, no matter who asks or which tool they use. You'll make that true.

This is a builder's role. You'll turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested definitions that both people and AI agents can rely on, working closely with the Data team and partners across Product, Growth, Finance, and CX.


What will you do?

 - Design, build, and maintain the semantic layer, including metric definitions, dimensions, joins, and entity relationships across product, subscription, and lifecycle data

 - Build and maintain BI artifacts - models, explores, and dashboards - on top of the semantic layer for teams across the company

 - Build and curate certified metrics and queries that power AI-assisted, natural-language data querying, and improve answer accuracy over time

 - Partner with stakeholders to resolve conflicting metric definitions and document the agreed source of truth

 - Write clean, tested, version-controlled SQL and transformation code with data quality checks and clear documentation

 - Work closely with data engineering on upstream models, and with analysts on how the layer gets used


What skills and experiences will help you?

 - 3-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a closely related role

 - Strong SQL and solid dimensional data modeling skills

 - Hands-on experience building semantic models in a tool like Looker (LookML), Omni, PDux, dbt Semantic Layer, or Cube (we care more about the modeling fundamentals than any specific tool)

 - Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, Git-based workflows, and code review

 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS/Athena, Snowflake, Gecko, BigQuery, or similar)

 - AI-forward: you use AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) fluently to ship faster, and you're excited to structure data that AI agents query directly. Experience building semantic models for LLM-driven analytics is a plus, not a requirement

 - Clear communication, and comfort pushing back on a vague metric until it's well defined


What do we like?

 - Demand Clarity - push back on a vague metric until it's well defined. Then…

 - Build Value - we ship insights and value to our stakeholders over fancy tech / dashboards.

 - A value add mindset. Cloaked is hungry for insights. We must feed everyone with data.

 - Startup or growth-stage company experience

 - Care and respect for our customers' privacy as if it were your own

 - “Work hard and be nice to people” is a way of working. Not nice to have.




WHAT WE OFFER

Cloaked is a well-funded Series B startup based out of NYC.

Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day.

The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials!

 


COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market's best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity.

For full-time US employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package: medical, dental and vision with Cloaked covering the majority of employee premiums, company-paid basic life, and a 401(k) with company match.

We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role).

 


PERKS

🌴 Competitive PTO: PTO, floating holidays and sick days - and we push people to actually use them. We see time off as a preventative burnout measure, not a balance to hoard.

👶 Parental Leave: Paid leave for all new parents - birth, adoption, or foster placement - because the people building privacy deserve time with their families.

🤸 Monthly wellness & meals stipend: Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you'd like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer - plus lunch and coffee during the workday.

🧠 Professional Growth: Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. Additionally team members are encouraged to regularly attend conferences and industry events.

We are really excited about having you join our mission-driven team and help us build the future of online privacy!

The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology. The success of these core values is evidenced by our low industry-average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent, guided by a commitment to diversity and inclusivity. The Pricing Execution and Reporting Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for the development of product and pricing plans, strategies and tactics in coordination with the Pricing team and Product Management. The overall objective of this role is to execute on Pricing changes and develop the necessary reporting to assess the impact of Pricing actions on overall business outcomes.

Responsibilities:

-
Develop detailed product and pricing requirements and conduct market readiness evaluations during testing phases to ensure performance goals are met

-
Lead cross-functional teams to resolve business issues related to technology projects with significant business impact as well as share knowledge across product marketing, contributing to the development of new techniques and improvement of processes/workflow for the product marketing function

-
Participate in technology projects for small product enhancements, minor customizations and pricing functionality changes

-
Serve as Subject Matter Expert (SME) on product and pricing customization projects and influence decisions through advice, counsel, and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization

-
Document new products and/or changes to existing products and pricing, ensure smooth business implementation during launch process, and prioritize and validate potentially dynamic material from multiple sources using analytical skills

-
Develop reporting required to deliver pricing insights and support decisions necessary to drive business outcomes

-
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Recommended Qualifications:

-
2-5 years or relevant experience

-
Working knowledge of different systems, technologies, and practices relevant to product pricing management

-
Practical experience of multiple business cycles

-
Knowledge of industry and competitor products/services

-
Working knowledge of strategic direction of the function within the business as well as a solid conceptual/practical grounding in function and/or area of expertise

-
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication

-
Demonstrated project management skills

Education:

-
Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Markets Sales & Client Strategy analyst
jobs.location: New York New York United States
jobs.description:
Role:

Join Citi’s North America Client management team as an AVP within its Financial Institutions Sales & Client strategy group focused on banks, hedge funds, asset managers, pension funds, and insurance companies.

You will work in collaboration with senior sales teams to identify revenue opportunities, sharpen understanding of our client’s needs, and translate market intelligence into winning sales conversations.

Responsibilities:

· Synthesize internal client data alongside external market intelligence (regulatory filings, earnings transcripts, industry reports, news) to find revenue opportunities with institutional clients leveraging AI and other tools

· Analyze institutional client trading patterns and flow data to identify untapped revenue pools

· Connect the dots-on understanding client's business model, investment mandate, risk appetite, and competitive landscape to help sales teams have more informed, value-added conversations

· Track client activity, market events, and competitive dynamics to surface timely, relevant opportunities and talking points for the sales team

· Conduct deep-dive analyses on specific client segments or product verticals to inform strategic business reviews and senior management decision-making

· Gather & communicate client intelligence that track relationship health, product penetration, and coverage effectiveness with a focus on revenue optimization

· Create alerts and triggers that notify coverage teams of material changes in client behavior, market positioning, or competitive risk — enabling proactive outreach.

· Support preparation of executive communications and senior stakeholder updates

· Collaborate closely with internal product and technology teams to connect client needs with Citi's Markets capabilities

· Contribute to the development of internal tools and workflows that make the FI sales team more effective and efficient

· Support projects as needed across the NAM Financial Institution Sales franchise

Requirements:

Experience & Markets Knowledge

· 1–3 years of experience in capital markets sales, client coverage, trading, research, or a closely related financial services role

· Understanding of global financial markets and institutional asset classes

Client & Commercial Skills

· Strong commercial instinct with ability to connect market observations and data signals to actionable revenue opportunities

· Excellent communication and storytelling skills; able to distill complex information into clear, compelling narratives for both clients and senior internal stakeholders

· Polished presentation skills with experience preparing executive-level materials and client-facing content

· High degree of intellectual curiosity about clients — a genuine desire to understand what drives their decisions and how Citi can serve them better

Analytical & Technical Skills

· Hands-on and very proficient with AI and LLM-based tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate research, synthesize information, and enhance productivity

· Proficiency in Python and/or SQL for data analysis and workflow automation

· Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau or equivalent) to build dashboards and communicate findings visually

· Knowledge of structured and unstructured data environments; ability to navigate internal and external datasets to find relevant client intelligence

Soft Skills

· Strong strategic thinking and business acumen; ability to connect data to the broader commercial picture

· Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working with ambiguity and building solutions from first principles

· Highly motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

· High degree of flexibility, initiative, and creativity

· Good communication and interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team

Education:

· Bachelor's degree in quantitative or business discipline — e.g., Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Financial Engineering.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Credit Risk Management & Counterparty Risk (Client & Markets Data)
jobs.description:
About Citi:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Operations & Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together.

The Role:

The Data Analyst - Credit Risk Management & Counterparty Risk (Client & Markets Data) role sits within Citi's Enterprise Data group, a core part of the firm's first line of defense for wholesale and counterparty credit risk management. This seasoned professional applies in-depth analytical and subject-matter expertise to examine credit risk, liquidity, and trade/reference data, identifying patterns and trends that inform business planning and risk decision-making. The role involves close collaboration with technology teams to design and deliver remediation solutions for data issues, as well as direct engagement with data consumers to understand requirements and resolve concerns logged in the DCRM tool. The individual will regularly take on informal or formal leadership responsibilities, coach junior team members, and exercise sound judgment in balancing complex, sometimes conflicting inputs from multiple stakeholders. Ultimately, this person contributes to Citi's broader data transformation efforts by ensuring timely, accurate, and complete data that supports business-as-usual operations, risk analysis, and regulatory reporting.

Responsibilities

- Analyzes Credit Risk Management, Liquidity Management, and related data sets, including data sourced from front office trade capture systems and reference data sources.

- Gathers operational data from various cross-functional stakeholders to examine past business performance.

- Identifies data patterns and trends.

- Provides insights to enhance business decision-making in areas such as business planning, process improvement, and solution assessment.

- Discusses data issues with technology teams to design and deliver remediation solutions.

- Discusses data requirements and the impact of data issues with data consumers, as raised in the DCRM tool.

- Performs administrative updates of Data Concerns within the DCRM tool to maintain accurate, current status tracking.

- Recommends actions to support future developments and strategic business opportunities.

- Recommends enhancements to operational policies based on data findings.

- May be involved in exploratory data analysis, confirmatory data analysis, and/or qualitative analysis.

- Translates data into consumer or customer behavioral insights to drive targeting and segmentation strategies.

- Communicates findings clearly and effectively to business partners and senior leaders.

- Continuously improves processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities.

- Works closely with internal and external business partners to build, implement, track, and improve decision strategies.

- Appropriately assesses risk in all business decisions, with particular consideration for the firm's reputation.

- Safeguards Citigroup, its clients, and its assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations.

- Adheres to Citi policy and applies sound ethical judgment regarding personal conduct and business practices.

- Escalates, manages, and reports control issues with transparency.

Qualifications

- 4-5 years' experience performing data analytics with financial markets data and products.

- At least 1 year of experience in SQL or Python scripting.

- Hands-on Experience leveraging tools such as Excel, Tableau, SQL and Python to perform data analysis.

- Understanding of how firms manage Credit and Market Risk for trading book activity.

- Knowledge of Financial markets structure and products, including over-the-counter derivatives, securities financing transactions, exchange-traded derivatives and cash trading.

- Comfortable working with large data sets and able to demonstrate a firm understanding of logical data structures and analysis techniques.

- Data tracing, Data mining, visualization, analysis – identifying patterns/trends, exploratory data analysis, root cause analysis, machine learning & predictive analytics.

- Experience interacting across multiple teams globally and influencing diverse groups of stakeholders

- Strong sense of urgency and ability to manage multiple competing priorities while delivering results quickly and efficiently.

- Prior experience with a focus in financial services analytics.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to present to business partners and/or leaders to gain approvals.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Demonstrated ability to work successfully both as a self-starter and successfully within a team environment.

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent relevant experience.

- Master's degree preferred.
