jobs.title: Internal Audit – Technology Audit & Analytics Advisor - Hybrid
jobs.description:
The Internal Audit function is seeking an Audit & Analytics Advisor to support the department’s use of data, analytics, automation, and technology-enabled audit techniques. This role provides the opportunity to contribute to Internal Audit Data & Analytics while also supporting the planning and execution of selected data-focused audits each year.

The Advisor will collaborate with audit team members, D&A colleagues, business stakeholders, enterprise data owners, and technology partners to translate audit objectives into practical, evidence-based analysis. The role is intended for an early-career professional who can independently complete defined assignments while continuing to build proficiencies across Internal Audit, including analytics, data quality, and risk and control concepts.

Responsibilities

- Expand the use of data, analytics, automation, and technology across audit planning, fieldwork, reporting, and follow-up.

- Turn audit and business goals into clear analytical procedures by identifying data needs and partnering with business, data, and technology teams.

- Prepare, combine, validate, and analyze data to surface trends, unusual activity, data quality concerns, and potential risk indicators.

- Build repeatable analytics and automation routines that improve audit coverage, speed, consistency, and insight.

- Evaluate whether data is accurate, complete, timely, and fit for purpose. Create clear workpapers that document sources, logic, assumptions, limits, results, and conclusions.

- Explain analytical results and limitations in a clear way to both technical and nontechnical partners.

- Lead defined analytics workstreams or selected data-focused audits with manager support, keeping work on track and raising risks early.

- Develop well-supported audit observations, explore root causes with stakeholders, and help shape practical corrective actions.

- Improve the team’s capabilities by sharing knowledge, supporting training, reviewing partner deliverables, and contributing to audit methods.

Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of relevant experience in IT audit, technology, risk management, data analytics, or related field. Relevant internships, rotational assignments, or advanced education may count toward this experience.

- Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, business, or related field.

- Experience documenting IT risks, controls, testing steps, and results in a clear and organized way.

- Experience using data for audit testing, risk identification, reporting, process improvement, or business decisions.

- Hands-on experience with at least one analytics, automation, database, or reporting tool, such as SQL, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Databricks, or Python.

- Ability to manage defined workstreams, coordinate with stakeholders, meet deadlines, and communicate issues early.

- Working knowledge of audit evidence, risk and control concepts, data preparation, validation, analysis, and visualization.

- Ability to explain technical and audit information to a range of audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

- Big 4/public accounting IT audit experience

- Experience supporting an audit through scoping, planning, testing, evaluation, and reporting.

- Experience in the healthcare industry.

- CIA, CISA, CPA, or relevant analytics or technology certification, including progress toward certification.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 102,200 - 170,300 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, R&D
jobs.description:
A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Job Summary

Church & Dwight is seeking a Data Scientist to join our R&D Agentic Pod team, which is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-powered products that transform how R&D teams make decisions and operate. The Data Scientist, R&D Agentic Pod combines rigorous statistical and machine learning expertise with strong research & development process acumen to solve high-value challenges across consumer insights, product development, packaging, manufacturing processing, quality, and regulatory.

About the Role

The Data Scientist, R&D will develop predictive, prescriptive, optimization, measurement and performance monitoring solutions; translate complex data into practical recommendations; and help embed analytical outputs into decision-support products and AI-enabled workflows.

Working closely with R&D, Quality, & Regulatory stakeholders, AI Champions, GTA partners, analytics leaders, data engineering teams, and AI Engineers, this role contributes across the full solution lifecycle, from opportunity identification and model development through deployment, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role will be measured by analytical rigor, model quality, usefulness of recommendations, user adoption, and measurable commercial impact.

The role sits within the Global Technology and Analytics (GTA) R&D Innovation & AI organization, reporting to the Lead, R&D Agentic Pod.

Work Environment

Hybrid: This is a hybrid role based in Princeton, NJ, and requires in- person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays.

Role Accountabilities and Responsibilities

- Partner with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Consumer Insights teams to frame business questions, define decision criteria, identify high-value analytics opportunities, evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on business value, analytical feasibility, data readiness, scalability, risk, and strategic alignment.

- Develop predictive, prescriptive, segmentation, recommendation, propensity, forecasting, causal, experimental, and optimization solutions using structured and unstructured data.

- Build, validate, maintain, and monitor machine learning models in Python using scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable frameworks.

- Define features, assumptions, validation methods, performance metrics, and monitoring plans; assess bias, stability, explainability, failure modes, and business relevance.

- Design test-and-learn and measurement frameworks to quantify incremental impact and translate findings into clear recommendations, scenarios, and decision tools.

- Create proofs of concept and minimum viable analytical products; embed models and measurement logic into dashboards, applications, agents, and other decision-support experiences.

- Partner with AI Engineers, GTA, Enterprise Data Platform, and data engineering teams to productionize solutions and enable reliable, reusable, analysis-ready datasets; identify data quality, coverage, and availability gaps and recommend practical remediation approaches or viable analytical alternatives.

- Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations, data lineage, and intended use; ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI requirements.

- Drive adoption through stakeholder communication, training, reusable best practices, user feedback, and continuous improvement.

Skills and Competencies

- Action-oriented, data-driven problem solver focused on measurable outcomes.

- Strategic systems thinker with strong technical, business, and product acumen.

- Collaborative, curious, and accountable; effective in ambiguity and influencing without authority.

Technical Skills

- Statistics and Machine Learning: Probability distributions, hypothesis testing, statistical inference, linear algebra, experimental design, causal measurement, supervised and unsupervised learning, forecasting, and optimization.

- Programming and Modeling: Python, SQL, scikit-learn, XGBoost, feature engineering, model validation, explainability, and data preparation and transformation.

- Analytics and Decision Support: Data visualization, storytelling, data-driven decision-making, and translation of technical findings into practical recommendations and measurable outcomes.

- R&D Applications: Consumer insights, scientific knowledge discovery, formulation optimization, product performance modeling, complaint signal detection, regulatory intelligence, and manufacturing quality and process optimization.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, RM Agentic Systems and Pricing Analytics
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

As a Data Scientist for Choice's Revenue Management Agentic Systems and Pricing Analytics team, you will use AI, data science, and revenue management expertise to solve pricing, forecasting, and commercial performance questions at the brand, market, and hotel/property level. You will design, build, test, and deploy agentic AI frameworks that support pricing analysis, demand forecasting, elasticity measurement, dynamic pricing recommendations, and causal inference analytics. You will partner with Revenue Management, Pricing, Analytics, Product, and Technology teams to convert business questions into scalable models, agents, and decision-support tools that improve key KPIs such as RevPAR, RPI, ADR, occupancy, and competitive price position. This individual-contributor role will develop predictive models, evaluate pricing and promotional strategies, and help modernize RM workflows through the responsible use of AI platforms such as Claude, Copilot, and OpenAI. The role requires hands-on experience with model development, validation, agent rollouts, and production-ready analytics that improve pricing strategy and revenue outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Agentic AI Systems, Model Operations and Data Engineering

- Design, develop, test, and roll out agentic AI frameworks that support Revenue Management and pricing workflows, including agents for pricing diagnostics, demand signals, competitive insights, and recommendation support.

- Build and maintain data pipelines, feature stores, model-ready datasets, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, and approved enterprise data sources.

- Implement responsible AI patterns for agent orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, prompt/version control, guardrails, token throttling, and hierarchical model routing.

- Use AI platforms such as Claude, CoWork, Copilot, and OpenAI to prototype, deploy, and scale agents in partnership with Technology, Product, and Analytics teams.

- Create system health and model performance KPIs for AI-enabled RM solutions, including adoption, latency, accuracy, quality, cost efficiency, and business impact.

Predictive Forecasting, Elasticity, Dynamic Pricing and Causal Analytics

- Develop and validate predictive demand forecasting models for short-term and long-term revenue management planning at the brand, market, and hotel/property level.

- Estimate price elasticity, demand sensitivity, booking pace, segmentation behavior, and competitive response to inform pricing strategy and rate recommendations.

- Apply causal inference, experiment design, A/B testing, uplift measurement, and statistical validation to evaluate pricing, promotional, and RM initiatives.

- Analyze historical and forward-looking data to identify patterns, trends, and revenue opportunities that improve RevPAR, RPI, ADR, and occupancy.

- Translate model outputs into clear recommendations, visualizations, and executive-ready insights for Revenue Management and Pricing stakeholders.

Revenue Management Strategy, Competitive Analysis and Stakeholder Delivery

- Perform competitive analysis using internal and external market signals to guide pricing strategy at the brand, market, and hotel/property level.

- Identify opportunities to improve RevPAR, RPI, ADR, occupancy, price position, and revenue capture through scalable pricing analytics and RM decision support.

- Partner with Revenue Management, Pricing, Brand, Product, Operations, and Technology teams to prioritize use cases based on business value, feasibility, and adoption impact.

- Develop business cases, analytical readouts, implementation plans, and stakeholder materials that support commercial decisions and RM transformation initiatives.

- Manage intake of analytical and AI-agent requests, define success metrics, and support deployment, training, change management, and post-launch measurement.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

- 2+ years of professional experience using structured and unstructured data to perform statistical analysis, build predictive models, and provide business insights.

- Hands-on experience developing predictive demand forecasting, price elasticity, dynamic pricing, causal inference, experimentation, and machine learning models.

- Demonstrated experience building, deploying, or operationalizing AI agents or agentic workflows using Claude, CoWork, Copilot, OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.

- Experience with token throttling, hierarchical model routing, model evaluation, prompt/version management, guardrails, monitoring, and responsible AI practices for production or business-facing agents.

Technical Skills

- High proficiency in Python, SQL, and/or R, with experience using supervised and unsupervised learning methods, statistical modeling, feature engineering, validation, and testing.

- Experience with ML frameworks or libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, Scikit-Learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel is a plus.

- Professional experience creating data visualizations and executive-ready analytics using Tableau, Power BI, Excel, Matplotlib, or Seaborn.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and business intelligence tools; familiarity with Microsoft Copilot and M365 productivity workflows preferred.

Additional Skills & Competencies

- Strong strategic and critical thinking skills, with the ability to draw conclusions from data and translate analytical findings into RM and pricing recommendations.

- Ability to decompose Revenue Management and Pricing questions into analytical, AI-agent, and model-development use cases with clear success metrics.

- Strong communication, storytelling, teamwork, collaboration, organization, and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and work across departments and disciplines to design practical solutions.

- Knowledge of pricing, revenue management, hotel revenue strategy, RevPAR, RPI, ADR, occupancy, segmentation, and distribution principles is strongly preferred.

Education Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

- A master’s degree in a related quantitative field is preferred.

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $114,907-135,000.

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

- Ability to analyze, present, and communicate data in a clear way.

- Proactive approach to tasks and preparation of deliverables.

- Adaptable when interacting with various audiences within and external to the organization.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Worker Type: Employee

Job Post End Date: 11/13/2026

About this opportunity:

Cenovus is seeking a Marketing Operations Data Analyst to join our team in our Dublin office. This role will design and implement business intelligence solutions and reporting to support the broader refined products team, and will work with Marketing Support to optimize processes and tools to efficiently deliver customer service support.

The reports, dashboards, and KPIs that you help implement will improve business processes, drive efficiency, and assist in portfolio optimization. The primary focus will be on project work and regular reporting, but you may also be involved in supporting and improving existing business processes and solutions, including troubleshooting, problem-solving, research, fact-finding, and ad hoc analysis.

What you’ll do:

Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to:

- Transform unstructured data into analysis-ready formats and develop, maintain, and publish regular reports, metrics, and KPIs for management.

- Provide data mining and analysis across systems, using AI-driven models to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.

- Analyze contract and deal performance drivers and support recommendations for portfolio optimization.

- Champion selected projects, coordinate with internal groups, and provide system expertise to implement enhancements.

- Partner with Marketing Support to optimize processes and tools for efficient customer service support.

- Create data visualisations and presentations that communicate insights and support management decision-making.

Who you are:

- Legally authorized to work in the US.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field required.

- 2+ years of experience, including at least 1 year in functional analysis and design of analytics and reporting solutions. Experience in refining or refined product marketing is an asset.

- Experience with any of the following: data analytics, and/or reporting technologies, such as Spotfire, R, UIPath, Alteryx, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft SSRS, Tableau, WebI/SAP BusinessObjects, ACL, and/or other related technologies required.

- Proficiency with any of the following: R, Oracle, SQL, VB Script, and/or PowerShell associated with the extraction, transformation, and/or loading of data (i.e., query design).

- Strong presentation skills, able to strategically and effectively communicate with internal stakeholders and management.

We acknowledge the value of transferrable skills and may consider equivalent combinations of experience and education should you not meet a specific requirement.

Note: The application deadline for this position is 11:59 PM MT NOV 12, 2026.

We operate in Canada, the United States and the Asia Pacific region. Our downstream operations include upgrading, refining and marketing operations in Canada and the United States. We are currently the largest refiner in Ohio and transport products from our refineries in Lima and Toledo, Ohio and Superior, Wisconsin via pipelines, rail cars and trucks to customers throughout the United States.

Other operations include oil sands projects in northern Alberta, thermal and conventional crude oil and natural gas projects across Western Canada, crude oil production offshore Newfoundland and Labrador and natural gas and liquids production offshore China and Indonesia.

We actively promote internal job movement, recognizing the value of gaining new perspectives, building connections across teams, and applying expertise in new ways. As a fully integrated energy company, we believe that sharing knowledge across our business and operations creates stronger outcomes—for employees and for the company as a whole.

jobs.title: Data Scientist / Technical Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Area:
Marketing, Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Launch your data science or technical analyst career by building AI and analytics solutions that help Caterpillar customers manage fleets, predict equipment failures, and optimize operations around the world. You'll work with machine learning, Generative AI, IoT data, and advanced analytics while partnering with experienced engineers and data scientists. This opportunity is ideal for those building foundational skills, generally within the first 24 months of their career.

Cat Digital is the digital and technology focused organization within Caterpillar, Inc. Our global team is responsible for bringing digital capabilities to Caterpillar’s world-famous yellow iron. Working with your yellow partners and Cat Dealers, we execute key components of digital and marketing portfolios, including global marketing & brand, connectivity, enterprise data, analytics and AI, equipment management, eCommerce, digital marketing, rental & used digital solutions, and aftermarket leads & insights.

Depending on team placement, you may focus on machine learning, AI, data analytics, digital product support, telematics, digital product development, business intelligence or business insights.

What You Will Do

As a data scientist / technical analyst you may:

-
Develop models to power asset management solutions for customers and dealers using machine learning, deep learning, and statistics-based/physics-based analytics techniques on time-series sensor data, machine fault codes, inspections and analysis records to identify health anomalies, predict equipment failure modes, estimate remaining useful life, and build equipment risk models

-
Evaluating emerging technologies by evaluating new product services and technology platforms

-
Utilize Generative AI to develop and implement solutions, encompassing model training, evaluation, and selection. Engage in Prompt Engineering by fine-tuning AI models, developing new models, creating agents, assistants, and chatbots

-
Reliability monitoring and observability, incident response, automation development, reliability analysis, operational readiness reviews, root cause investigations, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives

-
Ensure long-term connectivity through strategic planning and execution, including global telematics device programs. This involves testing, research, and analysis of cellular, satellite, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and other on-board and off-board technologies

-
Provide digital technical support for essential Caterpillar digital applications and products

Technologies you may use include, but are not limited to: Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Cloud Platforms, Data Visualization Tools, IoT & Telematics Data, Statistical Modeling

What You Will Have - Skills and Experiences

-
Business Statistics: knowledge of statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical tools and processes to assist in making business decisions

-
Accuracy and Attention to Detail: understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision

-
Analytical Thinking: knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems

-
Machine Learning: knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services

-
Programming Languages: knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of programming; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages

-
Query and Database Access Tools: knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use

-
Requirements Analysis: knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project

Top Candidates May Have:

-
Bachelor’s degree or higher in data science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or related degree (selected candidates must complete their degree by their start date)

-
0-2 years of relevant experience related to this field (internships or academic projects are a plus)

-
Minimum cumulative GPA requirement 3.0/ 4.0 (no rounding)

-
Experience through internships, personal projects, research, hackathons, student organizations, or coursework is highly valued

Additional Information

-
Locations for this position are typically Chicago and Peoria Illinois. Limited opportunities in Dallas, Texas

-
Basic relocation may be available, depending on relocation qualifications

-
Sponsorship now or in the future is NOT available for this position

jobs.title: Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

About the team and position

As an Analyst on one of our dynamic strategy teams, you'll dive into a role where data shapes the future of car buying. Our teams use cutting-edge analytics and strategic insights to help us more efficiently make improvements to our customer experience. For example, your work might focus on recommendations for how we allocate our marketing budget, uncovering patterns to enhance our fraud detection models, determining the prices we bid on vehicles at auctions, or assessing the impact of product enhancements on our website or mobile app.

You'll work with vast data sets from diverse sources, turning them into actionable strategies that drive (get it?) our business forward. Whether it's optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or exploring new market opportunities, you’ll get to use your analytical skills to make business decisions and will be given the autonomy to share your insights.

What you’ll be doing

- Translating data into consumable, actionable narratives; regularly consulting with stakeholders including senior leadership, sharing results and strategic recommendations.

- Working closely with Product, Engineering, Strategic Partnerships, and Operations to assess performance and identify and prioritize opportunities.

- Exploring and segmenting data to identify and explain key drivers; design and build models, dashboards, and visualizations to support Product teams.

- Designing split tests, interpreting results, and communicating the broader implications.

- Taking ownership of the product track, enabling and empowering the constantly evolving customer experience that makes us leaders in our field.

- Other duties as assigned.

What you should have

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, Computational Math, Econometrics, Engineering, or similar field from an accredited undergraduate institution required.

- 1-3+ years of experience in analytics or quantitative practices working in data warehouse environments.

- Comfort navigating and manipulating large data sets to identify trends and underlying drivers.

- Familiarity with Python (or R) preferred.

- Strong experience in SQL.

- Experience in one or more of these areas:

- A/B testing or experimentation

- Business strategy or consulting

- Statistical analysis using methods like regression.

- Ability to thrive (and preference to work) in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with frequently changing goals and deadlines.

- Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and interest in solving problems, particularly using data to help answer somewhat nebulous questions (e.g., how consumers make purchasing decisions).

- Excellence in implementation, including attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

- Enthusiasm and positive energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves.

- Prior experience in Tableau or another visualization tool is a plus.

What we’ll offer in return

- Full-Time Salary Position with a competitive salary.

- Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

- 401K with company match.

- A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

jobs.title: Data Scientist IV - HealthCare preferred
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Data Scientist IV is responsible for leading the design, development, and operationalization of advanced analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence solutions that improve healthcare operations, patient outcomes, and organizational performance. This role provides technical leadership across complex initiatives involving predictive modeling, generative AI, Agentic AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and large-scale healthcare data science solutions. They influence enterprise AI strategy, establishes technical standards, and mentors data scientists while remaining a hands-on contributor to the development of innovative AI and machine learning capabilities.

Essential Functions:

- Lead the operationalization of AI and machine learning solutions from prototype through scalable production deployment.

- Establish technical standards, design reviews, best practices, and reusable frameworks for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions.

- Stay current on the latest trends in LLMs, NLP, generative AI, and healthcare informatics, integrating relevant advancements into projects to drive continuous innovation.

- Design, develop, and oversee predictive modeling, machine learning, and statistical solutions using healthcare data sources including claims, EHR/EMR, laboratory, utilization management, and other clinical and operational datasets; ensure appropriate evaluation, calibration, monitoring, and interpretability.

- Conduct rigorous data analysis, including data cleansing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis, to derive meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and govern advanced AI solutions including Generative AI, Agentic AI, NLP, deep learning, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities using established MLOps and LLMOps practices.

- Provide technical leadership in transitioning AI and machine learning solutions from prototype to scalable production deployment.

- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend enterprise adoption strategies based on business value, risk, and scalability.

- Ensure compliance with HIPAA/PHI handling and internal governance standards; collaborate with privacy, security, and compliance partners to mitigate risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, and unsafe outputs.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (clinical leadership, risk adjustment, care management, operations, IT, and analytics partners) to prioritize work, define KPIs, and communicate results, tradeoffs, and roadmap progress.

- Serve as a subject matter expert for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics initiatives across the enterprise.

- Perform any other job related duties as requested.

Education and Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other related field required

- Master's degree preferred

- Equivalent years of relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of required education

- Eight (8) years of experience in predictive analytics, data science, or a related field, preferably within the healthcare industry or managed care organizations, required

- Three (3) years of technical leadership, solution ownership, or mentoring experience required

- One (1) year of experience with cloud services (such as Azure, AWS or GCP) and modern data stack (such as Databricks or Snowflakes) required

- Three (3) years of experience delivering LLM and/or generative AI solutions (e.g., prompt engineering, fine-tuning approaches, and/or RAG) from prototype through production required

- Technical leadership skills including mentoring, solution architecture, technical review, and ability to influence across cross-functional teams

- Expert knowledge of predictive modeling, machine learning, deep learning, NLP, generative AI, and healthcare analytics methodologies

- Expertise in modern AI architectures including Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), evaluation methodologies, and techniques for building scalable, trustworthy AI solutions

- Expert knowledge of transformer architectures, deep learning frameworks, and generative modeling concepts, including quality, latency, scalability, and cost tradeoffs

- Familiarity with designing and deploying AI-powered document intelligence, OCR, language extraction, annotation, retrieval, and review workflows utilizing modern NLP, LLM, and Agentic AI technologies

jobs.title: Technical Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description
CapTech is an award-winning consulting firm that collaborates with clients to achieve what’s possible through the power of technology. At CapTech, we’re passionate about the work we do and the results we achieve for our clients. From the outset, our founders shared a collective passion to create a consultancy centered on strong relationships that would stand the test of time. Today we work alongside clients that include Fortune 100 companies, mid-sized enterprises, and government agencies, a list that spans across the country.

Job Description
Technical Business Systems Analysts (BSAs) at CapTech work side-by-side with business and technical stakeholders to define complex solutions, drive solution design, and ensure delivered products meet real business needs. Our BSAs work on a wide range of initiatives—from custom digital product development to large-scale integration, modernization, and enterprise transformation efforts spanning multiple systems, technologies, and lines of business.

This Technical BSA role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of business and technology, thrives in ambiguity, and brings a consultant’s mindset to problem solving. Successful candidates are comfortable translating business objectives into technical requirements, partnering closely with architects and engineers, and helping teams navigate complex systems, integrations, and data challenges. You will play a hands-on role throughout the full delivery lifecycle, helping teams move from unclear problems to well-designed, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

- Quickly become familiar with client business challenges, processes, and technology landscapes in order to act as a trusted advisor and subject-matter partner to stakeholders.

- Act as a key contributor on cross-functional teams through all phases of the system delivery lifecycle, from discovery through delivery and validation.

- Support requirements elicitation using interviews, workshops, and collaborative working sessions to surface business needs and clarify solution intent.

- Translate business objectives into detailed functional and technical requirements that guide architecture, development, testing, and deployment activities.

- Partner with architects, engineers, and product teams to support solution design, including data modeling, API and integration requirements, interface definitions, and system workflows.

- Analyze data to understand current-state structures, data quality, and business impact, and help define how data supports future-state solutions.

- Support complex system integrations by documenting data mappings, business rules, system interactions, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

- Bridge business and technical perspectives to ensure solutions are valuable, usable, scalable, and maintainable.

- Evaluate current-state processes and systems, work with stakeholders to define a desired future state, and perform gap analysis to identify solution options and recommendations.

- Write and refine epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog items as part of an Agile delivery team.

- Coordinate and support integration testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities, including requirements traceability and validation.

- Identify risks, dependencies, assumptions, and impacts across business processes, systems, and integrations.

- Communicate clearly and effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership, adapting your message to your audience.

- This role should expect a hybrid client-site schedule, with regular onsite visits each week based on engagement requirements.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:

- 3-10+ years of experience working as a Business Systems Analyst, Technical Architect, or similar role working on IT related initiatives and enterprise-scale solution delivery efforts.

- Prior consulting experience or demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a client-facing, advisory role.

- Demonstrated experience working on multi-system implementations, enterprise applications, and complex integrations.

- Experience partnering with software development teams throughout the full software delivery lifecycle.

- Experience creating process flows, data flows, sequence diagrams, system context diagrams, or other visual models that communicate business and technical solutions.

- Experience defining business rules, writing user stories, developing acceptance criteria, and managing requirements in Agile environments.

- Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, data flows, and modern cloud-based architectures.

- Ability to write and execute SQL queries to support analysis, troubleshooting, validation, and testing efforts.

- Experience performing data analysis, data mapping, and requirements traceability across multiple systems.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Proficiency with common delivery and collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience supporting digital product development and product-centric delivery models.

- Experience working in regulated industries such as energy, utilities, infrastructure, financial services, healthcare, or public sector environments.

- Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, or other enterprise business platforms.

- Experience supporting cloud modernization, application modernization, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

- Familiarity with system architecture concepts, object-oriented design principles, or software engineering practices.

- Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Scrum, Product Owner, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or related certifications.

Additional Information
We provide challenging and impactful opportunities in our client work and internal teams, while keeping individual interests in mind. We want everyone at CapTech to be able to envision a lifelong career here, which is why we offer a variety of career paths based on your skills and passions. As a CapTecher, you will experience exciting and rewarding roles that help you grow and make a difference, while having fun along the way.

At CapTech we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package including, but not limited to:

- CapTech is committed to providing a flexible work environment and helping our employees achieve a work-life balance that suits their individual needs. Employees must be available to work onsite in a client location or a CapTech office as requested. We allow CapTech employees to work remotely when compatible with CapTech and client needs.

- Competitive salary with performance-based bonus opportunities

- Three comprehensive Medical Plan options (PPO and HDHP), as well as Dental and Vision coverage

- Company paid basic Life and AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

- Matching 401(k)

- Cell Phone stipend

- Competitive Paid Time Off

- Paid Birth and Family Bonding Leave

- Adoption Assistance

- Training and Certification opportunities eligible for expense reimbursement

- Team building and social activities

- Mentor program to help you develop your career

CapTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culture of equality, inclusion and fairness — each foundational to our core values. We strive to create a diverse environment where each employee is encouraged to bring their unique ideas, backgrounds and experiences to the workplace. For more information about our diversity, Inclusion and belonging efforts, click HERE.

At this time, CapTech cannot transfer nor sponsor a work visa for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work directly for any employer in the United States without visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst (Salesforce, Vibe Coding)
jobs.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

About the Role

Cadence IT is looking for a Business Systems Analyst in San Jose, CA with Salesforce expertise and hands-on experience using Vibe-coding and Agentic AI to accelerate and scale delivery.

You will support workflow analysis across Marketing and Quote-to-Cash areas, help identify automation opportunities, and assist with optimizing workflows across Salesforce and other enterprise systems in a fast paced, global environment.

What You’ll Do

-
Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations, Customer Support to define future-state, end-to-end workflows and success metrics (cycle time, handoffs eliminated, adoption, compliance).

-
Design and deliver Salesforce solutions optimized for scalability, performance, and native platform functionality.

-
Assess upstream/downstream impacts across integrated systems, document system interactions, data dependencies, and exception paths.

-
Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria—including agent-ready rules and guardrails.

-
Provide functional leadership and clarity to development and QA teams by translating end-to-end workflow intent, system interactions, and automation requirements into clear, actionable guidance throughout design, build, and testing.

-
Drive UAT readiness, including test planning, end-to-end validation, and stakeholder coordination to ensure solutions meet business expectations.

-
Collaborate with Development, QA, InfoSec, and Enterprise Architecture to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise standards.

-
Leverage AI-assisted delivery techniques (including ‘vibe coding’/rapid prototyping) to validate concepts quickly with users and accelerate iteration.

-
Design and leverage AI agents and workflow orchestration capabilities to automate complex end-to-end business processes with built-in governance, exception handling, security/access controls, and operational oversight.

What You Bring

Required Skills

-
3-4 years of Business Systems Analyst experience supporting large-scale enterprise applications.

-
2+ years of Salesforce/application experience including Sales Cloud, Conga CPQ and Marketing apps like Marketo or HubSpot or Pardot.

-
Strong understanding of Marketing & Sales processes including Lead generation and qualification, Quote-to-Cash processes

-
Hands-on experience using rapid prototyping or AI-assisted development techniques (e.g., Vibe Coding, low code/no code, or similar approaches) to accelerate validation and delivery.

-
Ability to build consensus among cross functional stakeholders at multiple organizational levels on approach and outcomes, enabling delivery of robust, scalable technology solutions.

-
Strong understanding of Salesforce data model and security, including permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and data governance best practices.

-
Experience working in Agile / iterative delivery environments, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, incremental releases, and rapid feedback loops.

-
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Software Engineering

-
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to a variety of audiences.

-
Comfortable driving clarity and outcomes in fast-moving, ambiguous situations.

Preferred Skills

-
Salesforce certifications (Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud), demonstrating strong platform and data model fluency.

-
Experience working on CRM, CPQ, ERP, and related platforms.

-
Experience with designing and leveraging AI agents and workflow orchestration capabilities to automate business processes.

-
Experience in the high-tech or semiconductor industry, supporting complex, global and highly integrated business processes.

Why Join Cadence

At Cadence, you will play a key role in accelerating enterprise-scale digital transformation by modernizing Sales and Quote-to-Cash processes and scaling a global Salesforce ecosystem. You’ll leverage innovative AI capabilities, including Vibe Coding and AI agents—while collaborating with high-performing teams worldwide to deliver measurable business impact.

If you’re passionate about driving innovation, solving complex business challenges, and working at the intersection of business and technology, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey.

The hourly range for California is $39.71 to $73.75 per hour. You may also be eligible to receive incentive compensation: bonus, equity, and benefits. Please note that the hourly range is a guideline and compensation may vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies and work location. jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Overview

CVS Health is seeking a Data Scientist to join its enterprise clinical intelligence platform team. AI is unlocking new possibilities in healthcare at an unprecedented pace, and that progress comes with a responsibility to build capabilities that are clinically rigorous, ethically grounded, and worthy of the trust patients and providers place in them.

This role will analyze clinical data and develop AI and machine learning solutions that generate evidence-backed insights for use cases across CVS Health. The Data Scientist will work closely with experienced data scientists, engineers, product managers, and clinical partners to build, evaluate, and improve solutions used in production.

What You’ll Do

-
Develop subject matter expertise in clinical data and its application to healthcare problems.

-
Explore, analyze, and summarize large structured and unstructured datasets to inform product and modeling decisions.

-
Develop, validate, and improve statistical, machine learning, and generative AI solutions under the guidance of senior team members.

-
Apply large language models and natural language processing techniques to extract, structure, and summarize information from clinical documents.

-
Evaluate model performance and help monitor solution quality, reliability, and effectiveness in production.

-
Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, and clinical partners to implement AI solutions.

-
Create dashboards, visualizations, and technical documentation that clearly communicate findings and solution performance.

-
Apply CVS Health policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible AI standards throughout the model development lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

-
1+ years of experience in data science, analytics, machine learning, or a related field.

-
Experience using Python and SQL to analyze data and solve analytical problems.

-
Experience applying statistics, machine learning, natural language processing, or generative AI techniques.

-
Experience communicating analytical findings through documentation, visualizations, or presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

-
Experience working with healthcare, clinical, claims, or other sensitive data.

-
Experience analyzing unstructured text with large language models.

-
Experience with cloud-based data and AI platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.

-
Familiarity with tools such as BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataproc, or Cloud Composer.

-
Ability to collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team and work through technical problems with guidance.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Physics, Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Clinical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Health Informatics, or a related discipline.

Master’s degree preferred.

Anticipated Weekly Hours
40

Time Type
Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$79,310.00 - $158,620.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Summary:

The Business Systems Analyst is a critical role in the delivery of products for Lifetime Healthcare Companies. This position collaborates with stakeholders throughout the organization to understand business objectives and defines IT system requirements and specifications for the implementation of IT system solutions. The Business Systems Analyst will serve as the primary interface between the business and IT teams to gather, document and analyze all level of requirements with the emphasis on delivering functional and non-functional requirements to solution architects and IT teams. Business Systems Analyst, in collaboration, with their stakeholders sets scope for work items.

Essential Accountabilities:

All Levels:

- Collaborates with all stakeholders to elicit, analyze, specify, and gather business, stakeholder, and solution requirements. This will include assisting and/or contributing to the creation of documented requirements leveraging the organization’s requirements methodology.

- Creates functional and non-functional requirements based on stakeholder requirements including business, IT and recommended best practices.

- Develops an understanding & expertise of the business, application, and data domain they are assigned.

- Conducts or participates in peer reviews of business, stakeholder, and solution requirements.

- Defines scope as they flow from business stakeholders to development teams in an iterative release process.

- Consistently demonstrates high standards of integrity by supporting the Lifetime Healthcare Companies’ mission and values, adhering to the Corporate Code of Conduct, and leading to the Lifetime Way values and beliefs.

- Maintains high regard for group, member, and agency privacy in accordance with the corporate privacy policies and procedures.

- Regular and reliable attendance is expected and required.

- Performs other functions as assigned by management.

Level II (in addition to Level I essential accountabilities

- Conducts research and systems analysis required to deliver IT systems related requirements including data and cloud technologies.

- Proactively manages changes in scope, identifies potential risks, and works with management and development team(s) to create recovery plans.

- Works with Business Stakeholders to identify the minimal viable product (MVP).

Level III (in addition to Level II essential responsibilities/accountabilities)

- Assesses requirements to provide recommendations for improvements.

- Mentors and trains other Business Systems Analyst I/II’s in various practices and other products.

- Considered a subject matter expert in their assigned business area and data domain.

- Leads complex projects and work efforts to obtain requirements to ensure solutions are appropriate and directly support the business, enterprise, and data strategies.

Level IV (in addition to Level III essential responsibilities/accountabilities)

- Leads peer reviews with other Business Systems Analyst to assess quality and completeness of requirements, providing feedback and guidance.

- Works collaboratively across the organization to identify potential areas for process or implementation improvements, addressing any impediments to the product or project.

- Directly negotiates with and functions as a liaison with other IT resources, business stakeholders and external vendors/partners. Often fills the role of project spokesperson. Writes and speaks fluently on all aspects of work.

- Considered a subject matter expert across many business areas and data domains.

- Demonstrated leadership in creating requirements while working collaboratively with multiple levels of management and architects from across the enterprise.

Minimum Qualifications:

NOTE: We include multiple levels of classification differentiated by demonstrated knowledge, skills, and the ability to manage increasingly independent and/or complex assignments, broader responsibility, additional decision making, and in some cases, becoming a resource to others. In addition to using this differentiated approach to place new hires, it also provides guideposts for employee development and promotional opportunities.

Level I:

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) years of relevant work experience is required.

- Basic understanding of various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated basic understanding of data and systems analytics skills.

- Basic experience writing requirements or user stories that are clear, concise, and well organized.

- Basic understanding of waterfall or agile scrum methodologies and familiarity with Automated Testing preferred.

- Demonstrated Intermediate communication skills: oral presentations, writing, facilitation, elicitation, negotiation, active listening, influence positive team dynamics.

- Advanced MS Office knowledge.

- Ability to prioritize work components and define objectives effectively without assistance and with minimal supervision.

- Demonstrated critical thinking and analytical approach to providing solutions at an intermediate level.

- Ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Level II: All qualifications of Level I, as well as the following

- Three (3) years of relevant work experience.

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) additional years of relevant work experience is required.

- Basic SQL skills with the ability to effectively execute SQL queries, interpret data and read through procedural code.

- Intermediate knowledge of business, technology, and data domain they are assigned.

- Intermediate data and systems analytics skills.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience with various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience in the Health Plan or healthcare industry especially as it relates to overall health insurance value chain and processes preferred.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience writing requirements or user stories that are clear, concise, and well organized.

- Demonstrated intermediate experience with waterfall or agile scrum methodologies and familiarity with Automated Testing preferred.

Level III: All qualifications of Level II, as well as the following:

- Five (5) years of relevant work experience.

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) additional years of relevant work experience is required.

- Scrum Master, Product Owner, Business Analyst or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certifications preferred.

- Advanced understanding of application and data systems and how they are used in the organization.

- Advanced understanding of common architecture and development best practices.

- Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to effectively execute SQL queries, interpret data and read through procedural code.

- Demonstrated advanced writing requirements in various formats, including user stories and Gherkin preferred.

- Demonstrated advanced ability to facilitate and lead Joint Application Requirements (JAR) or similar sessions.

- Demonstrated advanced experience with various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated advanced experience within an Agile and waterfall environment, Scrum preferred.

Level IV: All qualifications of Level III, as well as the following:

- Seven (7) years of relevant work experience.

- Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. In lieu of a degree, three (3) additional years of relevant work experience is required.

- Advanced SQL skills with the ability to effectively execute SQL queries, interpret data and read through procedural code.

- Expert experience writing requirements.

- Demonstrated advanced data and systems analytics skills.

- Demonstrated expert experience with various business flow diagraming tools like data flow, UML, or capabilities matrices.

- Demonstrated expert knowledge of application systems and data systems and how they are used in the health care industry.

- Demonstrated expert understanding of common architecture and development best practices.

Physical Requirements:

- Ability to complete work in a traditional office environment under fluorescent lighting.

- Ability to orally communicate.

- Must be able to travel across the enterprise.

- Ability to work in a home office for continuous periods of time for business continuity

- CAE Defense & Security Mission: CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.

Job Title: Information Environment Operations Analyst

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

Anticipated Posting End: There is not an anticipated end date for this posting since applications are needed on an ongoing basis.

The Opportunity:

Join a team dedicated to advancing national security through innovative irregular warfare, intelligence, and operations expertise. CACI is seeking an Information Environment Operations (IEO) Analyst to help synchronize intelligence, targeting, and operational planning in support of Operations in the Information Environment (OIE), Information Operations (IO), cyberspace operations, and other non-kinetic activities that shape the modern battlespace.

In this role, you will integrate all-source intelligence with operational planning to identify opportunities for information advantage, develop actionable targeting recommendations, and support the planning and execution of influence activities, cyberspace operations, and information-related capabilities. Working alongside intelligence professionals, operational planners, and cross-functional mission partners, you will transform complex intelligence into operationally relevant assessments that enable commanders to understand adversary behavior, influence target audiences, and achieve campaign objectives across the information environment.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on high-priority national security missions, collaborate with experienced operational and intelligence professionals, and help shape the integration of information-related capabilities into strategic and operational planning. Candidates who thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy solving complex analytical challenges, and are passionate about integrating intelligence with operations to create decision advantage will find meaningful opportunities for professional growth and mission impact at CACI.

Opportunities available at the Senior and Journeyman levels.

Responsibilities:

- Integrate intelligence analysis, targeting, and operational planning activities to support Operations in the Information Environment (OIE), Information Operations (IO), cyberspace operations, and other non-kinetic effects.

- Develop intelligence assessments, target audience analyses (TAA), network analyses, intelligence estimates, and targeting products that support operational planning and execution.

- Synchronize with intelligence analysts and planners to integrate all-source intelligence, finish intelligence, collection reporting, and operational assessments into targeting and operational decision-making.

- Coordinate, consolidate, track, and manage intelligence requirements supporting information-related capabilities (IRCs), non-kinetic operations, and operational objectives.

- Support the planning, coordination, integration, and synchronization of non-lethal effects, cyberspace operations, influence activities, and other information-related capabilities.

- Analyze adversary capabilities, vulnerabilities, leadership, networks, intentions, and operational behaviors to identify opportunities for operational advantage and target development.

- Integrate intelligence reporting, assessments, and operational feedback into measures of effectiveness (MOE), measures of performance (MOP), and operational assessment activities.

- Support targeting working groups, operational planning teams, and cross-functional staffs by providing intelligence-driven recommendations and decision-support products.

- Facilitate intelligence deconfliction and synchronization across operational, intelligence, cyber, and information environment stakeholders to maximize effectiveness and minimize operational risk.

- Produce intelligence products, briefings, and assessments that support campaign planning, operational design, targeting, and the integration of information-related capabilities across the operational environment.

Qualifications:

Required:

Journeyman Qualifications

- 3-10 years of experience supporting intelligence operations, targeting, Information Operations (IO), Operations in the Information Environment (OIE), cyberspace operations, or military planning activities.

- TS/SCI clearance required

- Demonstrated experience integrating intelligence analysis, targeting methodologies, and operational planning processes to support mission objectives.

- Experience developing intelligence assessments, target audience analyses, network analyses, intelligence estimates, and operational decision-support products.

- Proven ability to integrate all-source intelligence into operational planning, targeting, assessment, and information-related capability activities.

- Experience supporting joint, inner-agency, multinational, or Combatant Command operations and coordinating across multiple functional staffs and mission partners.

Senior Qualifications:

- 10+ years of experience supporting intelligence operations, targeting, Information Operations (IO), Operations in the Information Environment (OIE), cyberspace operations, or military planning activities.

- TS/SCI clearance required

- Demonstrated experience integrating intelligence analysis, targeting methodologies, and operational planning processes to support mission objectives.

- Experience developing intelligence assessments, target audience analyses, network analyses, intelligence estimates, and operational decision-support products.

- Proven ability to integrate all-source intelligence into operational planning, targeting, assessment, and information-related capability activities.

- Experience supporting joint, inner-agency, multinational, or Combatant Command operations and coordinating across multiple functional staffs and mission partners.

Desired Qualifications:

- Experience supporting targeting processes, cyberspace operations, influence activities, operational assessment, or strategic competition initiatives.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

In this role, you will apply data science, statistical analysis, automation, and emerging technologies to complex operational challenges within the information environment and irregular warfare (IW) mission space. The Opportunity:

We are seeking a flexible, proactive, and detail-oriented engineer with a passion for analytics and a commitment to delivering high-quality products under government direction.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to technical analysis in support of government-led assessments of Integrated Combat Systems and Weapons Systems across warfare areas including Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), Surface Warfare (SUW), Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD), Ground Based Air Defense (GBAD), Strike, Area Defense, Self-Defense and Point Defense areas. You will work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where priorities may shift and processes are still evolving—requiring adaptability, clear documentation, and a strong sense of initiative.

The ideal candidate has a foundation in an engineering field with MATLAB or Python experience, strong analytical skills, and is eager to learn and tackle complex problems.

• Continuous Learning: Proactively expand your understanding of Defense and Integrated Combat System, analytical tools, and related technologies.

The Integration Technology Business Analyst III elicits and creates requirements for our customer digital integration, learning the customer's business processes, analyzing data, and maintaining a thorough understanding of our internal practices. You will consult on digital communication technology methodologies and solutions that span multiple technical domains while contributing to team process development and continuous improvement efforts. This role partners with, educates, and influences internal and external partners, building and maintaining effective working relationships.

This role can be based only in MN, IL, or Kansas City

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Leads and manages multiple digital integration projects with moderate to high complexity, defining new patterns, leveraging existing patterns, and addressing gaps in the platform, partners with business and technology teams on more complex customers

- Facilitates effective meetings, keeps internal and external stakeholders informed, sets and maintains project scope and timelines, mitigates risks, partners with others to resolve technical issues, provides guidance and consultation to the project team, ensures deliverables are met by managing day-to-day work, and escalates issues appropriately

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Marketplace Incentives
jobs.description:
ABOUT BUILD AI

Build AI is the data hyperscaler for Physical AI. We're vertically integrated across hardware, manufacturing, logistics, collection, and model training to scale the physical labor dataset orders of magnitude faster than anyone in the world.


JOB SUMMARY

This role exists to hillclimb the dataset objective: the ideal dataset, the objective function, the taxonomy, and the value of incremental data. You take that objective and maximize it: incentives, marketplace design, and collection behavior so the next hour we collect actually moves the score.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Treat the Dataset & Quality objective / value function as the thing you optimize — not raw hours, not vanity volume

 - Design marketplace mechanics (task mix, targeting, bonuses, payouts, eligibility) so collectors produce high-value data

 - Run experiments: treatment assignment, holdouts, pay and bonus tests; keep the ones that hillclimb the objective and kill the rest

 - Measure whether incremental collection is improving the dataset under the value function, and report that in language ops can act on

 - Work with software to ship incentive and payout changes into the collection product (not a spreadsheet that never lands)

 - Watch for Goodhart: collectors optimizing the proxy instead of the objective, and close those holes


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE (MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS)

 - Quantitative: you can take someone else’s objective function and optimize against it

 - Comfortable designing and reading experiments (assignment, holdouts, power, leakage)

 - Comfortable with messy field / collection data

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Data at Brex

The Data organization develops infrastructure, statistical models, and products using financial data. Our Scientists and Engineers work together to make data —and insights derived from data — a core asset across the company. Our work is ingrained in Brex’s decision-making process, in the efficiency of our operations, in our risk management policies, and in the second-to-none experience we provide our consumers.

What You’ll Do

Our Data Scientists are responsible for the entire model development lifecycle, from conception with stakeholders, through model development and productionization, to following through to see that the desired business impact is achieved — including circling back with stakeholders to make product or strategic decisions.

Responsibilities

- Drive Data & AI solutions from inception to deployment to efficiently manage risk and/or improve customer experience.

- Be responsible for the full machine learning lifecycle — problem identification, model design, training, productionization, and monitoring.

- Partner with cross-functional teams (Ops, Engineering, Product, Fraud, Compliance, and Credit).

Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in Data Science/ML roles, or 2+ years with a PhD in a quantitative field

- Ability to apply statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing and A/B testing, and to approach problems with a statistical mindset

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including experience with API development and integrating ML systems into production services

- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with various stakeholders, both technical and non-technical

Nice to Have

- Experience working with real-time models

- Experience in the fintech industry

jobs.description:
Operations Analyst
The Opportunity:

As an operations analyst, you’re passionate about exploring the root cause of an issue and then analyzing, reporting, and developing recommendations for a creative solution. The Operations Analyst supports mission effectiveness by analyzing operational feedback and user needs, identifying capability gaps, and shaping clear, actionable requirements. The role works closely with operators, subject matter experts (SMEs), and technical or acquisition teams to refine tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), validate requirements, and support solution development.

This role is responsible for analyzing operational feedback, lessons learned, and user needs to identify capability gaps, emerging requirements, and opportunities to enhance mission effectiveness. The position develops, evaluates, and refines TTPs in collaboration with operational users, SMEs, and partner organizations. It translates operational challenges into clear, traceable capability requirements and supports the creation of associated documentation, priorities, and recommended acquisition approaches. The role also coordinates across operational, technical, requirements, resourcing, and acquisition stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are feasible, aligned with organizational objectives, and responsive to end‑user needs. Additional responsibilities include supporting planning, experimentation, assessments, training events, and other activities that inform capability development and fielding decisions, as well as preparing briefings, reports, decision papers, and other products for leadership review.

What You’ll Work On:

- Analyze operational insights, lessons learned, and user feedback to identify capability gaps and areas for mission improvement.

- Translate operational challenges into clear, traceable capability requirements and supporting documentation.

- Develop, evaluate, and refine TTPs in collaboration with operational users, SMEs, and partner organizations.

- Coordinate across operational, technical, requirements, resourcing, and acquisition stakeholders to ensure solutions are feasible and aligned with mission objectives.

- Support planning and execution of experiments, exercises, assessments, demonstrations, and training events.

- Prepare leadership‑ready briefings, reports, decision papers, and other staff products.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

- Experience analyzing operational data, mission feedback, or lessons learned

- Ability to develop or refine requirements, concepts, or TTPs

- Ability to produce clear, concise documentation for senior leadership

- Ability to collaborate effectively across various operational, technical, and acquisition communities

- Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

- Bachelor’s degree

Experienced Business Operations Specialist

Company:
The Boeing Company

The Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) Business Operations team is hiring an Experienced Business Operations Specialist to join our team in Berkeley, MO. This position will support the Test Program Managers and Cost Account Managers (CAMs) in executing program management best practices and functional performance and reporting. The successful candidate will demonstrate knowledge and application of program management best practices and program planning and control.

We are seeking candidates who are detail-oriented, possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, and demonstrate effective problem-solving abilities. The ideal candidate will be able to manage tasks with accuracy and collaborate clearly and professionally with team members at all levels.
