- Assists in the integration and analysis of programs, plans, strategies and processes to meet business goals for authorization, including supporting management of cost, schedule, and technical elements of the work

- Maintain compliance with earned value management system work scope

- Supports timely coordination and clarifies the analysis with business partners to validate results and determine scope to meet long range business goals and develop business case

- Coordinates the commitments with internal and external organizations to fulfill strategies

- Identifies risk and opportunity potential, develops mitigation planning and refines the business case

- Provides implementation direction for work authorization

- Collects, organizes and provides data according to established processes within the management system to maintain status of programs, customer and supplier commitments and compliance

- Ensures follow up action for issue resolution

- Develops solutions to complex problems that require ingenuity and innovation

- Ensures solutions are consistent with organization objectives

- Performs work with minimal direction and exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignment

- 3+ years of experience developing/maintaining resource management, earned value management, risk management, and project management

- 3+ years of experience leading or managing projects that involved cross-functional or cross-business unit teams

- 3+ years of experience working with organizational leaders to develop & implement plans & objectives to meet requirements and create reports for management reviews & track performance to plan

- 3+ years of experience gathering and analyzing data

- 3+ years of experience developing and managing strong relationships with partners (internal and external), government and community customers, and representatives

- 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

jobs.description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space communications and requires dedicated commitment and detailed attention to safe, repeatable manufacturing. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will support the management operating system driving sustainable improvement in the production of New Glenn. This is a hands-on position requiring effective communication, sound judgment, and working knowledge of manufacturing production systems.

We are seeking a proactive, collaborative individual with strong analytical ability. In this role, you will work with the manufacturing and senior leadership teams to help identify, develop, and implement process improvements.

Responsibilities

- Build and maintain business dashboards and KPIs that support the New Glenn management operating system.

- Support and execute the rhythm of the business, including recurring performance reviews, data preparation, and action tracking.

- Document and help standardize business processes with cross-functional teams.

- Help the management operating system identify performance risks early. Analyze data, recommend solutions, and follow through on implementation.

- Measure, analyze, and report on New Glenn manufacturing team performance, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Contribute to company-wide process definition and improvement across manufacturing processes, business processes, production planning, lessons learned, and other standards as needed.

Qualifications

- BS degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience in manufacturing, such as satellites, spacecraft, electronics, semiconductors, launch vehicles, aircraft, automotive, medical devices, or power generation systems.

- Experience with data analytics tools such as SQL, Python, or Tableau.

- Exposure to visual factory or production operating systems, preferably in a high-mix, low-volume or early-stage production environment.

- Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and statistical process control, with experience supporting process definition, measurement, and improvement.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills with a focus on teamwork and customer satisfaction.

- Familiarity with production scheduling MRP/ERP systems.

- Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current green card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired

- Master's degree or MBA is a plus.

- Experience implementing visual factory or production operating systems in a high-mix, low-volume or early-stage environment.

- Experience supporting the transition of manufacturing capabilities from development/prototype to full-rate production, particularly in satellite, RF, optical, or electronics manufacturing.

- Knowledge of fabrication and integration processes, systems engineering best practices, test, quality, and configuration management relevant to satellite or communications hardware.

- Exposure to facility-level capital improvements in a greenfield or rapidly scaling manufacturing program.

Revenue Operations Analyst - 12 Month Maternity Cover

jobs.title: Index Projections & Analytics, Associate
jobs.description:
About this role

BlackRock is one of the world’s preeminent asset management firms and a premier provider of global investment management, risk management and advisory services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors around the world. BlackRock offers a range of solutions — from meticulous fundamental and quantitative active management approaches aimed at maximizing outperformance to highly efficient indexing strategies designed to gain broad exposure to the world’s capital markets. Our clients can access our investment solutions through a variety of product structures, including individual and institutional separate accounts, mutual funds and other pooled investment vehicles, and the industry-leading iShares® ETFs.

Your team

BlackRock Global Markets and Index Investments (BGM) brings together BlackRock’s Index Investments, Cash Management, Securities Lending and Financing, Global Trading, ETF Markets, Liquid Origination, and Markets Relationship Management businesses. Together, these businesses serve clients at scale by delivering investment performance and risk management, leveraging technology to enhance quality, scale and risk control, and helping shape more accessible, resilient and transparent markets.

Within BGM, the Index Projection & Analytics team is a specialist group of index methodology experts focused on improving index investment outcomes through high-integrity data, advanced analytics and advocacy for stronger index standards. The team delivers actionable insights and challenges the status quo to improve client outcomes in an increasingly technology- and artificial intelligence-enabled investment environment.

Your role and impact

As an Index Researcher, Associate, you will join an established global team supporting one of the world’s largest index investment businesses. You will work at the intersection of index research, portfolio management, quantitative analysis and data science to help solve complex investment problems and develop next-generation analytical capabilities.

The role provides an opportunity to influence investment decision-making through forward-looking index projections, research into corporate actions and index rebalances, benchmark analysis and advanced analytics. You will collaborate with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, strategy and product teams, and research, data and technology partners to strengthen BlackRock’s index investment process and deliver insights for institutional and retail clients.

Your responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

- Play an integral role in producing high-quality, forward-looking index projections that drive investment decision-making.

- Research expected index changes, upcoming corporate actions and major index rebalances, and conduct statistical analysis to help build and drive our analytical offering.

- Play an integral part in defining and building out a best-in-class Index Research Analytics platform for BlackRock.

- Collaborate with Quantitative Research to apply modeling techniques to address index investing challenges and opportunities.

- Be an active voice in our index portfolio management process.

- Partner with and support index strategy and product teams through benchmark analysis.

- Apply advanced data science techniques to complex financial data to generate commercial value for our business partners.

- Provide data-driven insights and thought leadership for internal and external client use.

- Build strong relationships with index partners across research, data and technology.

- Design and implement risk controls to detect anomalies in index data and methodologies.

Your experience

- 2–5 years of relevant experience.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

- Experience with data science, data management and data visualization tools and techniques is a strong plus.

- Ability to demonstrate a blend of technical and analytical skills, with equal emphasis on communication and presentation.

- Passion for investing and a continuous desire to learn about financial markets and fund management.

- Clear, logical thinker with strong quantitative problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to develop effective cross-functional relationships at all levels.

- Understanding of index construction and methodology concepts.

- Strong understanding of cross-asset index investing.

- Ability to multitask and prioritize assignments while producing high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent verbal and written communication, teamwork and relationship-building skills.

- Programming skills in Python and SQL.

- Experience with Aladdin tools and knowledge of Aladdin data sources are a plus.

- Knowledge of Bloomberg and FactSet is an advantage.

- Strong desire to solve complex financial problems by leveraging artificial intelligence.


For Atlanta, GA Only the salary range for this position is USD$105,000.00 - USD$140,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance.


Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Forward Deployed Business Analyst – BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO)

The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology.

Your role and impact

The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm.

This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together.

Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a strategic builder to build a terawatt hour sales engine™. To date, our sales team has moved fast to define the market, but to handle ambitious growth goals, we need a robust operational engine supported by reliable analytics streamlined to scale efficiently. We are looking for someone to parse through a sea of data, build the architecture for Base's revenue and efficiency metrics, then make decisions and take the necessary actions to reach our goals.

In this role, you’ll own the underlying data and systems the sales team relies on. You will identify bottlenecks in the funnel, work across the growth team to diagnose root causes, and work hand-in-hand with other operators to resolve them.. You will bridge the gap between data and action, quickly identifying any gaps or holes preventing us from Base Pace scale, and fixing them.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Assist with forecast precision and team reporting & analytics to develop new strategies and drive improvements throughout the funnel.

 - Create alerting systems to quickly notify the team when data changes (positively or negatively) and parse through data to identify root causes. Then work with stakeholders to resolve or improve as needed.

 - Lead the operational execution of cross-functional initiatives, translating complex data into clear actions for Sales, Growth, and Engineering.

 - Build automated workflows to remove friction and increase team efficiency, while helping optimize the sales tech stack.

 - Willingness to "get hands dirty" with the tactical work needed to keep the sales team running smoothly.

 - Proactiveness and drive to identify gaps in data or reporting, build those reports, and own them as the single point of contact.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Sales team acts as the critical bridge between a homeowner’s initial interest and a ready-to-install battery system. We are the primary educators in the market, responsible for building deep trust with homeowners who are engaging with distributed energy for the first time. We solve the problem of complexity, taking a sophisticated engineering solution and translating it into a clear, no-brainer value proposition for the consumer. This team carries the volume goals for the company, and our ability to operate efficiently directly dictates how fast we can modernize the American grid.

This is the single finance partner for our go to market leaders. You own the economics of acquisition end-to-end in partnership with our GTM operators — pricing, CAC by channel, member pipeline efficiency, market sizing, and the penetration curve as Base expands from Texas into the next set of states. Pricing and CAC are two of the most consequential variables in Base's long-range P&L, and this seat owns the forecast and analytics of each.  - Partner with growth, marketing, sales, and partnerships leadership on pricing and channel investment — translate proposals into defensible cases, and challenge an allocation without becoming the no-person.

 - Build out the financial framework for utility partnerships and large GTM bets — structure the deal economics, set the bar, and track whether reality matches the case after it closes.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Job Description

Purpose of the role

To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.

Accountabilities

- Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.

- Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.

- Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.

- Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.

- Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.

- Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.

- Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

Analyst Expectations

- Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.

- Partner with other functions and business areas.

- Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.

- Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.

- Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.

- Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.

- Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.

- Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.

- Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

- Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.

- Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.

- Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.

- Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Tax Operations Analyst. At Barclays, our vision is clear – to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. You will support the Tax Documentation team in maintaining consistent, well-controlled practices across the investment bank. In this position, you will handle the collection, validation, and maintenance of client tax documentation for your assigned portfolio of accounts, ensuring compliance with Tax Operations policies and IRS regulatory requirements. You will be responsible for obtaining the appropriate tax forms for Barclays investment bank clients and validating all documentation in accordance with IRS guidelines.

To be successful as a Tax Operations Analyst, you should have experience with:

-
Understanding and validating US W 8 and W 9 tax documentation in accordance with IRS regulations

-
Supporting onboarding and remediation activities driven by regulatory changes

-
Applying a basic understanding of financial products within the investment banking industry

-
Communicating effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including clients, sales teams, and onboarding partners

-
Using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook in a collaborative, team focused environment

Some other highly valued skills may include:

-
Experience in IRS tax form validation, reporting, and withholding, with awareness of tax technical requirements and industry practices

-
Ample evaluative thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to navigate detailed tax and documentation requirements

-
A dynamic approach, including the ability to challenge existing processes, recommend enhancements, and drive continuous improvements

-
Understanding of risks associated with operational tax processes, and the ability to clearly articulate these risks to management

-
Technical aptitude and willingness to learn evolving tax and regulatory obligations

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in Whippany, NJ.

Minimum Salary: $ 64,000

Maximum Salary: $ 87,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

The Business Analyst will function as a key partner between business and technology, translating evolving business needs into clear outcomes and actionable direction for delivery teams. Over time, this individual is expected to develop deep domain expertise and serve as a trusted business proxy, helping teams make informed decisions and maintain momentum even when direct business input is limited. jobs.title: Data Scientist – AV Metrics & Evaluation Analytics
jobs.description:
About the team

Our team is dedicated to advancing the future of autonomous driving technology by developing the metrics and evaluation frameworks that ensure the safety, performance, and readiness of self-driving systems. We work closely with engineering teams to analyze real-world and simulated driving data, enabling data-driven decisions that accelerate the commercialization of autonomous vehicles. Our work directly impacts critical questions such as: ‘How well does the vehicle handle complex intersections? Does it provide a passenger-safe experience during maneuvers? How do we statistically validate readiness for urban deployment?’

About the role

We are seeking a skilled Data Scientist to join our team and play a pivotal role in defining and evaluating the performance of autonomous vehicle systems. You will design and implement quantitative metrics to assess driving behavior, safety compliance, and passenger comfort. Your work will involve analyzing large datasets, applying statistical methods, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure our self-driving systems meet the highest standards of safety and reliability. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of autonomous driving technology.

What you'll do

- Analyze data from real-world and simulated autonomous vehicle experiments to evaluate system performance.

- Develop and refine quantitative metrics (both rule-based and ML-driven) to assess driving behavior, safety, and passenger comfort.

- Apply statistical inference and hypothesis testing to validate the sensitivity and reliability of metrics.

- Collaborate with autonomy software, simulation, and safety teams to prioritize improvements based on data-driven insights.

- Build scalable data pipelines to automate metric computation and reporting.

- Review driving logs and participate in test rides to ground analyses in real-world performance.

What you'll need

- 2+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or metrics development.

- Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis.

- Strong background in statistical methods (e.g., A/B testing, confidence intervals, regression).

- Experience designing metrics to evaluate complex systems (e.g., robotics, autonomous systems, or large-scale software).

- Ability to communicate technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to have

- Experience with machine learning (e.g., model evaluation, feature engineering).

- Familiarity with big data tools (Spark, Hadoop, MapReduce).

- Knowledge of traffic regulations or automotive safety standards (e.g., NHTSA).

AtriCure’s Isolator® Synergy™ Ablation System is the first medical device to receive FDA approval for the treatment of persistent Afib. AtriCure’s AtriClip® Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion System products are the most widely sold LAA management devices worldwide. AtriCure’s Hybrid AF™ Therapy is a minimally invasive procedure that provides a lasting solution for long-standing persistent Afib patients. - Collaborate with Sales and Corporate Accounts teams to resolve contract discrepancies and ensure timely execution.

- Identify opportunities to streamline contract operations and improve process efficiency.

- Calculate rebate accruals and GPO administrative fee payments, and other operational checks as needed based on current rebate strategy.

- Ability to make decisions and use good judgment

- Ability to prioritize various duties and multitask as required

- Ability to successfully work with others

- Proficiency in Excel and ERP systems and strong attention to detail for data accuracy.

- Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

jobs.description:

If you are driven to do more and love the challenge of pursuing more, Athene is your kind of company. Purpose & Impact:
Help shape Athene’s founding engineering team in Austin and the technology platform that transforms how annuity and retirement products are distributed and managed. As Product Analyst, you will connect strategy with engineering execution: evaluate partner platforms and integration options, analyze data and system capabilities, translate approved priorities into well-defined requirements, and equip Athene and Apollo leadership with technically grounded recommendations.

Reporting to the SVP, Technology, you will work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Distribution, Actuarial and partner organizations to answer: What should we build, how should it fit together, and why now? This is an opportunity to influence a new platform with executive sponsorship, combining Athene’s scale and Apollo partnership with a culture of innovation, ownership and our BEAM values.

Key Deliverables:

- Evaluate platforms, partners and integration options. Assess partner APIs, distribution platforms, data providers and technology vendors against functional, technical and commercial criteria. Maintain capability comparisons, identify integration gaps and recommend build, buy or partner paths with clear evidence and assumptions.

- Own the product roadmap and backlog. Translate strategic priorities into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Partner with the engineering lead to prioritize delivery, resolve technical and business trade-offs, and keep development aligned with platform objectives.

- Lead technical discovery. Facilitate discovery with business, engineering and partner teams. Map current-state systems, data flows and transaction paths; define target-state workflows; document decisions and coordinate dependencies with West Des Moines teams and external partners.

- Build the data and measurement foundation. Assess whether available data, data models and partner capabilities support intended products and transactions. Define platform metrics and instrumentation that show delivery progress, adoption and business impact.

- Equip leaders to make informed decisions. Size opportunities, develop business cases and create executive presentations and decision memos that clearly explain options, trade-offs, risks and expected outcomes, grounded in technical reality.

- Use AI to improve product and analytical work. Apply AI tools to research, analysis, prototyping and drafting, validating sources, calculations and conclusions. Share effective workflows that improve speed and quality while protecting confidential information.

- 3+ years of technical product analysis, product management, systems analysis or relevant professional experience in a software or financial technology environment, preferred.

- Working fluency with APIs, data models, integration patterns and modern platform architecture, with the ability to read technical documentation, participate credibly in design discussions and evaluate partner systems.

jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

USG Capture Operations Analyst

The Capture Operations Analyst is the backbone of Astranis’s US Government capture operations, working with both the business development team and capture team to ensure the smooth execution of pipeline management, marketing initiatives, and proposal activities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, a strong communicator, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. The analyst will be instrumental in maintaining the integrity of Astranis’s government opportunity pipeline, monitoring federal procurement portals for new business, and providing essential administrative and logistical support to drive our government growth strategy forward. In addition, the analyst will aid the capture team in developing proposal responses, briefing and marketing materials, and trade show organization and coordination.

Role

- Pipeline & CRM Data Management: Maintain and update the Astranis’s Business Development pipeline and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. Ensure all opportunity data, contact information, and review statuses are accurate and current.

- Solicitation Monitoring & Research: Actively monitor federal procurement portals (e.g., SAM.gov, NASA Spires, etc.) for new solicitations, Requests for Information (RFIs), Sources Sought notices, and industry days relevant to Astranis’s capabilities, disseminating findings to the appropriate Capture and BD leads.

- Marketing & Communications Support: Assist in drafting, editing, and producing customer responses and marketing materials tailored for US Government audiences. This includes capability statements, past performance summaries, product summaries, and presentations for customer meetings.

- Proposal Management Assistance: Support the Proposal Manager and Capture Manager during the proposal lifecycle. Assist with proposal management, compliance matrix development, data call coordination, section authoring, and logistical support for color team reviews.

- Logistical & Event Coordination: Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items for capture strategy sessions and executive gate reviews. Manage logistics and scheduling for industry events, trade shows, and customer site visits.

Requirements

- B.S. or B.A. in business administration, operations, or engineering

- 2-5 years of experience in business development support, technical sales, operations, or other administrative role, preferably within the government contracting sector.

- Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to draft professional marketing copy and correspond effectively with internal stakeholders.

- Hyper-focused attention to detail, particularly regarding data entry, document formatting, and compliance checking.

- Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to 25% of time

- US Citizen or Green Card Holder

Bonus

- B.S. in engineering or B.A. in business

- Familiarity with standard federal government procurement processes, terminology (e.g., RFI, RFP, RPP), and portals (SAM.gov)

- Federal-level capture/proposal execution and/or government acquisition experience

- Previous exposure to standard proposal development processes (e.g., Shipley Associates methodology)

- Working knowledge and interest in satellites, US government space missions (both civil and national security space)

- Eligible to obtain a TS/SCI Security Clearance

- Less than 5 years since previously active TS//SCI Security Clearance

What we offer:

jobs.title: Founding Data Scientist
jobs.description:
What We Do

Insurance is a $10T industry still running on PDFs, email threads, and manual reconciliation. Ascend is changing that. We built the first and only complete financial operations platform purpose-built for insurance — combining accounting automation, payments, and premium financing in a single vertically integrated solution. In five years, we've become the market leader: over 4,000 businesses, including more than half of the 50 largest brokers in the country, trust Ascend to bring clarity to complex accounting operations from collection to close.

How We Do It

Ascend automates the financial operations that insurers, MGAs, and agencies run every day and embeds directly into the transactions where money actually moves. Point solutions are easy to build and even easier to copy. The companies that win won't just sell tools — they'll capture value where the money actually moves. Ascend is built for exactly that moment. Our customers don't just adopt software, they unlock measurable efficiency with a proven 5-7x return on investment.

Our team is onsite in San Francisco. We bring deep expertise in insurance, fintech, and financial infrastructure to build what the industry has never had.

Why We Do It

The insurance industry intermediates trillions of dollars — and almost none of that infrastructure was built for the modern era. Legacy systems aren't just inefficient; they're a ceiling on what the industry can become.

Ascend's mission is to become the leading financial automation platform for insurance by 2030 — powering the financial operations of the entire industry and transforming the way trillions of dollars move. We're not building another point solution, we're building the financial backbone of insurance.

Your Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to own measurement across the surfaces that move our customers' money. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will settle the metric definitions that three teams currently disagree on, set the thresholds that decide when a human touches a document, and stay accountable for those thresholds after they go live. We cut a standalone data scientist role to fund this one. Building a model got cheap; being answerable when a threshold is wrong did not.

Responsibilities will include

Objective #1: In your first 30 days, you will:

- Get deep into Ascend's products, data infrastructure, and the metric definitions the three teams currently disagree on

- Build relationships with Product, Engineering, and the Head of Data to understand how measurement decisions get made today

- Audit the scores and thresholds already in production and map where instrumentation is missing

Objective #2: In your first 60 days, you will:

- Propose and settle the accuracy, success, and exception metrics for Ascend's products

- Start owning the thresholds that decide when the system acts on its own versus routing to a person

- Partner with Product and Engineering on instrumentation for at least one upcoming feature before it ships

Objective #3: In your first 90 days, and beyond, you will:

- Fully own the accuracy, success, and exception metrics across all products

- Build and ship models that change a workflow rather than describe one: confidence scoring on extracted data, ranking and matching for reconciliation, sequencing for collections and recovery

- Monitor every score in production — predicted against realized, drift, and an explicit re-fit or retire date — and design the experiments our volume can actually power, saying plainly when a surface can't support one

- Turn product usage data into roadmap input

You might be a good fit if you are/have:

- Owned product data inside a live workflow rather than reporting on one, and can name the decision your number changed

- Deployed a model into a live workflow and owned it afterward, including calibration, drift, and the call to re-fit or retire

- Comfortable explaining calibration, drift, predicted-versus-realized, and re-fit timing to a non-technical owner

- Strong in SQL and feature engineering

- Experience with payments is a plus

- Someone who thrives in the ambiguity of an early-stage startup and will say when the data is too weak to decide, then propose a next step anyway

- Experience working in our toolset: Slack, Notion, Excel, Front, and Linear

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability to quickly understand complex (and sometimes dense) subject matter, and great attention to detail

Compensation: $150,000-$200,000

Benefits

- Unlimited PTO 🌴

- Meaningful equity 🤑

- Dog friendly office 🐕

- Commuter benefits 🚌

- Free lunch in office everyday 🥡

- Health care for you and your dependents 🍎

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to equal opportunity employment and embrace diversity within our organization. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience doesn't precisely match this opportunity. We value diversity and are dedicated to equal opportunity employment.

To learn more about what we do, visit analyticpartners.com – and see why we’re recognized as a Leader in the industry by independent research firms Forrester and Gartner.
 
AP is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with the business and technology teams to bridge the gap between users and software. The Business Analyst will help support the product as well as understand, translate, and develop requirements for product enhancements. They will use tools such as JIRA to manage requests and requirements, develop delivery schedules, and communicate across broader teams.

- You’ve got positive energy and you’re passionate about working with data. You’re optimistic about the future of using data to make informed business decisions.

- You’re never tired of learning and are always looking for ways to grow personally and professionally

- You thrive in collaborative work environments . You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener - because let’s face it, you can’t have one without the other.

- You can pivot on the fly. Analytics is constantly changing, and we need to keep adapting and evolving that change too. What you worked on last month may not be what you work on today, and that excites you.

- You have a “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.

- Do you enjoy owning a problem and see it as an opportunity to innovate and challenge the status quo? We’re all about harnessing innovation and are constantly looking for ways to improve

- You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.

What you’ll be doing:
- Be a subject matter expert – develop deep knowledge of our data, platform, and dependencies on other systems; act as a trusted adviser for our project teams and customers and turn business requirements into feature specifications; support our project teams and customers in the understanding and usage of existing features

- Provide data collection, prep, and validation related support to project teams and customers

- Collaborate with project teams, customers, Product Managers, and Engineers to analyze and help resolve process and product related issues

- Conduct research and analysis to understand business, process, and product challenges; make recommendations on how to resolve issues

- Gather and analyze data to better understand needs and tracking against OKRs

- Write requirements, functional specifications, and other supporting documentation for new and updated features and functionality

- Test new and updated features and functionality. Work closely with Engineers on feature and functionality development to ensure alignment to specs.

- Work with QA Engineers to ensure successful planning of test strategy and test case execution.

What we look for in you:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM, Economics, or Statistics

- 0-2 years of work experience as a Data Analyst or in a Product support role

- Knowledge of Office 365

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- The ability to influence stakeholders and work closely with them to determine acceptable solutions.

- Excellent multitasking and time management skill to manage stakeholders and to meet tight deadlines

Our differentiator is – Our People!  We hire the brightest talent and develop them into leaders. We foster a culture of PEOPLE, PASSION and GROWTH.

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.

Financial & Data Analyst (Customer Solutions Group)

We are seeking a motivated Financial Analyst to support the Customer Solutions Group (CSG), with a primary focus on financial reporting, data analytics, and commercial finance. This role will work with finance and business stakeholders to strengthen financial discipline, improve visibility into business performance, and translate financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights.

The analyst will also play a key role in advancing AI enablement initiatives across Finance and CSG operations. This includes assisting with use-case identification, improving data readiness, supporting responsible adoption, and helping integrate approved solutions into recurring workflows. This is an excellent opportunity for a developing finance professional who combines strong financial acumen with curiosity about data, technology, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

- Financial Reporting: Prepare and maintain recurring financial reports that provide clear visibility into business performance. Support variance analysis and communicate key results, trends, and risks to finance and business stakeholders.

- Revenue Forecasting & Consolidation: Support the revenue forecasting calendar and consolidation process, partnering with internal and external stakeholders to help deliver accurate, timely, and decision-useful forecasts.

- Reporting Governance: Support the Leadership Team in managing reporting cadence, governance processes, metric definitions, and standards to promote consistent and reliable financial information.

- Data Analytics & Visualization: Analyze large and varied datasets to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities. Build and enhance dashboards, reporting views, and self-service analytics that improve decision-making across Finance and CSG operations.

- AI Enablement: Partner with Finance and CSG stakeholders to identify, prioritize, test, and scale practical AI use cases, including forecast insights, management reporting, variance analysis, workflow automation, and knowledge access.

- Data Readiness & Controls: Help improve data quality, documentation, metric consistency, and validation controls required for trusted analytics and AI-enabled solutions. Promote appropriate governance, human review, and responsible use of financial data and AI outputs.

- Process Automation & Continuous Improvement: Map recurring finance processes and identify opportunities to reduce manual work using automation, AI, and standardized reporting. Help measure adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact.

- IT & Data Interface: Work with Finance, IT, data, and technology teams to document business needs, translate them into reporting and automation requirements, and support solution testing and implementation

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field

- 2-4 years of relevant experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Accounting, business analytics, or a related area

- Strong financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Advanced Excel skills and experience creating clear, executive-ready PowerPoint materials

- Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Qlik, or similar platforms

- Experience with enterprise planning and finance systems such as SAP, Anaplan, or similar tools preferred

- Exposure to generative AI, AI-enabled analytics, workflow automation, or data modeling, is preferred but not required

- Ability to work with finance and technology partners to translate business questions into data, reporting, automation, or AI requirements

Skills & Capabilities

- Strong attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into clear insights

- Business-first mindset with an interest in connecting analytics and AI capabilities to practical Finance outcomes

- Curiosity about emerging technologies and willingness to experiment, learn, and help others adopt new ways of working

- Ability to evaluate data and AI outputs critically, validate results, and communicate assumptions and limitations

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships within Finance and across functions

- Proactive ownership, sound judgment, and commitment to continuous improvement

Why This Role

- Exposure to business and Finance leadership across CSG

- Opportunity to contribute to how data analytics, automation, and AI are applied across Finance and CSG operations

- Broad development across forecasting, reporting, commercial finance, business partnership, and digital enablement

- Opportunity for continued growth and future rotation within the Finance organization

jobs.title: Specialist IS Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category
Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Specialist IS Business Systems Analyst – Technology Computer Validation SME

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will join the Amgen North Carolina (ANC) Technology team as an individual contributor, helping to drive productivity by identifying opportunities to streamline, optimize, and automate processes where appropriate. You will support the Computer Systems Compliance team by ensuring adherence to global regulatory requirements and Amgen procedures.

Acting as a subject matter expert (SME) in computer system validation (CSV), regulatory compliance, data integrity, quality systems and inspection readiness, you will partner with the business to maintain reliable, compliant and efficient systems.

You will proactively promote a culture of quality and continuous compliance, ensuring alignment with global quality standards and sustaining a constant state of inspection readiness. This position reports directly to the ANC Technology Regulatory Compliance Lead, Senior Manager.

- Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) in computer system validation (CSV), regulatory compliance, data integrity, quality systems, and inspection readiness for the Technology organization.

- Contribute to the development and execution of strategies supporting CSV, regulatory compliance, and sustained inspection readiness.

- Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with global quality and compliance standards and practices.

- Support inspection readiness activities, including development of playbooks, SME guidance, system documentation, and readiness tracking tools.

- Provide compliance and validation oversight for digital platform implementations, ensuring appropriate planning, risk identification, and adherence to regulatory expectations.

- Support digital technology services by ensuring validation, compliance, data integrity, and system reliability requirements are met.

- Collaborate in the design and implementation of support models, including coordination with vendors and third-party providers.

- Participate in cross-functional initiatives, contributing expertise in meetings and providing updates to stakeholders as needed.

- Help deliver solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and alignment with business objectives.

- Manage multiple priorities and contribute to resolving complex compliance and validation challenges.

- Support the development and tracking of performance metrics to enable continuous improvement.

- Contribute to successful project execution and promote operational excellence.

- Stay current with industry trends, regulatory expectations, and emerging technologies to inform best practices.

A day in life:

- Partner with business teams to understand processes, identify bottlenecks, and uncover opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining compliance.

- Collaborate with system owners and business stakeholders to evaluate and recommend quality-compliant system solutions and computer validation strategies.

- Contribute to the Computerized Systems Lifecycle, including gathering requirements, supporting process and system analysis, and helping define integration and design approaches.

- Participate in cross-functional meetings and working sessions to support system optimization and implementation of automated, compliant solutions.

- Champion data integrity by ensuring computerized systems meet compliance standards and support overall quality objectives.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The technology professional we seek is a team player with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems or Engineering experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems or Engineering experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems or Engineering experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 10 years Information Systems or Engineering experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- Industry experience preferred: Prior experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related regulated industries is strongly preferred.

- Depth knowledge and hand on experience in computer validation, regulatory compliance, inspection readiness.

- Drive problem solving and innovation: Apply critical thinking and best practices to proactively resolve complex issues and design effective, scalable solutions.

- Communicate with clarity: Demonstrate strong verbal, written, and presentation skills to engage stakeholders, senior management, and lead teams effectively.

- Decision-making: Clearly articulates the rationale behind decisions and their potential implications, continuously reflecting on successes and failures to enhance performance and decision-making.

- Adaptive leadership: Recognizes the need for change and actively participates in technical strategy planning.

- Balance priorities: Manage multiple initiatives with strong organizational skills, ensuring alignment with team goals and measurable performance outcomes.

jobs.title: Medical Intelligence Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a driven and professional Medical Intelligence Operations Analyst to work on the US PACOM Command Surgeon’s Decision Support Team (DST). This position serves as the DST's senior medical-intelligence specialist and primary interface with the US PACOM J2 intelligence enterprise regarding biosurveillence and related threats. The Analyst assesses foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, biosecurity, biosafety, and related scientific developments. General all-source experience without medical-intelligence expertise is insufficient. Assigned to the PACOM Joint Intelligence Operations Center (JIOC), the position directly supports Command Surgeon (J07), receives functional priorities from J07 through established contract channels, operates with project and technical oversight from Science and Technology Division (S&T) - J85, and reports administratively to the Amentum Project Lead.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Conduct medical-intelligence analysis of worldwide health, medical, biological, biosecurity, and biosafety issues affecting the US PACOM AOR.

- Assess foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological warfare and bioterrorism threats, medical research, and scientific or technological developments.

- Fuse classified intelligence, medical reporting, scientific research, public-health data, open sources, and partner reporting.

- Identify indicators, trends, anomalies, intelligence gaps, and implications for force health, readiness, and mission risk.

- Maintain awareness of US PACOM plans and operations; assess and forecast medical-intelligence implications for current and anticipated missions.

- Serve as the DST interface with J2, DIA, the National Center for Medical Intelligence, and other Intelligence Community organizations.

- Produce assessments and briefings consistent with analytic standards, classification requirements, and dissemination controls.

- Provide findings to the Operations Planner for integration with epidemiology, Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosive (CBRNE) analysis, Force Health Protection, and operational plans.

- Participate in intelligence exchanges, working groups, exercises, and bilateral or multilateral biosurveillance activities.

- Test the Biosurveillance Information Platform and provide intelligence-specific findings for Military Utility Assessments and recommendations.

- Translate intelligence-user needs into requirements for technical feeds, dashboards, alerts, and workflows; coding is not required.

Minimum Requirements:

- Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree, or equivalent education, intelligence training, military education, and directly related experience.

- Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to complete a polygraph examination if required. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Top-Secret Clearance.

- Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible intelligence analysis, including at least 2 years conducting medical intelligence analysis.

- Medical-intelligence experience involving health threats, foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, or scientific and technical intelligence.

- Working knowledge of DIA analytic tradecraft, product standards, and style requirements and Intelligence Community Directives 203 and 206.

- Ability to fuse medical, scientific, and intelligence information into products suitable for senior Department of War (DoW) leaders.

- Familiarity with military planning and ability to work with military planners; strong analytic writing, briefing, and classified-information handling skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced Degree.

- Medical-intelligence experience within the last 5 years; Military Intelligence Integrated Database (MIDB)/Machine-Assisted Analytic Rapid-Repository System (MARS) or comparable database experience.

- Education or professional experience in medicine, biology, epidemiology, public health, microbiology, or another health field.

- Combatant Command, JIOC, DIA, National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI), biosafety, or biological-research-facility experience.

- Indo-Pacific experience and familiarity with AI-enabled tools, Maven Smart System, or biosurveillance platforms.

- Deep understanding of global infectious diseases, endemic pathogens, biosafety/biosecurity standards (BSL-3/BSL-4), and emerging dual-use biotechnology.

- Thorough knowledge of State/Non-State biological warfare (BW) doctrine, weaponization methods, and bioterrorism threat vectors.

- Familiarity with foreign medical infrastructure, health surveillance capabilities, and foreign military medical readiness.

- Mastery of ICD 203 (Analytic Standards) and ICD 206 (Sourcing Requirements & Dissemination).

- Familiarity with the National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI) operations, reporting workflows, and production frameworks.

- Working knowledge of Joint Staff and Combatant Command (CCMD) intelligence directorate structures (specifically J2, J3/JOC, J07, and J85).

- Working knowledge of public health infrastructure, endemic disease landscapes, and biosecurity policies across the Indo-Pacific Area of Responsibility (AOR).

- Familiarity with regional adversaries' S&T modernization efforts and state-sponsored life sciences research programs.

- Understanding of Force Health Protection (FHP) policies, Joint Operational Planning Process (JOPP), and how medical intelligence integrates into OPLANs/CONPLANs.

Purpose and Impact:

Are you a data professional who thrives on exploring datasets, uncovering insights, and solving complex client challenges? If so, this opportunity could be a great fit.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about data analysis and enjoys identifying meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities to build impactful data-driven solutions. You’ll work on engaging projects that directly influence client outcomes and drive business success.

We believe in the transformative power of data. That’s why we’re looking for someone eager to dive into complex datasets, think critically, and deliver innovative, actionable insights. Your expertise will play a key role in helping our clients make informed decisions and achieve their goals.

Work Schedule: M-F, 40 hours/week (Flex time, Comp time, and Extended Work Week (EWW) approved)

Essential Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

- Preparing regular and ad hoc performance reports to provide valuable insights.

- Creating documents, databases, reports, and presentations as required to support our initiatives.

- Providing support to the Sponsor's business analytics stakeholders whenever needed.

- Apply AI and ML techniques to unstructured data sets, unlocking hidden patterns and insights.

- Utilize statistical techniques to create models using enterprise data warehouses and/or data lakes.

- Collaborate with a team of like-minded professionals, sharing knowledge and ideas to achieve exceptional outcomes.

Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands: General Office environment. The work environment is fast-paced and sometimes involves extreme deadline pressures. The nature of the work requires a high degree of teamwork and cooperation with other members of the staff as well as individuals across the Company and Customers.

Physical Requirements:

- Most work will be done at a desk or computer.

Attendance:

- Attendance is critical at all times. Must be able to work a 40-hour workweek, normally Monday through Friday. However, times and days may vary depending on business requirements. Needs to be available to work overtime during critical peaks and be available to meet last minute requests for overtime should the situation occur.

Other Essential Functions:

- Must be able to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing

- Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others. Must put forward a professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation.

jobs.description:
There was a time when all of America believed that the future of the physical world could be radically different. The engineers of the mid-1900s put a man on the moon in eight years, designed and built planes and submarines from scratch in under three, and conceived of building things we wouldn’t even be able to dream up today.

Today, the last of the engineers who imagined and built these systems are retiring. As they go, we lose not only the engineering knowledge gained from their decades of imagination and trial-and-error, but also the spirit that made that imagination possible.

Amca is working day-in and day-out to restore America’s ability to engineer anything that our critical systems depend on, and reinvigorate the cycle of creation that allows imagination to shape physical reality. We rapidly develop and manufacture new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. By restoring the capability of our antiquated supply chains, we increase the country’s capacity to imagine and realize new systems, and make a physical world that looks very different from today.

Overview

We are always interested in getting to know anyone who may be a fit for our Business Operations team, even if none of the open applications match your background. As you may have already seen, Amca is home to people from all walks of life. We like unconventional backgrounds. We like people who have committed to one thing for a long time and become exceptional at it. We like anyone who is intrinsically motivated. If you are interested in Amca, and not sure how you fit in here, please share your background in this application. We would love to speak with you.

jobs.description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.

Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.

The IT Business Analyst – Supply Chain is responsible for analyzing, defining, and delivering robust technology solutions that support end-to-end supply chain operations and overarching business goals. In this role, you will bridge the gap between operations and IT by translating business process requirements, championing supply chain data governance, and integrating our core ERP (Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O / AX 2012) with specialized ancillary supply chain platforms. You will act as a trusted partner to global Supply Chain teams, helping standardize and optimize workflows across procurement, inventory, warehouse management, quality, compliance, and material planning.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.

Remote:

At Allegion, we recognize that great talent and breakthrough ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why this position offers a flexible remote work arrangement, with occasional on-site visits as needed based on the role. Whether you’re working remotely or collaborating in person, we’re committed to providing the tools, support, and dynamic environment you need to succeed. At Allegion, your career thrives where innovation meets flexibility, empowering you to achieve your goals while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

While this is the current structure and we currently have no plans to change, we reserve the right to make changes to the remote schedule as needed at the Company’s discretion.

What You Will Do:

As a Supply Chain IT Business Analyst, you will bridge the gap between business operations and technology by collaborating with cross-functional leaders to define requirements, streamline processes, and design scalable, future-state solutions aligned with global business strategies. Serving as a functional expert for Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O / AX, you will author Functional Design Documents (FDDs), configure core supply chain modules—prioritizing out-of-the-box functionality—and work alongside technical developers to build custom extensions and integration points. You will evaluate and integrate third-party ancillary systems (such as demand planning tools and supplier portals) to boost end-to-end supply chain visibility. Additionally, you will champion data governance across master data entities (Item Master, BOMs, Vendor Master), utilizing SQL and Power BI to troubleshoot anomalies, validate data flows, and provide actionable business insights. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will drive execution by writing end-to-end test scenarios, leading User Acceptance Testing (UAT), guiding global cutover and post-go-live hypercare, and developing comprehensive training materials to foster sustained user adoption.

What you need to Succeed:

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.

- Experience: 3+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst supporting large manufacturing, distribution, or multi-national supply chain operations.

- ERP Experience: 3+ years of functional experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or AX 2012.

- Domain & Process Knowledge: Demonstrated functional expertise across several (not all required) of the following core supply chain process pillars:

- Procurement & Sourcing: Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders (PO), and Vendor Master management

- Master Data Management: Item Master, Bill of Materials (BOM) creation/maintenance, and data governance

- Warehouse & Inventory Control: Receiving (WMS), Cycle Counting, and Physical Inventory (PI) procedures

- External & Partner Operations: Outside Vendor/Service Operations (OSV), and Supplier-Owned / Managed Inventory (SOMI / VMI)

- Planning & Quality: Demand Forecasting, Product Quality & Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) workflows

- Compliance: Global Trade Compliance and regulatory transaction tracking

- Ancillary Software & Integrations: Experience supporting integrations with peripheral supply chain applications

- Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to lead workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and collaborate with technical development teams.

Preferred:

- Experience participating in global, multi-region ERP implementations, rollouts, or major version upgrades.

- Working knowledge of relational databases and basic-to-intermediate SQL skills for ad-hoc data analysis and validation.

- Knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Power BI) for supply chain metrics and dashboard creation.

- Familiarity with structured implementation methodologies

Work Environment & Travel:

- Travel: Approximately 10%-20% travel required (site visits, project milestones, go-live support).

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Worker Type

Regular

Job Description

Summary

The primary role of the Data Scientist is to drive mission-focused insights from complex datasets. This role involves managing, modeling, and interpreting large-scale government data holdings to support decision-making and operational success. You will combine expertise in mathematics, statistics, computer science, and domain-specific knowledge to deliver actionable conclusions and communicate them effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Position Responsibilities

-
Build and assess analytic models tailored to mission-specific needs

-
Communicate principal conclusions clearly, using mathematics, statistics, and computer science methods

-
Develop reproducible workflows and ensure data integrity

-
Develop qualitative and quantitative methods for exploring and assessing datasets in varying states of organization and cleanliness.

-
Organize, clean, and curate large datasets for analysis

-
Present complex technical findings in a way that is accessible to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Experience

-
Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

-
Minimum 3+ years’ relevant work experience.

-
Experience with software development working with Python in a Unix environment.

-
Experience using the Unix command line.

-
Practical knowledge in Python Machine Learning and Data Visualization

-
Practical knowledge in Data ETL such as working with: Data loading from SQL, CSV, JSON, Excel, etc., Pandas and PySpark

-
Proficiency in statistical packages using any of the following: Python, R, STATA, SPSS, etc.

-
An active TS/SCI with polygraph

Additional Requirements

-
Experience using the Atlassian Tool Suite.

-
Experience with development of any of the following; Hadoop, Pig, MapReduce, or HDFS

-
Working knowledge with other object-oriented programming languages such as Java or C++

-
Working knowledge with Front-end data visualization libraries (i.e., D3.js; Raphael.js, etc.)

We're looking for a data scientist to build a production resource-allocation capability in Palantir Foundry. - Build predictive and forecasting models, including time-series forecasting, to identify future operational trends.

- Conduct uncertainty and sensitivity analyses to quantify confidence in model outputs.

- Partner with subject matter experts to validate model assumptions and improve accuracy over time.

- Benchmark simulation and forecasting models against optimization-based approaches to ensure model validity and cross-validation.

- Evaluate opportunities to apply machine learning as historical data becomes available.

Here is what you need:

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field

- Experience in statistical and simulation modeling, SimPy/AnyLogic/Mesa/SALib or similar

- Strong Python programming skills for statistical/scientific computing

- Ability to work full-time onsite in the DC area

- Must have an Active Secret clearance

- Must be a US Citizen

Preferred experience:

- Experience with linear/mathematical optimization or operations research

- Experience with Palantir Foundry data science tooling.

- Healthcare or public sector domain experience
