jobs.title: Payer Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role

Abacus Insights is seeking a Payer Analytics Consultant to serve as the dedicated data and analytics partner working side-by-side with our business teams and client teams as we launch new and expanded service offerings for health plans. This is a client-facing subject matter expert role for an analytics consultant trained at a top-tier consulting firm, bringing structured problem-solving, executive presence, and client-delivery discipline to payment integrity, provider performance, and payer operations. You’ll turn client questions into the data models, dashboards, and analyses that power their recommendations, leveraging AI and automation wherever it helps you move faster and dig deeper.

In this role, you will travel onsite to client locations alongside other members of the team, gathering requirements in person, presenting your own analysis to client stakeholders, and building the kind of trusted relationships that come from being in the room. This is an individual-contributor, analytics-first role: you are both the technical engine that makes our insights possible, accurate, and repeatable, and a visible, credible voice in front of clients yourself. You’ll help set the standard for how Abacus delivers analytics to health plans as these new offerings take off. This role sits at the intersection of payer domain knowledge, hands-on data analytics, and client delivery.

Note: This role requires travel to and from client sites, estimated at around 25%.

Your day to day

- Own the analytics workstream on client engagements, from scoping and hypothesis development through data modeling, analysis, and delivery of findings

- Partner closely with Abacus’ Payment Integrity and Payer Business Domain consultants, translating their client questions into data models, reports, and analyses that support their recommendations

- Travel onsite to client locations alongside the consulting team to gather requirements, support live engagements, and build direct relationships with client stakeholders

- Present data findings, dashboards, and analyses directly to client stakeholders, including steering committee updates and working sessions, translating technical analysis into clear, actionable takeaways in real time

- Design and manage the queries and data pipelines, working directly inside each client’s own Snowflake or Databricks environment, that pull from client claims, pharmacy, and provider performance systems to support active consulting engagements

- Perform deep-dive analyses (utilization trends, cost drivers, quality metrics, provider performance) and package findings into clear, presentation-ready outputs for consultants and clients alike

- Leverage AI and automation, from AI-assisted query generation to GenAI-powered insight summarization, to accelerate analysis, reduce manual reporting work, and surface findings faster for consultants and clients

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and technical rigor across all client-facing analytics deliverables

- Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to scale, automate, and productize the analytics workflows and tools the consulting team relies on

- Contribute reusable analytics frameworks, templates, and accelerators to Abacus’ consulting methodologies as the practice scales

- Maintain working knowledge of payer domain concepts (claims, utilization management, quality measures, payment integrity, and provider contracting) so analytics outputs are accurate and meaningfully interpreted

What you bring to the team

- A consulting background at a top-tier global firm, such as McKinsey (including QuantumBlack), BCG (including BCG Gamma), Bain, Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Oliver Wyman, or Guidehouse, or a leading healthcare-focused advisory or analytics firm such as Chartis, Huron, Milliman, Optum Advisory, or Clarify Health. We typically see 3+ years of consulting experience, including client-facing analytics delivery within a healthcare payer practice

- 7-10+ years of total hands-on experience in healthcare data analytics, gained at a payer, TPA, health plan vendor, or consulting firm serving them

- Demonstrated consulting craft: hypothesis-driven analysis, structured problem solving, and executive-ready storytelling, with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured data models and clear analyses

- Deep proficiency in SQL and Power BI and/or Tableau, with a track record of building production-grade dashboards and reporting tools

- Experience analyzing medical/pharmacy claims, provider performance, or payment integrity data

- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, comfortable presenting analysis directly to client stakeholders and fielding questions in real time, not just supporting consultants behind the scenes

- Comfort using AI-powered tools (e.g., Copilot-style assistants, GenAI for code/query generation, AI-enabled BI features) to work faster and surface insights more efficiently

- Willingness and ability to travel onsite to client locations as part of a consulting engagement team

- Working familiarity with payer domain concepts: claims processing, utilization management, quality measures (HEDIS/STAR), payment integrity, or provider contracting

- A bachelor’s degree required; an MBA, MHA, MPH, master’s in a quantitative field, or comparable advanced degree from a leading institution is a plus

What we’d like to see, but not required

- Experience with Python or another scripting language for data manipulation and automation

- Exposure to payment integrity specifically, including claims auditing and fraud/waste/abuse detection

- Exposure to provider performance or network analytics

- Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)

- Experience building reusable analytics accelerators or client-ready analytics products within a consulting practice

Compensation

Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What you’ll get in return

- Unlimited paid time off: recharge when you need it

- Work from anywhere: flexibility to fit your life

- Comprehensive health coverage: multiple plan options to choose from

- Equity for every employee: share in our success

- Growth-focused environment: your development matters here

- Home office setup allowance: one-time support to get you started

- Monthly cell phone allowance: stay connected with ease

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.

AI Use in Recruitment

We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks. We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.

Identity and Location Verification

To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.

If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.

By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for more information, including your rights.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today’s digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That’s why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including KitchenPark, CloudRetail, and Profood Properties, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a highly organized and tech-savvy Business Operations Associate to support our Real Estate Development Operations team across MENA. Based in Amman, you’ll work with data, systems, and cross-functional teams to maintain accurate reporting, build dashboards and trackers, and drive operational efficiency.

- Perform routine data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency) on all data related to real estate portfolio management and development projects, following up with teams to correct any discrepancies.

- Ensure data governance standards are followed, including access control, refresh schedules, documentation, and automated reporting processes.

- Build and maintain standardized data models and reporting templates for consistent measurement across the MENA region.

- Develop, automate, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models using Google Sheets, Excel, and other BI tools to support decision-making.

- Lead the implementation and adoption of software platforms (e.g., Yardi, Procore, or other real estate/construction/project management tools).

- Collect, clean, and analyze operational and system usage data to identify trends, adoption challenges, and opportunities for process improvement.

- Analyze operational and system usage data to identify areas for efficiency gains and improved adoption.

- Train users on dashboards, trackers, and systems, ensuring teams understand how and why to input data correctly.

- Design and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for real estate development, including cost, schedule, risk, and platform adoption metrics.

- Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations (slides, dashboards, and written summaries).

- Connecting and integrating multiple data sources, such as Excel, JSON, CSV, SQL databases, SharePoint, and APIs.

What we’re looking for

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or another analytical field.

- 3-5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar data-driven role.

- Exceptional skills in Google Sheets and Excel (dashboards, pivot tables, automation, reporting).

- Understanding of forecasting concepts, including trends and projection techniques.

- Experience with SQL and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar) is a plus.

- Hands-on experience with real estate / construction / project management platforms is highly preferred.

- Fluent in English and Arabic with excellent communication and training skills.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

Key qualities

- Someone who enjoys turning raw, messy data into reliable, actionable insights.

- An analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills and high ownership over data quality.

- A systems-minded professional who can design metrics, reporting frameworks, and digital organization structures.

- A clear communicator who can make data accessible and intuitive for multicultural teams across the MENA region.

- Passionate about accuracy, efficiency, and impact through data.

Why join us

- Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.

- Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.

- Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Amman office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

- Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.

- Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.

- Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.

- Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.

- Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.

- Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.

- Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.

- Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.

- Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.

- Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.

- Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.

- Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

- 5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.

- Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.

- Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.

- Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.

- Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.

- Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.

- Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.

- Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

- Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.

- Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.

- Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.

- Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.

- Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.

- Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.

- Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

jobs.title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Commercial Operations Analyst at Zoox, you will help build and run the operational engine that drives our commercial P&L. Sitting at the center of our commercial business, you will turn pricing, promotions, and demand signals into the day-to-day and week-to-week decisions that move our growth and profitability targets—and stand up the rigor and rhythm that lets us manage those levers as we scale.
This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable in the data and in the operating cadence of a fast-moving business. You will partner closely with Product, Data Science, Fleet Operations, and Finance to translate complex commercial dynamics into clear actions, while helping establish the foundational processes that a growing Central Market Management team will be built on. It is ideal for a technical, structured operator who is energized by ambiguity and excited to shape how an autonomous mobility business is run.

In this role you will:
- Run strategic pricing and promotions operations—standing up and owning the recurring processes to make, monitor, and evaluate pricing and promo decisions, and continuously assess how our commercial systems are performing.

- Own the weekly rhythm of commercial health monitoring, building the metrics, reporting, and review cadences (e.g., market and system health, experiment readouts) that surface issues and guide lever decisions across the business.

- Partner with Finance to translate commercial systems outputs and decisions into P&L impact, helping connect pricing, promos, and demand actions to cost, profit, and bookings outcomes.

- Translate supply-demand dynamics into operational inputs—working with Fleet Orchestration and Fleet

- Operations to inform parameterization, vehicle-hour targets, and demand management across waitlist, gating, and dynamic pricing.

- Synthesize messy operational and financial data into clear, decision-ready recommendations and narratives for cross-functional partners and leadership.

Qualifications
- 6+ years of experience in a quantitative, high-output role—e.g., analytics, data science, strategy & operations, management consulting, investment banking, or a comparable operating role (ideally within mobility, logistics, marketplaces, or tech).

- Strong technical foundation, with proficiency in SQL and Excel/Sheets and the ability to independently pull, structure, and analyze large, disparate datasets; comfort writing Python (or similar) to accelerate analysis is expected.

- A degree in a quantitative or technical discipline (e.g., economics, finance, data science, engineering, or a related field); advanced degrees (MS or MBA) welcome.

- Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solver who goes beyond surface metrics to understand underlying drivers, with strong analytical rigor and a high bar for accuracy in data that informs business and leadership decisions.

- Ability to distill complex analysis into concise storytelling and to operate effectively across functions in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.

Bonus Qualifications
- Experience standing up new operational processes, metrics, or reporting rhythms from scratch (vs. running an established playbook).

- Familiarity with pricing, promotions, demand/supply forecasting, or marketplace economics.

- Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, etc.) and/or advanced analytics tooling (Python, R, Databricks).

jobs.title: Data Scientist, FX Quantitative Research
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data scientists and data analysts learn and grow together. The Treasury Finance Data Science team builds the models, risk frameworks, and decision tools behind how Stripe manages money at global scale: liquidity, funding, counterparty risk, and foreign exchange.

Stripe moves funds across 135+ currencies every day. That creates FX exposure from merchant flows, multi-currency balances, and entity funding. In this role, you'll be a thought partner and builder alongside Stripe's FX team. Together you'll develop the quantitative foundation for how Stripe measures, forecasts, and hedges FX exposure.

What you'll do

You'll be the senior quantitative lead for FX within Treasury Finance Data Science. You'll co-build with Treasury, the FX hedging team, Finance, and Engineering: shaping the research agenda, turning ideas into rigorous models, and building the systems that put those models to work. Data Science owns these systems. They produce the decision-critical outputs and analyses that the FX team and Treasury leadership rely on. This is a hands-on role. You'll design the methodology, write the code, and ship it into production.

Responsibilities

- Partner with the FX team to build and evolve FX risk measurement: exposure aggregation across entities and currencies, VaR / Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and scenario analysis

- Develop forecasting models for FX exposures and multi-currency cash flows. Quantify forecast uncertainty so it can inform hedge sizing and timing.

- Co-design hedge optimization and decision frameworks with the FX team that weigh hedge cost, residual risk, P&L volatility, and liquidity constraints

- Build ML and statistical systems for trading and risk (signal research, anomaly detection on flows, execution and cost analytics), and take them from prototype to production

- Own the production systems that generate decision-critical FX outputs, partnering with Engineering on reliability, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response for risk-critical workflows

- Partner deeply with Treasury Finance stakeholders to turn business questions into quantitative frameworks. Anticipate needs and help shape FX risk strategy rather than reacting to requests.

- Produce clear, trusted analyses and reporting that inform Treasury and Finance leadership decisions, including leadership-level reporting such as MBRs and QBRs

- Use AI tools (code assistants, LLM-based agents) to speed up modeling, analysis, and automation, while maintaining rigor, validation, and auditability

- Raise the technical bar for FX quantitative work within Data Science: methodology standards, model validation, documentation, and mentoring other data scientists

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Location Requirement

- New York, NY required (50% in office - hybrid)

Minimum requirements

- PhD with 1-3 years, MS or MA with 2-6 years, or BS or BA with 4-8 years of data science or quantitative modeling experience

- Hands-on quantitative experience at a bank, asset manager, hedge fund, trading firm, or similar financial institution, with direct exposure to FX, rates, or market risk

- Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and time-series modeling, plus working knowledge of risk measures (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing) and hedging instruments (forwards, swaps, options)

- Proficiency in Python and SQL. You write production-quality code, not just research scripts.

- Experience taking models or analytical systems from research into production

- Business acumen and the ability to turn complex analyses into clear, decision-ready insights

- Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact with cross-functional partners, including senior non-technical stakeholders

- Ability to manage multiple projects at once, with strong attention to detail

- Experience using AI tools to speed up modeling, analysis, and coding

Preferred qualifications

- Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Quantitative / Mathematical Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research)

- Applied machine learning experience in trading or risk (e.g., forecasting, execution analytics, signal research, anomaly detection)

- Experience with corporate treasury or balance-sheet FX: multi-entity exposure management, hedge programs, and treasury concepts such as liquidity, funding, and cash positioning

- Experience building risk or decision systems with engineering standards: code review, testing, monitoring, and defined SLAs

- Experience with distributed data tools (e.g., Spark) and workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Flyte)

- Prior experience at a growth-stage internet, fintech, or payments company

- Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs

- A builder's mindset, with a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom

- Interest in how data products enable automated and agentic workflows, and an understanding that model and data quality determine the reliability of every downstream decision

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DATA SCIENTIST (STARLINK)

At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Data Scientist, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, key metrics, tools, software services, and processes for assessing how well key aspects of Starlink are scaling and how effective the Starlink Network is itself, in serving tens of millions of users around the globe. You will work with operators, subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers inside the Starlink organization as well as key contacts with various major external partners to help ensure the growth of this program.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUSINESS OPERATIONS ANALYST (STARLINK)

One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, Starlink is leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the world's most advanced broadband internet system and largest satellite constellation to provide fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide, connect humanity, and fund Mars colonization.

- Analyze key performance indicators, especially active subscribers, network utilization, produce-to-activate latency, inventory turnover, and hardware unit economics (CAC, payback period); includes developing complex S&OP models and decision-making tools

- Translate analysis into strategic insights and hardware mix strategy to accelerate hardware adoption, maximize lifetime value, and minimize working capital

- Drive resource planning for specific verticals, including the execution of critical hardware ramp and sunset plans in close collaboration with Hardware & Manufacturing Engineering

- 1+ years of experience in Excel or programming

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment

- Quantitative dual degree in engineering field and economics or business field and/or equivalent professional experience

- Extreme sense of urgency and ownership; bias toward action and automation

- Ability to read and interpret income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python; ability to handle large datasets independently

- Excellent analytical modeling skills (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Looker)

jobs.title: Sales Finance Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
The Finance Team supports and empowers Palantirians through day-to-day operations and creative problem-solving. The International Tax Manager is responsible for supporting the company’s direct and indirect tax compliance and reporting across multiple jurisdictions worldwide. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical background with the ability to navigate complex and evolving tax matters with a practical business-oriented approach. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, solutions driven and comfortable working cross functionally to support accurate compliance, effective risk management and scalable tax processes.

Core Responsibilities
- Own process and workflow optimization — proactively identify inefficiencies and gaps in forecasting, reporting, and deal tracking processes. Develop and implement improvements that enhance speed, accuracy, and cross-team collaboration.

- Drive automation and tool development — lead initiatives to automate manual workflows, build dashboards and reporting tools, and reduce ad hoc analysis burden. Leverage AI and automation tools to drive efficiency across Sales Finance processes. Partner with Finance Systems and Engineering teams as needed.

- Turn ad hoc Revenue strategy and performance requests from leadership into scalable workflows — provide the immediate analytical support, identify recurring questions or patterns, and build repeatable processes or tools to address them and reduce future one-off requests.

- Support the Deal Desk team during peak activity periods, particularly quarter-end close. Streamline and improve closeout workflows and ensure timeliness and accuracy.

- Collaborate with forecasting team — work closely with the forecasting analyst to ensure that process improvements integrate seamlessly with weekly execution.

What We Require
- Bachelor’s in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related discipline.

- 3+ years in finance operations, process improvement, systems implementation, or sales operations.

- Comfortable operating in both strategic and tactical modes—designing improvements and executing operationally.

- High ownership and execution bias — sees problems and takes personal accountability for solutions from conception through implementation.

Salary
 
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $95,000 - $160,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual's relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance

•  Commuter benefits
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based

•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year

•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir

Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all, including but not limited to Veterans and those with disabilities. Palantir is committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

The NVIDIA Revenue Marketing Team is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst! We transform sophisticated data into actionable insights for the CMO and collaborators across Marketing, Sales, Developer, Finance, and Product. This role combines the organized problem-solving approach of a management consultant with the technical expertise of a hands-on analyst. We need an AI native, incorporating AI throughout the analytical process, developing reusable solutions, and ensuring the accuracy and business impact of the outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

- Partner with senior leaders to frame business questions, challenge assumptions, and prioritize analytical work based on business impact. Translate leadership priorities into actionable plans and guide initiatives from recommendation to adoption and measurement.

- Synthesize complex marketing, sales, and developer insights into concise executive briefs, presentations, and dashboards that explain what is happening, why it matters, and what to do next. Tailor the narrative and level of detail to the audience.

- Present recommendations to senior executives and lead discussions that advise strategy, investment, and execution. Explain assumptions and tradeoffs, incorporate feedback, and build agreement on decisions and next steps.

- Examine campaign results, account journeys, funnel conversion, pipeline, and revenue attribution to identify growth opportunities and recommend where to focus resources.

- Apply statistical methods to test hypotheses, distinguish meaningful changes from noise, and assess the likely success of proposed actions.

- Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows that accelerate analysis, anomaly detection, and reporting. Validate outputs against source data, protect critical information, and evaluate whether the resulting insights positively guide decisions.

What we need to see:

- 8+ years in management consulting at a strategy consulting firm or similar, synthesizing analysis and advising senior executives. A degree or equivalent experience in Business, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.

- Proven experience synthesizing complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior executives, presenting and facilitating discussions in leadership meetings, and influencing cross-functional decisions through adoption and measurable outcomes.

- An AI-native working approach, proven through analytical workflows or tools you have built and used, with an ability to evaluate generated code and conclusions, identify errors, and apply human judgment.

- Strong analytical judgment in statistical analysis, experimentation, attribution limitations, and the distinction between correlation and causation. Ability to structure ambiguous questions and explain the implications and limitations of findings.

- Experience building dashboards, data models, and visualizations in modern AI-first BI tools, with an emphasis on clear data storytelling, usability, and data quality.

- Shown ownership of analytical projects, strong documentation, and experience influencing cross-functional teams while delivering independently in a constantly evolving environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

- A track record of influencing senior executive decisions through presentations and business reviews, with examples of recommendations adopted and measurable business outcomes.

- SQL and practical Python familiarity, with hands-on experience exploring large datasets in a modern cloud analytics platform.

- Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe Analytics, Tableau, or Amplitude, and with account engagement, pipeline progression, lifecycle measurement, and proactive usage of social listening data.

- Examples of AI agents, analytical web apps, or automated intelligence briefs embraced by business users, with evidence of improved speed, accuracy, or decision making.

- Experience with forecasting, marketing incrementality, or developer ecosystem analysis, including product usage and publicly available engagement data.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 128,000 USD – 195,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 6, 2026.

jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Develop, recommend and update policies and procedures to improve performance. Build dashboards and reports in Jira for leadership analysis. Automate new workflows, collaborating with DevOps teams to improve efficiency and compliance with ITIL standards. Work with Finance teams to report internally on the progress of overdue client invoices. Create and implement monthly and ad-hoc reports for management on key findings and assessments. Identify and communicate any solutions resourcing risks, and ensure accountability from internal stakeholders to Ripple client success. Report on project/milestone completion to ensure resources are on track with go-live timelines for migration of acquired companies into Ripple.

Telecommuting permitted up to 100% per week. Candidate may live anywhere in the U.S.

40 hrs/week, Mon-Fri, 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management or a related field plus two (2) years of experience recommending and creating policies and procedures to improve company performance.

Must have 2 years of experience with treasury management systems or treasury workstation software.

Must have 2 years of experience using Kantata to report on project/milestone completion.

Must have 2 years of experience using PowerBI to enhance reporting with data visualizations.

Must have 2 years of experience reporting on professional services KPIs for internal executives.

Must have 2 years of experience with Jira, including all of the following:

- Automating workflows;

- Integrating AI tools within Jira;

- Building dashboards to track real-time performance with real-time stats;

- Conducting a comparative analysis of ticket KPIs across regions, workflows, or clients, and;

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Credit (Retros)
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.


ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re part of Plaid’s Data organization, building models and insights that help millions of people better understand and grow their financial lives. We use Plaid’s unique financial data to help lenders make more informed decisions and build better credit experiences.

We partner across data science, engineering, product, and Go-to-Market to turn complex data into practical customer recommendations and scalable solutions. We value technical rigor, creativity, user empathy, and teamwork.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist on the Credit team, you’ll apply quantitative analysis and deep credit expertise to help lenders make better use of cash flow insights. You’ll work across customer problems, credit policy, and data products—translating Plaid’s data into recommendations and insights that drive business impact and inform product direction.

Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

 - Deep-dive into model performance for clients, triage issues, and identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

 - Analyze Plaid’s unique data to identify emerging credit risk signals and build and evaluate credit retrospectives.

 - Create tailored recommendations for clients based on their data and Plaid’s insights.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes using tools such as dbt.

 - Develop metrics, alerts, and dashboards to monitor production machine learning model performance.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the process of developing hands-on recommendations for incorporating cash flow insights into lending decisions, using best practices for account-level decisioning.

 - Improve customer adoption of Plaid Insights through custom analysis tailored to each customer’s needs.

 - Serve as a subject matter expert on credit insights and credit policy implementation, supporting Data Science, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners.

 - Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and data visualization to develop models and actionable insights.

 - Identify useful signals that can inform machine learning models.

 - Inform and influence Product and Engineering teams through clear analysis and presentations.



WHAT EXCITES YOU

 - Applying data science and credit expertise to real-world lending decisions.

 - Working with Plaid’s unique financial data to uncover emerging credit risk signals and create useful customer insights.

 - Helping lenders make more informed decisions with cash flow data and account-level recommendations.

 - Partnering across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Go-to-Market to turn analysis into customer and product impact.

 - Working on high-impact problems that can improve financial access and outcomes.



WHAT EXCITES US

 - 2–5 years of industry experience in a financial services Data Science role.

 - Deep familiarity with SQL and Python.

 - Deep understanding of credit risk and the development of underwriting models.

 - Hands-on credit expertise building and maintaining credit policies for lenders.

 - Knowledge of the lending lifecycle and how to optimize each step, including marketing, acquisition, customer management, and collections or recoveries.

 - Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions.

 - Nice to have: Experience building data pipelines and automating ETL processes with dbt or similar tools.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!



Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.



Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here https://plaid.com/legal/#candidate-privacy-notice.


Additional compensation in the form(s) of equity and/or commission are dependent on the position offered. Plaid provides a comprehensive benefit plan, including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k). Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location. jobs.title: Super Day - Business Operations Associate (Rotational Program)
jobs.description:
About Us:

Perpay is a certified B Corp and Philadelphia’s most impactful growth-stage startup. We are driven by a mission to significantly improve the financial stability of everyday Americans. For the past decade, we have established strong product-market fit and a profitable, efficient operating model across a suite of products, positioning Perpay as the premier financial partner for consumers with subprime credit.

With over 500,000 customers who have utilized more than $1 billion in spending power, we are at a pivotal moment. We are scaling our operations, building new offerings, and deepening our impact. We are looking for teammates eager to join us on this journey.

Our venture partners include First Round Capital and L Catterton.

Products we’ve built to make an impact:

- Perpay Marketplace: Combines interest-free payments and modern e-commerce to reduce cost of ownership and promote healthy repayment behavior.

- Perpay+: Leverages Marketplace repayment history to help members monitor and build credit with all 3 credit bureaus.

- Perpay Credit Card: Expands access to the flexibility and benefits of a World Mastercard by removing common barriers like high security deposits and low approval odds.

Our team thrives on in-person collaboration, operating from our unique center-city Philadelphia office. This comfortable "home away from home" space offers river views and fosters rapid product development, strong relationships, and career growth. The energy from achieving big wins is palpable here. While we primarily work in the office, we offer sensible flexibility for personal needs, such as sick children or urgent errands, and coordinate official remote weeks around major holidays. If you are passionate about a meaningful mission, collaboration, equity, and generous perks, Perpay is the best place to be in Philadelphia right now.

This is a 🚀 Super Day Hiring Event 🚀 specific job posting.

What is Super Day?

It's an accelerated hiring event that will give recent graduates the unique opportunity to land this role in just one day! We will host it on January 7th at Perpay HQ in Philadelphia. Selected candidates will tour the office, meet the team, and experience a fast-tracked interview process. Attendance is invite-only, and applicants must complete a pre-work video challenge to be considered. Launch your career by applying below! *Application Deadline: December 18th*

**Please note, if you are unable to attend the super day on January 7th, we encourage you to still apply for the role!**

About the Role:

We’re seeking highly motivated recent graduates who are passionate about our mission and eager to make a meaningful impact on our customers, while supporting the growth of operations. As a Business Operations Specialist, you’ll be instrumental in helping customers navigate their shopping and credit-building experiences. By analyzing customer feedback and operational performance data, you'll help identify areas for improvement and drive changes that enhance both customer satisfaction and overall operational efficiency.

This role also provides a unique chance to explore a range of professional growth opportunities through rotations across various internal teams (for example: Product, Acquisition, Merchandising, Credit Card, Marketing, Compliance, People, and more). During each 10-11 week rotation, you will integrate yourself into the team, work on impactful projects, and build your professional network. You’ll play an integral role in shaping product development and process improvements, acting as a liaison between customers and internal teams. Throughout your rotations, we’ll empower you to discover your path and challenge you to elevate your contributions.

Our greatest strength is our people and we’d love for you to be one of them!

What You'll Do:

Initially

- Deliver exceptional customer service across multiple channels (chat, email, phone), guiding users through their shopping and credit-building journey

- Drive resolution of high-impact problems across operational verticals: Core, Marketplace, Card, and Risk

- Collect and analyze customer service data to develop and implement performance improvement strategies

- Collaborate with overseas BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) partner to provide actionable feedback on customer service interactions, ensuring continuous improvement in agent efficiency, accuracy, and overall service quality

- Maintain and update internal training materials, including SOPs and operational documentation

- Help shape the future of Perpay, ensuring that we continue to exceed customer expectations and expand access to financial services for all

Working Towards

- Rotate through internal teams including Product, Acquisition, Merchandising, Credit Card, Marketing, Compliance, and People

- Work cross-functionally by proposing solutions to optimize operational efficiency and drive business outcomes

- Measure and communicate user friction points to the Product team and propose UX solutions

- Collaborate with Merchandising to support seamless execution of orders, pricing, shipments, and vendor coordination

- Leverage customer service expertise to manage BPO operations, setting clear performance standards to shape agent output while ensuring alignment of business goals

- Lead training for new and existing team members

- Design your career trajectory by diving into experiences that will help you draw your own map – unlocking your professional potential and aligning your passions with meaningful work

Real Stories, Real Growth

This role is just the beginning – a launchpad. Check out how others have navigated their own growth, developed new skills, and taken on exciting new challenges.

“I joined Perpay as a Business Operations Specialist in October 2022, and did rotations through our Merchandising, Product, and Compliance teams. I transitioned to Perpay’s Compliance team full-time shortly after. Now I report directly to our C Suite. Every day, I get to learn from incredibly experienced and talented individuals.” -Luke, Compliance Analyst

"I started with a rotation on the Credit Card team, where I became a subject matter expert on our Credit Card product. Now I lead the Credit Card vertical on the BizOps team, shaping strategy, supporting our outsourced customer service team, and partnering across Product, Engineering, and Compliance to drive impact. It’s been an incredible journey of growth, ownership, and learning." -Steph, Business Operations Specialist

Things We Value:

- Curiosity - You don’t just ask questions, you chase them.

- Passion - You’re excited by the idea of helping others build financial freedom.

- Drive - You act with intention and take initiative.

- Relentlessness - Setbacks don’t faze you. You try, learn, and try again.

- Strong Communication - You speak up, listen well, and aren’t afraid to say “I don’t get it.”

- Grit - You show up, dig in, and get things across the finish line.

- Adaptability - You can handle pivots in responsibilities and are able to adjust as needed.

What You’ll Bring:

- A BA/BS degree, completed in 2025, 2026, or 2027

- GPA of 3.0 or higher

- Commitment to an in-person work environment

Hey, we know not everybody checks all the boxes, so if you’re interested, please apply because you could be just what we’re looking for!

What We’ll Bring to Full-time Team Members:

- Meaningful compensation and equity

- Premium medical benefits (fully paid base plan, and very reasonable premium for the buy-up option)

- 5% employer 401k match

- Unlimited PTO policy

- ​​Remote weeks around major holidays + extra holiday on weekends like MDW and LDW

- High quality catered lunch by local chefs, 4 days / week

- Gym subsidy

- Paid cell phone + plan

- Student loan repayment match program

- Family savings match program

- Relocation assistance

- Generous team member discounts

This is not a remote opportunity; it is 100% onsite (#LI-Onsite) (#LI-TH1) (#LI-AK1)

jobs.title: Legal Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The Legal team at Asana works collaboratively across functions to achieve our ambitious mission of fostering effortless teamwork for everyone. We are a tightly-knit and cooperative group committed to supporting teams throughout the organization, ensuring they have the necessary resources for success while protecting Asana's core values and interests. As a Legal Operations Analyst, you will co-create and drive projects, processes, and enablement to elevate the effectiveness of the Legal & Stock Team while partnering cross-functionally to optimize legal technology and workflows.

This role is based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

-

Administer contracts within the management system (Ironclad) and oversee signature routing in compliance with our global signature policy, ensuring metadata integrity and repository upkeep.

-

Design, build, and deploy automated workflows and self-service tools to streamline operations, eliminate administrative bottlenecks, and accelerate turnaround times.

-

Administer the e-billing platform (Brightflag), managing matters, rate reviews, outside counsel onboarding, and invoice processing in partnership with Finance on purchase orders and accruals.

-

Develop and deliver actionable analytics, reports, and dashboards on department KPIs, cycle times, and resource utilization to inform strategic improvements.

-

Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Finance, Sales, Enterprise Technology) and serve as a reliable lead for legal operations requests, bug fixes, and general troubleshooting.

-

Design and facilitate legal enablement programs and documentation—including training sessions, playbooks, and FAQs—to drive adoption of legal tools and policies.

-

Evaluate and pilot AI tools and emerging technology solutions to drive productivity, automate routine tasks, and support data-informed decision-making.

About you

-

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

-

Proven experience in legal operations, legal engineering, or legal technology administration, preferably within a high-growth technology environment.

-

Deep familiarity with legal operations tools (such as Ironclad, Brightflag, Salesforce, and DocuSign), along with hands-on practice mapping business processes or building workflows in no-code/low-code tools.

-

Strong proficiency with modern work management tools (e.g., Asana) to structure complex deliverables, organize project timelines, and automate cross-functional handoffs.

-

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort gathering, synthesizing, and communicating quantitative data into practical business insights.

-

Clear, empathetic, and adaptable communication skills, with an ability to translate complex processes for varied stakeholders and thrive across shifting priorities.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $125,000 - $142,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

-

-

Career coaching & support

Long-term savings or retirement plans

-

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

jobs.title: Program Tooling & Analytics Developer
jobs.description:
The Program Management Office (PMO) at Zoox is responsible for driving cross-functional program planning and execution at the highest level. We partner with leaders across vehicle development, software engineering, manufacturing, fleet operations, and business functions to deliver the major corporate milestones on the path to launch, and beyond. The quality of those decisions depends on how fast the right evidence reaches the right people — and that is what this role builds.
As a Tooling contractor in PMO, you will build the internal web tools and dashboards that decisions get made on. Zoox generates an enormous amount of data — fleet and simulation logs, program and issue tracking, operational telemetry, map and route data — but very little of it arrives in a form a leader can act on. You will close that gap: pull from existing sources, model the data properly, and ship tools that answer real business questions, including geospatial tooling that scores and compares candidate service areas to inform where we deploy next.
The feedback loop is short. Your users sit in the same building, your tools will show up in program and executive reviews within weeks of shipping, and you will own a piece of the stack end to end rather than work a ticket queue.

In this Role, You Will...
-

Build and ship internal web tools and dashboards on top of existing Zoox data sources, owning them from prototype through the version leaders rely on.

-

Start from the decision, not the dataset — work with TPMs and engineering partners to turn a vague business question into a scoped tool, then iterate quickly on their feedback.

-

Design the data layer behind those tools — queries, transformations, and pipelines that keep them current without manual intervention.

-

Extend our geospatial tooling with new attributes, data sources, and visualizations that sharpen where and how we expand service.

-

Handle real-world data honestly — surface coverage gaps, flag low-confidence results, and make each tool's assumptions visible to the people acting on its output.

Requirements
- Able to work on-site at our Foster City, CA office.

-

Time commitment is flexible and agreed at offer — part-time alongside coursework or full-time both work. A minimum of six months is preferred for continuity.

-

Must adhere to Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

Qualifications
-

Currently enrolled in, or recently completed, a BS or MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent practical experience.

-

Demonstrated experience building web tools or dashboards end to end, through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects. We care more about what you have shipped than where.

-

Strong Python and working SQL, plus enough front-end capability to build a usable interface — React/TypeScript or a Python framework such as Streamlit, Dash, or Flask — with a visualization library (Plotly, D3, or similar).

-

Effective use of generative AI coding tools such as Claude Code, with the discipline to review and test what they produce rather than ship it unread.

-

Solid software fundamentals — version control, code review, readable code — and comfort with messy, incomplete real-world data, including the judgment to know when a result is not trustworthy enough to present.

-

Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain a technical result to a non-specialist audience.

Bonus Qualifications
-

Familiarity with geospatial tooling — GeoPandas, Shapely, OSMnx, H3 or equivalent spatial indexing, and map rendering with deck.gl, Mapbox, Leaflet, or QGIS — and with open data sources such as OpenStreetMap or Overture Maps.

-

Experience with large-scale data processing and BI tooling — Databricks, PySpark, Tableau, or Looker.

-

Background in routing, graph algorithms, or network analysis.

-

Exposure to autonomous vehicles, robotics, mapping, or mobility data, or prior experience building an internal tool other people depended on.

Compensation
$37-43/hour
 
This is a contract position and employment for this position will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly pay range is posted and you will be eligible for a benefits package as offered by the vendor.


About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fleet Orchestration Algorithms
jobs.description:
The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll focus on fleet simulation — the environment our data teams use to develop, test, and evaluate the algorithms that orchestrate our autonomous fleet (dispatch, routing, and vehicle assignment) and to understand how those algorithms perform before they reach the road.
